entries.title: 二十四节气粘土风格图标组
entries.description: 二十四节气完整图标组，以可爱3D粘土/充气风格呈现：每个节气一个圆角方形图标，内含代表…
entries.prompt: Complete set of all 24 Chinese solar terms (节气) as cute 3D clay-style app icons arranged in a 5-column grid on a light grey background. Each solar term has one rounded-corner square icon with a distinct nature symbol in 3D clay/inflatable style. The 24 icons in order: Start of Spring (tree with cloud), Rain Water (rain drops cloud), Awakening of Insects (cloud with thunder/insect), Spring Equinox (white daisy flowers), Clear and Bright (orange flower), Grain Rain (grain stalks with rain), Start of Summer (wheat stalks), Grain Buds (big yellow sun), Grain in Ear (red flower), Summer Solstice (wheat stalks), Minor Heat (white daisy flowers), Major Heat (orange autumn leaf), Start of Autumn (red tulip flower), End of Heat (orange pumpkin shape), White Dew (white cloud), Autumnal Equinox (red apple), Cold Dew (rain cloud), Frost (red maple leaf), Start of Winter (yellow daisy flowers), Minor Snow (white snowflake), Major Snow (white tree with snow), Winter Solstice (big snowflake), Minor Cold (light cloud), Major Cold (pink flower). Each icon: soft pastel background color, 3D clay tactile texture, rounded soft edges. Chinese name label centered below each icon in small clean sans-serif font. 5 icons per row, 5 rows, all icons same size and consistent style. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 全套二十四节气可爱3D粘土风格App图标，排列在浅灰色背景的5列网格中。每个节气一个圆角方形图标，内含独特的自然符号，3D粘土/充气质感。24个图标依次为：立春（带云的树）、雨水（雨滴云朵）、惊蛰（雷云/虫子）、春分（白色雏菊花）、清明（橙色花朵）、谷雨（带雨的谷穗）、立夏（麦穗）、小满（大黄色太阳）、芒种（红色花）、夏至（麦穗）、小暑（白色雏菊）、大暑（橙色秋叶）、立秋（红色郁金香）、处暑（橙色南瓜形）、白露（白色云朵）、秋分（红苹果）、寒露（雨云）、霜降（红色枫叶）、立冬（黄色雏菊）、小雪（白色雪花）、大雪（带雪白色树）、冬至（大雪花）、小寒（淡色云）、大寒（粉色花）。每个图标：柔和马卡龙背景色，3D粘土触感，圆润柔软边缘。每个图标下方居中小号无衬线中文名称标签。5图标一行，5行，所有图标尺寸一致风格统一。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 书法汉字与舞者剪影融合
entries.description: 极具创意的书法与人体融合艺术：将"舞"字的笔画与芭蕾舞者的身体剪影完美融合——舞者上半…
entries.prompt: Extraordinary fusion of Chinese calligraphy and human silhouette art. The Chinese character for dance (舞) is written in bold expressive black ink calligraphy brush strokes, and these very strokes seamlessly transform into the silhouette of a female ballet dancer. The character's upper brushstrokes naturally form the dancer's torso and body shape. The dancer's elegant arms and raised hand extend upward as if growing directly from the character's upper portion, her head with hair bun emerging at the top. The lower strokes of the character extend downward and become the dancer's legs in an arabesque pose, one leg extended, balancing on pointe on a single toe. Everything is pure flat black ink on an off-white soft cream background — no gradients, no grey tones, just bold black ink. The calligraphy strokes are dynamic and energetic: thick powerful strokes, thin flowing curves, ink splatter where the brush lifts. There is a sense of unified motion — the character IS the dancer, the dancer IS the character. Minimal, powerful, deeply elegant. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 非凡的中国书法与人体剪影融合艺术。"舞"字以大胆表现性黑色墨水毛笔笔触书写，这些笔触自然无缝地变形为一位女性芭蕾舞者的剪影。汉字上部笔画自然形成舞者的躯干和身体形态。舞者优雅的手臂和上扬的手势向上延伸，仿佛直接从汉字上部生长而出，头顶有发髻的头部在最高处浮现。汉字下部笔画向下延伸，成为舞者以阿拉贝斯克姿势舞动的双腿，一腿延伸，以单个脚尖立于踮脚尖。一切均为纯平面黑色墨迹在柔和奶白色背景上——无渐变、无灰色调，只有大胆的黑色墨水。书法笔触动感有力：粗重有力的笔画、细腻流转的曲线、提笔处的墨水飞溅。整体有统一的动感——汉字即是舞者，舞者即是汉字。极简、有力、深沉优雅。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 紫藤花下屋顶猫咪插画
entries.description: 治愈系动漫风景插画：一只虎斑猫端坐于古旧中式屋顶瓦片上，仰头望向铺天盖地垂落的紫藤花瀑…
entries.prompt: Breathtaking healing anime landscape painting of a tabby cat sitting on an old Chinese traditional roof. The cat sits in a relaxed upright pose on grey curved ceramic roof tiles, looking upward with wide curious eyes. Above and around the cat: an overwhelming cascade of wisteria flowers in full bloom — hundreds of dense hanging clusters of soft purple-lavender blossoms and green leaves filling the entire upper three-quarters of the frame, like a ceiling of purple flowers. Wooden pergola beams and crossbars visible through the wisteria. Soft diffused spring light filters through the flower canopy creating beautiful dappled light spots and lens-like bokeh circles on the roof tiles. A few fallen purple petals scattered on the grey roof. Color palette: soft purple-lavender wisteria, fresh mint-sage green leaves, warm grey aged roof tiles, bright white sky glow in the background. Painterly brushstroke style combining watercolor and oil painting, loose expressive strokes especially on the flowers and leaves. Makoto Shinkai and Studio Ghibli-inspired atmosphere. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 令人窒息的治愈系动漫风景插画：一只虎斑猫坐在古旧中式传统屋顶上。猫咪以放松的端坐姿势坐在灰色弧形陶瓷屋瓦上，睁着宽大好奇的眼睛向上仰望。猫咪上方和四周：满开的紫藤花倾泻而下——数百串密集垂落的柔和紫-薰衣草色花簇和绿叶充满画面上四分之三，如同紫色花朵天花板。木质凉亭横梁和格架从紫藤间隐约可见。柔和漫射的春日光线透过花冠筛落，在屋瓦上制造美丽的光斑和虚化光圈。几片脱落的紫色花瓣散落在灰色屋顶上。色调：柔和紫-薰衣草色紫藤，清新薄荷鼠尾草绿叶，温暖灰色老旧屋瓦，背景明亮白色天空光晕。笔触风格结合水彩与油画的绘画感，松散表现性笔触尤其体现在花朵和叶片上。新海诚与宫崎骏吉卜力工作室风格氛围。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 数字代码构成的人像
entries.description: 极具冲击力的代码人像：纯黑背景上，一个人物侧面或3/4角度的头像完全由密密麻麻的白色二…
entries.prompt: Dramatic typographic portrait of a human face composed entirely of binary code characters (0s and 1s) and alphanumeric text on a pure pitch-black background. The face of a young Asian man in 3/4 profile view, looking slightly downward with a thoughtful expression. The entire face and head is formed by thousands of tiny white and blue monospace code characters — binary digits, hex codes, and alphanumeric strings. Dense code clusters form the bright highlight areas of the forehead and cheekbones, sparse code forms the shadow areas and contours of the face. The code text transitions from bright white at the top of the head fading to cool electric blue toward the chest and shoulders. The outer edges of the figure dissolve into scattered individual floating code characters, like a digital disintegration effect. The face retains realistic photographic proportions and recognizable human features. Small elegant Chinese text in bottom right corner. Pure artistic digital art meets cinematic portrait photography. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 震撼的人物排版人像——一个人脸完全由二进制代码字符（0和1）及字母数字文本构成，背景纯黑。一位年轻亚洲男性的3/4侧面视角，眼神略向下，若有所思的表情。整个面部和头部由成千上万个细小的白色和蓝色等宽代码字符组成——二进制数字、十六进制代码和字母数字字符串。密集的代码簇形成额头和颧骨的明亮高光区域，稀疏的代码形成脸部阴影区域和轮廓。代码文字从头顶的明亮白色向胸肩部渐变为冷酷电蓝色。人物外缘消散为漂浮的单个代码字符，如数字化瓦解效果。面部保持写实的摄影比例和可辨识的人类特征。右下角有小字优雅中文文案。纯艺术数字艺术遇见电影级人像摄影。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 中药材科普信息图
entries.description: 中药材全套科普信息图：以枸杞为主角，中央超写实大图展示药材实物，左侧手绘植物科学插画标…
entries.prompt: Traditional Chinese medicine educational infographic poster on aged cream parchment paper background. Large bold Chinese calligraphy brush title at top. CENTER: a single hyperrealistic macro photograph of a dried goji berry (wolfberry) showing every wrinkle and texture in vivid orange-red. LEFT SIDE: delicate hand-drawn botanical scientific illustration of the goji plant showing branch with leaves, small white flowers, and bright red berries, with thin annotation lines pointing to labeled parts in Chinese: plant form, microscopic structure, purification, sun-drying. RIGHT SIDE: dashed arrow flow diagram showing processing steps from left to right with small sketch illustrations. LOWER LEFT: circular magnified cross-section showing cellular microscopic structure of the berry. BOTTOM ROW: four final product forms illustrated side by side with Chinese labels below each — reddish-brown powder pile, small medicine bottle with capsule, transparent sealed bag of dried berries, and a glass mug with amber tea liquid and floating berries. All connected by thin dashed annotation lines. Warm cream-yellow parchment paper texture. Vintage botanical illustration meets modern infographic design. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 中医药教育信息图海报，背景为陈旧奶油色羊皮纸质感。顶部大型毛笔书法标题。中央：一颗干枸杞（枸杞子）的超写实微距特写，每条皱纹与纹理清晰可见，鲜艳橙红色。左侧：精细手绘植物科学插画，展示枸杞植株枝条、叶片、白色小花和红色浆果，细细标注线指向中文标注：原植物形态、显微结构、净制、晒干。右侧：虚线箭头流程图，配小素描插图展示炮制步骤：采摘→清洗→晾晒。左下角：圆形放大截面图展示浆果细胞显微结构。底部横排四种成品形态，每种下方配中文标注——红棕色药粉堆、小药瓶配胶裂、透明密封袋装干浆果、玻璃茶杯盛琥珀色茶液漂浮枸杞。所有元素由细虚线标注线连接。温暖奶油黄羊皮纸纹理。复古植物科学插画与现代信息图设计融合。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 食谱手账步骤插画
entries.description: 可爱的螺旋装订手账食谱插画：温黄色网格笔记本纸张背景，顶部大标题采用可爱手写美食字体，…
entries.prompt: Adorable spiral-bound recipe notebook illustration in Japanese manga/anime hand-drawn style. Background: warm cream-yellow vintage grid notebook paper texture with spiral metal ring binding visible on the left edge and top edge. Layout has four illustrated recipe steps arranged on the page. TOP: Large decorative hand-lettered Chinese dish title in warm brown-orange bubble font with small cherry blossom flower doodles as decoration. STEP 1 box: cute watercolor-style illustration of fresh raw prawns with green scallions, ginger slices, garlic cloves, rock sugar crystals arranged nearby, hand-written ingredient list labels with quantities. STEP 2 box: small illustrations of dark soy sauce bottle, light soy sauce, cooking rice wine with hand-written labels. STEP 3 box: a wok/frying pan on a flame with glossy red-orange braised prawns sizzling in sauce, rising steam drawn as wispy lines. STEP 4 box: semi-photorealistic final plated dish of 6-8 beautiful braised whole prawns in rich sauce garnished with fresh scallion greens on a white plate. Decorative elements: small pressed flower and star stickers, doodle borders, warm yellow-amber color palette throughout. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 可爱的螺旋装订食谱手账插画，日系漫画/动漫手绘风格。背景：温暖奶油黄色复古网格笔记本纸张纹理，左侧和顶端可见金属螺旋装订环。页面上排列四个图示食谱步骤。顶部：大型装饰性手写中文菜名，暖棕橙色泡泡字体，小樱花涂鸦点缀。步骤一方框：可爱水彩风格的新鲜生虾插画，旁边配有葱段、姜片、蒜头、冰糖晶体，手写食材标签配用量。步骤二方框：深色酱油瓶、生抽、料酒的小插画，配手写标签。步骤三方框：火焰上的炒锅/平底锅，红橙色光泽油焖大虾在酱汁中滋滋作响，缭绕蒸汽以飘散线条绘出。步骤四方框：半写实风格最终摆盘成品——6-8只完整美丽的油焖大虾淋上浓郁酱汁，白色盘子上撒新鲜葱花点缀。装饰元素：小型压花与星形贴纸、涂鸦边框、全篇温暖黄琥珀色调。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 未来科技蓝图路线图三维可视化
entries.description: 科技蓝图三维路线图：一卷蓝色电路图卷轴从近景展开延伸至远处，展开部分变成发光的透明蓝色…
entries.prompt: Epic futuristic technology roadmap 3D visualization poster. A large engineering blueprint scroll is unrolling diagonally across a dark deep-blue reflective surface — one end still tightly rolled showing printed circuit diagrams and technical drawings, the middle section unrolling and transforming, the fully unrolled far end becoming a glowing translucent light-blue S-curved road/pathway that extends into the distance. Along this glowing road: miniature 3D scene elements placed at key stations: a cluster of glass and steel smart city skyscrapers with glowing blue windows, a sleek electric autonomous car (blue) and SUV (orange) driving on a side road, a white humanoid AI robot standing confidently, multiple professional delivery drones hovering with packages, a compact industrial data center with cooling units, a space shuttle on a launch platform, a tall telecommunications tower with circular signal rings emanating from it. Floating holographic HUD panels with blue text showing tech labels. All connected by glowing blue neon circuit-line paths. Dark navy reflective floor. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 史诗级未来科技路线图三维可视化海报。一卷大型工程蓝图卷轴斜向展开于深蓝色反光台面上——一端仍紧紧卷着，上面印有电路图和技术线稿，中段正在展开并发生转变，完全展开的远端变成发光透明浅蓝色S形弯曲道路/路径延伸至远处。沿这条发光道路，各关键节点摆放微缩三维场景元素：一组玻璃钢材智慧城市摩天楼，窗户蓝光闪烁；一辆流线型蓝色电动自动驾驶轿车和橙色SUV在支路行驶；一个白色人形AI机器人自信站立；多架专业配送无人机携包悬停；一座紧凑型工业数据中心配冷却机组；一个航天飞机发射台；一座高耸电信塔发出同心圆信号波纹。漂浮的全息 HUD 面板显示蓝色科技文字标签。所有节点由发光蓝色霓虹电路线相连。深海军蓝反光地板。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 城市名称3D景观字体设计
entries.description: 将中文城市名称的每个汉字变成立体三维景观字——字的笔画由微缩城市地标和自然景观构成：亭…
entries.prompt: Spectacular 3D Chinese character landscape typography art. The two characters for a Chinese city name are rendered as large-scale 3D sculptural forms, each character's strokes built from miniature city landmarks embedded within them. The brush strokes appear to be made of clay or thick paint, vibrant teal-blue color, with miniature 3D scenes growing from the strokes: classical stone arch bridges spanning the horizontal strokes, traditional Chinese pavilions and pagodas rising from the vertical strokes, weeping willow trees and blooming sakura/maple trees tucked into corners, lakes and rivers flowing through the curved strokes, traditional Chinese rooftop tiles visible on buildings. Bottom character has a multi-storied pagoda rising prominently from it, surrounded by a lake, stone lanterns, and autumn foliage in orange and red. Color palette: vibrant teal-cyan for the main strokes, red-orange pavilions, lush green trees, autumn orange and pink foliage. Pure white clean background. Small traditional red circular seal stamp (印章) in top right corner. Cinematic volumetric lighting. 9:16 vertical poster.
entries.promptZh: 震撼的三维中文城市名景观字体艺术。城市名称的每个汉字被渲染为大型三维雕塑形态，每个字的笔画由嵌入其中的城市地标微缩景观构成。笔画看起来由粘土或厚重颜料制成，鲜艳蓝绿色，微型三维场景从笔画中生长：经典石拱桥横跨横画，传统中国凉亭和宝塔从竖画中升起，垂柳和盛开的樱花/枫树嵌于笔画转折，湖泊和河流流淌于弧形笔画中，建筑上可见传统中式屋顶瓦片。下方汉字有多层宝塔从中突出，周围环绕湖泊、石灯笼、橙红秋色。色调：主笔画为鲜艳蓝绿色，红橙色亭台，翠绿树木，橙粉秋叶。纯白干净背景。右上角小型传统红色圆形印章。电影级体积光照。竖版9:16海报。

entries.title: 中国古镇珐琅徽章设计
entries.description: 精致金属珐琅徽章设计：以徽派建筑轮廓为外形，内嵌江南古镇全景——拱桥横跨运河，粉墙黛瓦…
entries.prompt: Collector-quality Chinese ancient town enamel pin badge product photography. The pin is shaped like a traditional Huizhou-style architecture outline — a white-wall building silhouette with upswept roof corners as the pin border. Inside the pin: detailed miniature scene of a Jiangnan water-town canal: a classic stone arch bridge spanning the turquoise canal, traditional white-wall black-tile buildings lining both banks, a small wooden wupeng boat with bamboo awning gliding on the water, drooping willow trees with soft green leaves, a decorative dark ceramic wine bottle on the right bank. All rendered in flat enamel paint with clean color fills. Bright gold metal outlining all internal dividers and the outer border. Bottom of pin: an elegant gold banner with Chinese town name and romanized pinyin text. The complete pin sits on a warm beige sand-colored background, photographed slightly overhead, soft shadow underneath. High-end enamel pin quality, museum gift shop level. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 收藏级中国古镇珐琅徽章产品摄影。徽章外形为传统徽派建筑剪影轮廓——白墙建筑侧面配翘角屋檐作为徽章边框。徽章内：精细的江南水乡运河微型场景：经典石拱桥横跨碧绿运河，传统粉墙黛瓦沿河两岸排列，一艘带竹篷的小木乌篷船在水面滑行，垂柳轻拂，右岸一只装饰性深色陶瓷酒瓶。全部以扁平珐琅上色，颜色填充干净。金色金属勾勒所有内部分隔线和外缘。徽章底部：优雅金色横幅刻有中文古镇名称和拼音。完整徽章置于温暖米色背景上，微俯角拍摄，下方有柔和阴影。高端珐琅徽章品质，博物馆礼品级。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 长城日落渐变插画
entries.description: 极简扁平风格的长城渐变插画：红橙金三色天空渐变背景，圆形红日在山巅，长城蜿蜒攀越流光金…
entries.prompt: Minimalist flat-design illustration of the Great Wall of China at golden hour. Background: smooth gradient sky from warm saffron yellow at top through vibrant orange to deep crimson red at bottom. Perfect red circle sun with no rays positioned behind mountain peaks. Stylized undulating mountain silhouettes with fine horizontal line texture to suggest terrain folds, flowing organic curves. The Great Wall winding dramatically along the mountain ridges, rendered in glowing gold color with architectural detail of towers and battlements visible. Gold glitter particle dust scattered around the wall base. Overall aesthetic: clean graphic design meets traditional Chinese painting. No clouds, no people, purely geometric and ornamental. Suitable for phone wallpaper. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 极简扁平设计风格的中国长城金黄时刻插画。背景：天空从顶部暖藏黄色渐变，经过鲜艳橙色，过渡到底部深红色。正圆形红日无光芒悬于山峰之后。程式化的起伏山脉轮廓，配以细密横线纹理表现地形褶皱。长城沿山脊蜿蜒，以发光金色渲染，可见城楼和雉堞的建筑细节。墙基周围散落金色亮片粉尘颗粒。整体美学：简洁平面设计融合传统中国画意境。无云彩、无人物，纯粹几何与装饰美感。适合手机壁纸。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 现代都市女性茶室人像
entries.description: 中西交融人像摄影：都市女性坐于仿古圈椅中，手捧透明茶杯，佩戴Apple Watch和有…
entries.prompt: Cinematic portrait of a modern Chinese woman in a traditional Chinese study-room setting. She sits relaxed in a classic rosewood circular armchair. Short wavy black hair, natural makeup, warm confident smile. Wearing an oversized brown wool sweater, Apple Watch on wrist, white wired earphones. Holding a glass tea cup with hot tea, visible steam rising. Background: classical Chinese wooden bookshelves lined with old books, decorative antiques, traditional lattice window with bamboo shadow outside. Warm golden amber cinematic light streaming from the window side. Color grade: warm browns, deep shadows, cozy afternoon mood. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 电影感人像摄影：现代都市中国女性坐于传统中式书房。她悠然坐在经典红木圈椅上。短卷发，淡妆，温暖自信的笑容。身穿咖啡色宽松羊毛毛衣，手腕佩戴Apple Watch，白色有线耳机挂于耳边。双手捧着透明玻璃茶杯，热茶升腾白色烟雾。背景：古典中式博古架陈列旧书与古玩，传统中式格窗，窗外竹影婆娑。暖金色电影光线从窗侧洒入。色调：暖棕色调，深沉阴影，午后慵懒氛围。85mm f/1.4拍摄，浅景深。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 北京地标建筑蓝图立体海报
entries.description: 工程蓝图与立体微缩模型的混合视觉海报：画面一侧是建筑蓝图线稿，另一侧撕开露出全彩立体模…
entries.prompt: Beijing city landmarks poster, half architectural blueprint technical drawing and half full-color 3D miniature model, paper tearing reveal effect at the boundary, gold foil accents. 3D miniature buildings: Temple of Heaven, Forbidden City, Bird's Nest stadium, CCTV headquarters twisted tower, Great Wall winding through mountains, Water Cube. Chinese red and gold color palette, cream blueprint paper background on the left. Large Chinese calligraphy brushstroke text Beijing and italic serif Beijing at bottom. Viewed from 45-degree angle on red textured surface. Cinematic depth of field on the miniature models. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 北京城市地标海报，左半部分是建筑蓝图技术线稿，右半部分是全彩立体微缩模型，边界处有撕纸揭开效果，金箔装饰。立体建筑模型包括：天坛、故宫、鸟巢体育场、CCTV总部扭转大楼、长城蜿蜒山间、水立方。中国红与金色配色，左侧米白色蓝图纸背景。底部有大幅毛笔书法北京和斜体衬线Beijing文字。从45度角俯视，放置于红色纹理桌面上。微缩模型部分有电影级景深效果。竖版9:16。

entries.title: 中国省份三维地形可视化地图
entries.description: 三维立体地形省份地图：真实山脉起伏的地形地貌，每个地级市用不同颜色区块划分，省界及沿海…
entries.prompt: Photorealistic 3D topographic relief map of a Chinese province. The terrain is raised and sculpted showing actual mountain ranges, plains, and coastline geography in physical 3D relief. Each prefecture-level city region is filled with a distinct solid color: rich jewel tones — deep purple, warm orange-red, teal green, olive gold, dark amber, dusty blue, coral pink, sage green, warm slate. The outer border of the entire province and major river boundaries glow with electric neon blue light, as if lit from below. White bold Chinese city name labels float above each region. The province floats on a dark charcoal grey stone-textured base map showing surrounding geography (sea, neighboring provinces in grey). Dramatic cinematic lighting from upper left creating strong shadows on the raised terrain. Slightly aerial bird's-eye view angle. Ultra-realistic CGI render quality. 1:1 square.
entries.promptZh: 中国省份超写实三维地形起伏地图。地形凸起雕刻，真实呈现山脉、平原和海岸线地理的三维立体效果。每个地级市行政区划以不同纯色填充：丰富的宝石色调——深紫、暖橙红、蓝绿、橄榄金、深琥珀、雾蓝、珊瑚粉、鼠尾草绿、暖石板灰。整个省份外缘及主要河流边界发出电蓝色霓虹光，如同从下方照亮。白色粗体中文城市名称标签悬浮于各区域上方。省份漂浮在深炭灰色石质纹理底图上，显示周边地理（大海、邻省以灰色呈现）。左上方戏剧性电影光照，在凸起地形上制造强烈阴影。轻微航拍俯视角度。超写实CGI渲染品质。方版1:1。

entries.title: IP毛绒玩具设计蓝图
entries.description: IP公仔的工业设计蓝图风格：方格纸背景，正面/侧面/背面三视图排列，标注头部/身体/四…
entries.prompt: Cute plush toy product design blueprint sheet. Aged cream grid paper background. durian fruit shaped kawaii plush toy character shown in three orthographic views: 正面 (front), 侧面 (side), 背面 (back). Pencil sketch outlines alongside detailed color render of the soft toy. Chinese dimension annotations with arrows: 头部 Xcm, 身体 Xcm, 腿部 Xcm, 刺长 Xcm. Additional small orthographic silhouettes in corners. The toy has big round cute eyes, soft fluffy texture, chubby proportions. Professional product design specification sheet aesthetic. 2:3 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 可爱毛绒玩具产品设计蓝图。做旧奶油色方格纸背景。【动物/物体】形状的卡哇伊毛绒玩具角色，以三视图呈现：正面、侧面、背面。铅笔草图轮廓线与详细彩色效果图并排展示。带箭头的中文尺寸标注：头部Xcm、身体Xcm、腿部Xcm、刺长Xcm。角落有额外的小型正交剪影图。玩具有大大圆圆的可爱眼睛、柔软毛茸茸的质感、圆润胖乎乎的比例。专业产品设计规格表美学风格。竖版 2:3。

entries.title: 云南菌菇火锅贴纸插画
entries.description: 黑底贴纸风格美食插画：云南野生菌菇火锅为主角，深陶土锅中煮着各类珍稀菌菇，筷子夹起一朵…
entries.prompt: Food sticker illustration on pure black background, white outline sticker border around the entire composition. Main subject: Yunnan wild mushroom hotpot in a rustic clay earthenware pot, golden amber broth bubbling, filled with premium wild mushrooms including matsutake, porcini, morel, chanterelle, king oyster mushrooms. Chopsticks lifting a large gorgeous mushroom with golden broth dripping. Watercolor-style illustration technique, vibrant warm colors. Upper left area: white irregular sticker shape containing large bold Chinese calligraphy brush text for Yunnan mushroom hotpot, smaller Chinese subtitle text, English subtitle YUNNAN WILD MUSHROOM HOTPOT. Bottom left: woven bamboo basket with fresh raw mushrooms and sliced raw meat. Overall warm appetizing color palette with black background creating drama. 1:1 square.
entries.promptZh: 纯黑色背景上的美食贴纸插画，整体构图有白色描边贴纸效果。主体：云南野生菌菇火锅，古朴陶土锅，金色琥珀色汤汁咕嘟冒泡，内有各类珍稀野生菌菇——松茸、牛肝菌、羊肚菌、鸡油菌、杏鲍菇。筷子夹起一朵大型完整菌菇，金色汤汁滴落。水彩风格插画技法，色彩饱和鲜艳。左上角：白色不规则贴纸形状，内含大幅毛笔字云南菌菇火锅，小号文字山珍至味鲜香浓郁，英文副标题YUNNAN WILD MUSHROOM HOTPOT。左下角：竹编篮子里摆放新鲜生菌菇和生肉配料。整体温暖食欲色调，黑色背景制造戏剧张力。方版1:1。

entries.title: 范曾风格水墨人物肖像
entries.description: 范曾大师风格的中国写意水墨人物：古代文人/武将半身像，自信的大笔触勾勒五官，极简色彩—…
entries.prompt: Chinese ink wash portrait in the style of master Fan Zeng (范曾). Half-body portrait of an ancient Chinese scholar literati. Confident bold brushwork defining facial features — sharp eyebrows, knowing expression, goatee. Very limited color palette: rich black ink for hair and details, cobalt blue wash for robes, vermilion-red accent on earlobes and lips. Vast white paper background as negative space. Traditional topknot hairstyle with headband. Ink robes loosely rendered with wet brush strokes — not tight or detailed. Artist red seal stamp (印章) and calligraphy signature lower right corner. The proud scholarly spirit of Tang and Song dynasty literati. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以范曾大师风格创作的中国写意水墨人物肖像。古代中国【文人/武将/侠客/士大夫】半身像。自信有力的大笔触勾勒面部特征——锋利眉毛、深邃眼神、山羊胡。极简色彩：浓黑墨描绘头发与细节，钴蓝色晕染衣袍，朱砂红点染耳垂与嘴唇。大面积白色纸张背景作为留白。传统发髻造型配头巾束发。衣袍以湿润笔触松散表现——不拘谨、不精细。右下角有红色印章与书法落款。唐宋文人士大夫的傲骨与儒雅气质。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 微缩食品作坊微观世界
entries.description: 移轴摄影风格的微缩世界：比例尺玩具小人在传统食品作坊中忙碌劳作，制作糖果/包子/面条等…
entries.prompt: Hyperrealistic tilt-shift miniature diorama photography of a traditional Chinese traditional Chinese workshop. Tiny 1:87 scale figurines as workers wearing aprons, actively making maltose candy workshop. Miniature traditional workshop equipment: wok stoves, wooden barrels, bamboo steamers, display tables with food. Warm amber honey food tones dominate. Shallow depth of field — foreground sharp, background softly blurred. Overhead or slight aerial angle. Incredibly detailed — individual grain texture on food, wood grain on barrels, fabric texture on aprons. The magical charm of a Miniature Calendar photo. 4:5 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 超写实移轴微缩立体模型摄影，传统中式【食品类型】作坊场景。1:87比例的微型玩具小人作为工人，穿着围裙，正在制作【具体食物，如麦芽糖/饺子/面条】。微型传统作坊设备：炉灶、木桶、竹蒸笼、陈列食物的展示台。温暖的琥珀蜂蜜食物色调为主。浅景深——前景清晰，背景柔和虚化。俯视或轻微斜上方角度。细节无比精细——食物表面的单粒纹理、木桶上的木纹、围裙上的织物纹理。微型日历（Miniature Calendar）那种神奇魅力。竖版 4:5。

entries.title: 中国古建筑爆炸结构图
entries.description: 中国古典建筑（故宫、天坛等）的爆炸分解结构图：中央为高精度3D等距渲染模型，屋顶/斗拱…
entries.prompt: Chinese imperial architecture exploded diagram infographic. Central subject: a Forbidden City main ceremonial hall (Taihedian) rendered as a highly detailed photorealistic isometric 3D model. Exploded view showing structural layers floating apart: glazed tile roof, elaborate dougong bracket clusters, red lacquer columns, painted ceiling medallion, marble terrace with balusters. White background. Technical blueprint drawings in corners: floor plan, elevation, cross-section. Chinese annotation lines with measurements pointing to architectural components. Gold, vermilion red, and deep teal color palette. JY DESIGN aesthetic — architecture education meets visual art. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 中国皇家建筑爆炸分解图信息图。中心主体：【建筑类型，如故宫楼阁/天坛/宝塔】以高度精细的写实等距3D模型呈现。爆炸视图展示各结构层漂浮分离：琉璃瓦屋顶、精美斗拱组、朱红漆柱、彩绘藻井、汉白玉栏杆台基。白色背景。角落有技术蓝图：平面图、立面图、剖面图。带尺寸标注的中文引线指向各建筑构件。金色、朱红与深青的色调搭配。JY DESIGN美学——建筑教育与视觉艺术的融合。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: Quentin Blake 月夜奔跑插画
entries.description: Quentin Blake 标志性月夜风格：宽阔的蓝色水彩天空、皎洁圆月，单个人物在惊…
entries.prompt: Quentin Blake illustration style, moonlit night scene. A single expressive cartoon character running in fright or flying through the air — wild hair, bulging eyes, arms flailing. Dramatic wide blue watercolor sky wash filling the upper half, large full moon top right. Black ink loose energetic strokes swirling around the figure suggesting wind and movement. Bare tree branches in black ink at edges. Bottom half fades to white/cream paper. No background clutter — the character and moon are everything. The magical frightening energy of a Roald Dahl book cover illustration. 3:4 portrait format.
entries.promptZh: Quentin Blake插画风格，月夜场景。单个表情夸张的卡通人物在空中惊慌奔跑或飞翔——头发乱飞、眼睛圆睁、双臂挥舞。宽阔的蓝色水彩天空填满上半部分，右上方有一轮大圆月。松散充满活力的黑色墨水线条在人物周围旋转，暗示风和运动感。边缘有黑色墨线勾勒的枯树枝。下半部分渐变为白色/奶油色纸张。背景简洁干净——人物和月亮就是一切。罗尔德·达尔书封那种神奇又惊悚的能量。竖版 3:4。

entries.title: 敦煌丝路史诗海报
entries.description: 以莫高窟为舞台的中国文化史诗海报：洞窟穹顶内巨型金佛端坐，飞天仙女腾云飞舞，一卷古代金…
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic Chinese cultural epic poster with Dunhuang Mogao Caves theme. A colossal golden Buddha statue inside a cave grotto, hand raised in blessing mudra. Ancient Dunhuang flying apsara (飞天) with flowing silk ribbons ascending around the Buddha. A giant ancient Chinese manuscript scroll unrolls from the Buddha's hand and cascades down, its surface covered in beautiful calligraphy. A small Silk Road camel caravan walks along the scroll as if it were a road. Rich warm color palette: gold, amber, deep ochre, terra cotta red. Red silk ribbons flying dynamically. Cave walls covered in colorful Buddhist murals. Mystical mist and golden light rays. Large Chinese calligraphy title in gold at the bottom. 9:16 vertical epic scale.
entries.promptZh: 创作以敦煌莫高窟为主题的中国文化史诗海报。洞窟内一尊巨大的金色佛像端坐，手持说法印。敦煌飞天仙女携飘飞的丝带在佛像周围腾空飞舞。一卷巨大的古代汉字卷轴从佛手处铺展而下，表面写满精美书法。一支丝绸之路的骆驼商队踏着卷轴行走，卷轴宛如道路。色调浓郁温暖：金色、琥珀、赭石、朱砂红。红色丝带动感飞扬。洞窟壁面布满彩色佛教壁画。神秘薄雾与金色光芒。底部以金色大字书写中文标题。竖版 9:16 史诗规格。

entries.title: Quentin Blake 手绘卡通插画
entries.description: 模仿罗尔德·达尔御用插画师 Quentin Blake 的经典风格：奔放的钢笔线条、蜡…
entries.prompt: Create an illustration in the exact style of Quentin Blake, the beloved illustrator of Roald Dahl books. Loose, energetic ink line work with slightly scratchy pen strokes. Watercolor and crayon washes as fill — never perfectly within the lines. Two expressive cartoon characters interacting: a wild-haired absent-minded professor and a delighted gap-toothed child in a chaotic garden with books flying everywhere. Exaggerated facial expressions and gestural body language. Wildflowers, garden plants, or simple interior props as background. Off-white or cream paper background. Playful hand-lettered style title if text needed. The spontaneous, joyful energy of classic British children's book illustration. 9:16 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 以 Quentin Blake（罗尔德·达尔御用插画师）的经典风格创作插画。松散而充满活力的钢笔线条，略带抖动感的笔触。水彩与蜡笔填色，颜色不需要精准在线条内。两个表情夸张的卡通人物互动：【角色1】与【角色2】在【场景/背景】中。夸大的表情与肢体语言充满表现力。背景用野花、花园植物或简单室内道具。米白色或奶油色纸张背景。如有文字则使用手写感的俏皮字体。捕捉经典英国童书插画那种自发的、欢乐的生命力。竖版 9:16。

entries.title: 高定晚礼服
entries.description: 高级定制晚礼服编辑大片，华丽礼服在宫殿或剧院场景中展现绝世风华，时尚王国的极致。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking haute couture evening gown fashion editorial. Model in magnificent ball gown or column dress by Alexander McQueen — dramatic sculpted black gown. Grand architectural setting: opera house, palace ballroom, or museum. Dramatic theatrical lighting. The gown as sculpture. Valentino, Giambattista Valli, or Elie Saab visual language. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作令人窒息的高级定制晚礼服时尚编辑大片。模特穿着【[设计师]】华丽的蓬蓬裙或修身礼服。宏伟建筑场景：歌剧院、宫殿宴会厅或博物馆。戏剧性剧场灯光。礼服作为雕塑。华伦天奴、詹巴蒂斯塔·瓦利或艾利·萨博视觉语言。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 汉服时尚编辑大片
entries.description: 汉服时尚编辑大片，古代华服在自然山水间飘逸，传统服饰美学的当代时尚重新演绎。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful hanfu traditional Chinese clothing fashion editorial. Model in flowing silk hanfu — Wei or Tang dynasty style — in natural setting: bamboo grove, lotus pond, or ancient architecture. Fabric movement in wind. Natural light. Cultural poetry combined with fashion photography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的汉服中国传统服饰时尚编辑大片。模特穿着飘逸丝绸汉服——魏或唐朝风格——在自然场景中：竹林、荷花池或古建筑。面料在风中飘动。自然光线。文化诗意与时装摄影的结合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 水上鸟居日落
entries.description: 严岛神社水上鸟居日落，潮水涨时朱红鸟居漂浮于金色水面，日本最美的神圣景观之一。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking photograph of Itsukushima floating torii gate at sunset. The iconic vermilion torii reflected in still high-tide water, blazing orange and gold sunset sky behind. Minimal boat or figure for scale. Long exposure smoothing the water. One of Japan's most iconic sacred landscapes. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作严岛神社水上鸟居日落的惊艳摄影。标志性朱红鸟居倒映在满潮平静水面，身后燃烧橙金色落日天空。极小的船或人物给予比例感。长曝光令水面光滑如镜。日本最标志性的神圣景观之一。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 日本水墨画
entries.description: 日本水墨画（墨绘），飞白与浓墨交织，寥寥数笔捕捉万物神韵，东方哲学的视觉精髓。
entries.prompt: Create a traditional Japanese sumi-e ink brush painting of a lone bamboo grove swaying in morning mist. Masterful brushwork with varying ink density — dark saturated strokes and dry feathered brushwork. Extensive negative space (ma) as compositional element. Subject: bamboo, plum blossom, mountain, or tiger. Rice paper texture. Seals and haiku calligraphy. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[主题]】的传统日本水墨画（墨绘）。精湛的笔触，墨色浓淡变化——深沉饱满的笔迹与干笔飞白。大量负空间（間）作为构图元素。主题：竹子、梅花、山脉或老虎。宣纸质感。印章与俳句书法。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 传统服饰民族人像
entries.description: 传统民族服饰人像，精美刺绣与配饰记录文化的精华，人文与美学兼备的视觉档案。
entries.prompt: Create a dignified traditional costume portrait of Miao ethnic minority of Guizhou — elaborate silver headdress and embroidered costume. Subject wearing authentic traditional garments with intricate embroidery, jewelry, and headdress. Natural light or softbox that honors the textile details. Respectful documentary photography. Rich textile texture visible. Cultural heritage documentation quality. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[民族/文化]】庄重的传统服饰人像。人物穿着真实的传统服装，配有精美刺绣、珠宝与头饰。尊重纺织细节的自然光或柔光箱。尊重文化的纪录式摄影。丰富织物质感可见。文化遗产记录品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 彩色凝胶棚拍人像
entries.description: 彩色凝胶灯光棚拍人像，多色打光在人物脸上投射戏剧性色彩分割，当代艺术摄影。
entries.prompt: Create a colored gel studio portrait photograph. Model lit by multiple colored gels — one side deep magenta, other side electric blue, with split lighting creating dramatic color division across the face. Pure black studio background. High contrast skin tones. Fashion-forward creative photography. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作彩色凝胶工作室人像摄影。模特被多色凝胶灯照亮——一侧深品红，另一侧电光蓝，分色打光在脸上制造戏剧性色彩分割。纯黑工作室背景。高对比肤色。前卫时尚创意摄影。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 浮世绘现代融合插画
entries.description: 浮世绘与现代元素的视觉融合，传统木版印刷风格描绘当代都市场景，古今对话。
entries.prompt: Create a Ukiyo-e style woodblock print illustration fusing traditional with modern: classic Hokusai or Hiroshige style but depicting a vintage red Ferrari 250 GTO racing through rain. Hand-carved woodblock print texture. Limited palette with flat areas. Bold black outlines. Diagonal rain or wave pattern. Poetic fusion of eras. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作浮世绘风格木版印刷插画，融合传统与现代：经典北斋或广重风格，但描绘【[现代主题——东京天际线、跑车、宇航员]】。手雕木版印刷质感。有限色板与平面色块区域。粗犷黑色轮廓线。斜线雨或波浪纹样。跨越时代的诗意融合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 中国新年春节海报
entries.description: 中国春节主题海报，传统剪纸与国画笔法结合，喜庆红金配色，传递东方新年祝福。
entries.prompt: Create a Chinese New Year celebration poster. Traditional paper-cut silhouettes of zodiac animal and auspicious elements — peony, lanterns, fireworks. Ink wash painting background with red and gold as dominant palette. Bold Chinese calligraphy blessings. Woodblock print texture. Festive and culturally rich. 3:4 ratio.
entries.promptZh: 创作中国新年庆典海报。传统剪纸风格生肖动物与吉祥元素——牡丹、灯笼、烟花。水墨背景，红金为主色调。粗犷毛笔书法祝福语。木版印刷质感。喜庆而富有文化底蕴。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 吉卜力风格田园村庄
entries.description: 吉卜力动画风格田园村庄，绿意盎然的山坡小屋与金色午后，宫崎骏式的温柔世界观。
entries.prompt: Create a Studio Ghibli-inspired countryside village scene. Rolling green hills with a picturesque village of stone and timber houses, windmill, herb gardens. Warm golden afternoon light with dramatic cumulus clouds. A small girl in a sundress walking down a cobblestone path. Wildflowers in foreground. Painterly background inspired by Howl's Moving Castle and Kiki's Delivery Service. Nostalgic hand-painted quality. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张吉卜力工作室风格的乡村田园场景。连绵起伏的绿色山丘，错落有致的石木小屋村庄，有风车、香草园。温暖金色午后阳光搭配戏剧性积云。石板路上一个穿着连衣裙的小女孩走过。前景是野花丛。受哈尔的移动城堡和魔女宅急便背景艺术启发。怀旧手绘品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 史诗龙骑士动漫
entries.description: 史诗龙骑士动漫大片，骑士与神龙翱翔于云层之上，壮阔天空与神话级别的视觉震撼。
entries.prompt: Create an epic dragon rider anime illustration. A heroic anime warrior riding a magnificent dragon soaring above dramatic cloud formations. The dragon has detailed scales and powerful wings spread wide. Blazing sunset or dramatic stormy sky background. Motion and speed implied by cloud streaks. Epic fantasy anime movie poster quality — inspired by Dragon Ball, Made in Abyss level of artistic detail. Cinematic widescreen 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张史诗龙骑士动漫插画。英雄动漫战士骑乘壮观神龙翱翔于戏剧性云层之上。神龙拥有细节满满的鳞片和大力展开的巨翼。背景是燃烧般落日或戏剧性风暴天空。云迹暗示运动与速度。史诗奇幻动漫电影海报品质——受七龙珠、来自深渊的艺术细节水准启发。电影感宽银幕 16:9。

entries.title: 日本夏日祭典夜晚
entries.description: 日本夏日祭典夜晚，红灯笼连成长廊，浴衣少女与烟火，美得令人想起许多个夏天。
entries.prompt: Create a vibrant Japanese summer festival (matsuri) night photograph. Row of red paper lanterns (chochin) lining a festival street, their warm light reflecting on wet cobblestones. Girl in colorful floral yukata in middle distance. Festival food stalls (yatai) with their warm lights. Possibly fireworks (hanabi) illuminating the sky. Bokeh lights from lanterns. Warm nostalgic film photography quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张生动的日本夏日祭（まつり）夜晚照片。红色纸灯笼（提灯）排成一排点亮祭典街道，温暖光芒映照在湿漉漉的石板路上。中景是身着彩色碎花浴衣的女孩。夜祭摊位（屋台）散发温暖灯光。天空中可能有烟花（花火）绽放。灯笼光斑虚化。温暖怀旧胶片摄影品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 樱花小巷
entries.description: 日本樱花小巷，粉色花瓣漫天飞舞，古老石板路通向诗意的远方，春天最美的邀请。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking cherry blossom alley photograph in Japan. A narrow stone-paved path flanked by ancient cherry trees in full bloom — thick overarching branches creating a pink floral tunnel. Fallen petals covering the ground and floating in the air. Soft spring morning light filtering through blossoms. Possibly a traditional gate or lantern in background. Film photography aesthetic with Kodak Portra colors. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张日本令人叹息的樱花小巷照片。狭窄石板路两侧是盛开的古老樱树，茂密的樱花枝条拱成粉色花隧道。凋落花瓣铺满地面并飘浮在空气中。柔和的春日晨光从花丛中过滤而下。背景可见传统门廊或灯笼。胶片摄影美学，Kodak Portra 色调。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 水下时装大片
entries.description: 水下时装摄影大片，飘动的面料与悬浮的秀发，折射光线营造梦幻深海时装秀。
entries.prompt: Create an editorial underwater fashion photography portrait of a model submerged in crystal clear water. Flowing silk fabric billowing around the body in slow-motion suspension. Hair floating weightlessly. Dramatic caustic light rays filtering down from surface. Saturated teal-blue water tones, contrasted against vibrant fashion. Bubbles and refraction adding surreal texture. High fashion editorial quality. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张模特沉浸在清澈水中的水下时装编辑摄影大片。丝绸面料在水中以慢动作悬浮飘动，秀发无重力漂浮。戏剧性的焦散光线从水面向下折射。饱和的蓝绿色水体与鲜艳的时装形成对比。气泡和折射光线增添超现实质感。高端时尚编辑摄影品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 机甲动漫海报艺术
entries.description: 水彩水墨混合机甲海报，全身机动战士立于战场废墟，史诗星云背景，日文排版印章装饰，高细节…
entries.prompt: Mecha anime poster in {argument name="style" default="watercolor and ink wash style"}, vertical layout, epic and dramatic. Center: Full-body {argument name="robot colors" default="white, blue, and red"} mobile suit robot with large pink-red energy wings, holding a long beam sword and rifle, standing on a battlefield with city ruins. Above it: Close-up of the robot's head with glowing green eyes, gold V-fin, and red shoulder armor marked {argument name="model code" default="X42S"}. Background: Space battle scene with multiple mobile suits, explosions, and a pink-purple nebula. Right side: Side profile of a young male anime character with dark hair. Bottom: Silhouettes of 4 people standing together. Design elements include emblem logo, Japanese vertical text, large title typography, barcode. Color palette: off-white background, red, pink, blue, gray, gold accents. Mix of traditional ink brush strokes and digital airbrush effects. High detail, cinematic lighting, dynamic composition, poster art style.
entries.promptZh: 机甲动漫海报，风格为【{argument name="style" default="水彩与水墨风格"}】，竖构图，史诗戏剧性。画面中心：全身【{argument name="robot colors" default="白、蓝、红配色"}】机动战士，背部带有巨大粉红色能量翼，手持光束剑和步枪，伫立在城市废墟战场上。上方：机器人头部特写，发光绿色眼睛、金色 V 型天线，肩甲印有【{argument name="model code" default="X42S"}】。背景：太空战场景，含多台机动战士、爆炸和粉紫色星云。右侧：深色头发的年轻男性动漫角色侧影。底部：4 人并肩站立剪影。设计元素包含徽章 Logo、日文竖排文字、大标题排版、条形码。调色板：米白底色，红、粉、蓝、灰、金色点缀。融合传统水墨笔触与数字喷枪效果。高细节，电影级光影，动态构图，海报艺术风格。

entries.title: 三维卡通角色
entries.description: 极致夸张比例的 3D CGI 卡通头像，超柔和哑光材质，饱和渐变背景强烈视觉对比，漫画…
entries.prompt: Extreme 3D CGI cartoon of {argument name="character" default="a chubby corgi puppy wearing a tiny golden crown"} extremely exaggerated proportions and oversized features for maximum comic effect. Head and shoulders portrait photo, incredibly styled with bold and dramatic expressions. Ultra soft matte materials. Character perspective. Saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange gradient"} background that creates a strong visual contrast. Soft lighting and ambient shadows for depth.
entries.promptZh: 极致的 3D CGI 卡通形象，【{argument name="character" default="[角色]"} 】具有极度夸张的比例和超大特征，以达到最佳漫画效果。头部和肩部肖像摄影，以大胆戏剧性的表情进行极具风格化的处理。超柔和的哑光材质。角色视角。饱和的【{argument name="background color" default="橙色渐变"}】背景，营造强烈视觉对比。柔和灯光和环境阴影增加深度感。

entries.title: 街头时尚海报
entries.description: 高角度俯视构图，街头潮流男模站在混凝土地面，强制透视剪刀手，35mm 胶片感，Z 世代…
entries.prompt: Ultra-realistic streetwear fashion campaign poster shot from a high-angle top-down perspective of a stylish young man standing on concrete pavement, reaching one hand toward the camera with a peace sign in forced perspective. He has textured curly mullet hair with a low taper fade, light mustache and beard stubble, sharp jawline, confident relaxed expression, and natural tan skin. Wearing an {argument name="shirt details" default="oversized faded charcoal gray Stüssy t-shirt"}, {argument name="pants details" default="loose blue jeans"}, {argument name="shoes" default="black-and-white Converse sneakers"}, including handwritten-style text, small paragraph blocks, logos, QR code, and fashion campaign aesthetic. Background should remain simple raw concrete texture. Vertical poster format, high-fashion editorial look, natural shadows, 35mm lens feel, photorealistic, trendy Gen Z street style.
entries.promptZh: 超写实的街头时尚宣传海报，采用高角度俯视视角拍摄，一位时尚的年轻男子站在混凝土路面上，一只手伸向镜头并比出剪刀手，形成强制透视效果。他留着质感卷曲的鲻鱼头，配有低渐变发型，留着淡淡的胡茬，下颌线分明，表情自信放松，肤色自然。身穿【{argument name="shirt details" default="宽松褪色炭灰色 Stüssy T 恤"}】，搭配【{argument name="pants details" default="宽松蓝色牛仔裤"}】和【{argument name="shoes" default="黑白配色 Converse 运动鞋"}】，画面包含手写风格文字、小段落文本、Logo、二维码以及时尚宣传大片的美学元素。背景保持简洁原始混凝土质感。竖版海报格式，顶级时尚编辑风格，自然阴影，35mm 镜头质感，照片级真实感，潮流 Z 世代街头风格。

entries.title: 柯达 Portra 杂志风人像
entries.description: Kodak Portra 400 胶片的招牌调色——奶白高光、提亮暗部、肤色精准还原、…
entries.prompt:
Create a fashion editorial portrait of a young East Asian woman with natural wavy hair shot on Kodak Portra 400 film. Location: golden hour rooftop with city skyline. The model is styled in relaxed chic.

Film characteristics: Portra 400's signature milky highlights with slight halation, lifted shadows revealing shadow detail, accurate warm skin tone reproduction, gentle grain structure visible at 100%. Greens are slightly desaturated shifting toward olive. Blues remain cool and crisp.

Lighting: available natural light as primary source, possibly supplemented with white reflector for fill. The light should feel effortless and unmanipulated. Lens: 85mm portrait equivalent, f/2 shallow depth of field, buttery background bokeh. Slightly underexposed ⅓ stop for richer tones.

Mood: sophisticated, unhurried, the photograph feels found rather than made. Slight organic imperfection—a small breath blur, the model mid-blink or mid-laugh. Magazine quality but with soul. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅在柯达Portra 400胶片上拍摄的【[主角]】时尚编辑人像。地点：【[场景：黄金时刻屋顶/自然窗光摄影棚/地中海街道]】。模特造型为【[风格：休闲优雅/编辑先锋]】。

胶片特性：Portra 400标志性的奶白高光带轻微光晕，提亮暗部展现细节，精准的暖肤色还原，100%放大时可见柔和颗粒结构。绿色略微去饱和向橄榄色偏移。蓝色保持冷峻清晰。

光效：可用自然光作为主光源，可能以白色反光板补光。光线应感觉毫不费力和未经处理。镜头：85mm等效焦段，f/2浅景深，黄油般的背景虚化。轻微欠曝⅓档以获得更丰富的色调。

氛围：精致、从容，照片感觉是被发现而非被制作。轻微有机不完美——轻微的呼吸模糊，模特半眨眼或大笑中。杂志品质但有灵魂。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 动漫立体弹出式名片
entries.description: 动漫角色从名片中破纸而出，半身立体于纸张之上——3D错视艺术与动漫角色设计的完美结合。
entries.prompt:
Create a trompe-l'oeil 3D pop-out business card featuring a cyberpunk hacker girl with neon blue hair and holographic glasses. The business card itself is realistically rendered—white card stock with clean typographic layout showing a name, title, and contact details. From the center of the card, an anime-style character bursts outward in full 3D relief, their upper body dramatically emerging above the flat card surface.

The character interacts with the card's physical plane—hands gripping the card's edge, foot braced against the bottom border, creating convincing depth. The emergence point shows the card torn or bent around the figure. Dramatic studio lighting with hard shadows falling on the card surface from the 3D figure.

Art style: high-quality anime illustration meets photorealistic card rendering. Background: clean gradient studio white. The card casting a crisp shadow on the surface below. Scale should feel dramatic—the character nearly as tall as the card is wide. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一张以【[动漫角色/人物]】为主角的3D弹出式视错觉名片。名片本身被真实渲染——白色卡纸，干净排版显示姓名、职位和联系方式。从名片中央，动漫风格角色在完整3D立体浮雕中向外爆发，上半身戏剧性地从平面卡片表面上方浮现。

角色与名片的物理平面互动——双手抓住名片边缘，脚撑在下边框上，制造令人信服的深度感。浮现处显示名片围绕人物撕裂或弯折。硬阴影戏剧性地从3D人物落在名片表面。

艺术风格：高质量动漫插画结合照片级真实名片渲染。背景：干净的渐变摄影棚白。名片在下方表面投下清晰阴影。比例应感觉戏剧性——角色高度接近名片宽度。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 暗黑奇幻剑姬
entries.description: 月光下身披暗黑盔甲的剑姬，电影级幻想插画。魔法能量在刀锋流淌，星辰碎片飞舞于裙裾之间。
entries.prompt:
Illustrate a dark fantasy swordswoman: a silver-haired warrior in black obsidian armor with glowing red eyes. She stands in a dramatic cinematic pose under a shattered full moon, midnight blue sky scattered with star fragments that spiral downward like snow. Her armor is dark midnight black with intricate silverwork engravings, her cape shredded at the edges and caught in a supernatural wind.

Her sword channels ethereal energy—pale blue-white magic flows along the blade in luminous threads, crackling at the tip. Her expression is fierce yet melancholic, hair loose and wild. One eye glows with arcane light.

Lighting: rim light from the fractured moon behind her, primary light from the magical sword, deep shadows on her face. Color palette: midnight blue, silver, pale arcane white, flashes of cold purple. Cinematic composition with extreme vertical format, strong figure silhouette against the moonlit sky. Epic illustration quality, detailed. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh:
绘制一位暗黑奇幻剑姬：【[角色描述]】。她在破碎满月下摆出戏剧性电影感姿态，午夜蓝色天空散布着星辰碎片如雪花般向下旋转。她的盔甲是深黑色，带有精细的银色雕刻纹路，披风边缘破损，被超自然之风扯动。

她的长剑传导以太能量——苍白蓝白色魔法沿刀刃以发光丝线流淌，在剑尖迸裂。表情凶猛而忧郁，头发散乱飞扬。一只眼睛散发奥术光芒。

光效：身后破碎月亮的边缘光，主光来自魔法长剑，脸部深邃阴影。色彩：午夜蓝、银色、苍白奥术白、冷紫色闪光。极竖版构图，强烈人物剪影映衬月光天空。史诗插画品质，细节丰富。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 奢华护肤品广告大片
entries.description: 高端护肤品广告的极致美学——黑暗背景、戏剧光影、液体飞溅与产品的完美邂逅。
entries.prompt:
Create a cinematic luxury skincare product advertisement for LUMIÈRE Sérum Éclat. Dark studio background fading to absolute black. The product—an elegant glass bottle or jar—sits as the primary hero, lit with dramatic single-source lighting that creates sharp specular highlights and deep, rich shadows.

Surround the product with a dynamic frozen-moment splash: translucent serum or water erupting upward, droplets suspended mid-air, catching the light as perfect spheres. Floating botanical elements—white orchid petals, gold leaf fragments, or fresh herb sprigs—orbit the scene at varying distances.

Texture emphasis: cold glass clarity, liquid surface tension, velvet matte packaging. Color palette: deep charcoal black, warm champagne gold, pure white light. One accent color from the brand (rose, jade, or midnight blue). Photorealistic commercial photography quality, 4K. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh:
为【[产品名称]】创作一幅电影级奢华护肤品广告。暗色摄影棚背景渐变至纯黑。产品——一个优雅的玻璃瓶或罐——作为主角，以戏剧性的单光源照明，产生锐利的高光和深沉丰富的阴影。

用动态凝固瞬间包围产品：半透明精华液或水向上迸发，水珠悬停在空中，捕捉光线如完美球体。飘浮的植物元素——白色兰花花瓣、金箔碎片或新鲜香草嫩芽——在不同距离环绕场景。

质感重点：冰冷玻璃的清澈感、液体表面张力、哑光天鹅绒包装。色彩：深炭灰黑、暖香槟金、纯白光。加入一个品牌强调色（玫瑰、翡翠绿或午夜蓝）。摄影级真实感商业大片，4K。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 极简侘寂风诗歌海报
entries.description: 日式侘寂美学——残缺之美、物哀之感、极简留白。一枝枯荷、一行诗句、足矣。
entries.prompt:
Design a wabi-sabi poetry poster for "In imperfection lies the perfect beauty of transience.". Embrace the Japanese philosophy of imperfection, impermanence, and incompleteness. The composition should breathe—vast negative space, a single withered branch or cracked pottery fragment occupying one corner, the poem set in elegant minimal typography.

Texture is essential: aged rice paper with visible fiber grain, subtle watercolor washes in diluted ink grey and pale ochre, brush stroke marks at the margins. Typography: refined vertical or diagonal placement, classical Chinese or Japanese typeface, small and unhurried. No decoration beyond what already exists in the texture.

Color range: off-white, warm grey, diluted sumi ink, one breath of pale moss green or stone blue. The mood is quiet, contemplative, slightly melancholic—like an ink painting left to dry in afternoon light. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
为【[诗句/引言]】设计一张侘寂风诗歌海报。拥抱日本美学中残缺、无常与未竟的哲学。构图需要呼吸——大片负空间，一枝枯枝或破损陶器残片占据一角，诗句以优雅极简的字体排布。

纹理至关重要：带有可见纤维纹理的老宣纸，淡墨灰和淡赭色的稀释水彩晕染，边缘有笔触痕迹。字体：精致的竖排或斜排，古典中文或日文字体，小而从容。除纹理本身的装饰外无其他装饰。

色彩范围：米白、暖灰、淡墨、一抹淡苔藓绿或石青。意境安静、沉思、略带忧郁——如同一幅水墨画在午后阳光中晾干。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 怀旧胶片拼贴摄影
entries.description: 70-80年代复古胶片美学，多张叠加的旧照片、手写文字、邮票和胶带，构成有故事感的拼贴…
entries.prompt:
Create a retro film collage photograph featuring a young woman wandering through 1970s Tokyo. Layer multiple vintage photographs of different sizes, angles, and ages—some faded, some over-exposed, some with light leaks and film grain. The main subject should emerge from this layered composition.

Intersperse physical ephemera: Polaroid frames, yellowed newspaper clippings, airmail envelopes, dried flowers pressed flat, vintage stamps, old ticket stubs, washi tape strips in muted earth tones. Add handwritten annotations in pencil and faded blue ink—dates, captions, fragments of poetry.

Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 warmth—milky highlights, lifted blacks, soft grain, desaturated greens pushing toward olive. Slight vignette at corners. The overall mood evokes memory, nostalgia, and the material weight of preserved moments. Aspect ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[主题]】为核心的复古胶片拼贴摄影作品。叠加多张不同尺寸、角度和年代的老照片——有些褪色、有些过曝、有些带有漏光和胶片颗粒。主体从这种层叠构图中浮现。

穿插实物纸制品：宝丽来相框、泛黄的报纸剪报、航空邮件信封、压平的干花、复古邮票、旧车票票根、和纸胶带（土地色调）。用铅笔和褪色蓝墨水添加手写注释——日期、说明文字、诗歌片段。

色彩调色：柯达Portra 400的温暖感——奶白高光、提亮的暗部、柔和颗粒、去饱和的绿色推向橄榄色。角落轻微暗角。整体氛围唤起记忆、怀旧和珍藏瞬间的物质重量。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 生物机械仿生融合
entries.description: 有机生命与精密机械的极致融合——血管化为电路，骨骼变成钛合金框架，生命与机器的边界在美…
entries.prompt:
Create a biomechanical fusion artwork featuring a lotus flower in full bloom. Organic forms merge seamlessly with mechanical components—veins become fiber-optic circuits, bones transform into polished titanium frameworks, petals unfurl as precision-engineered gears.

The fusion should feel inevitable rather than forced: biological textures (skin, membrane, wood grain) transition naturally into cold metal surfaces, circuit traces, and hydraulic joints. Ultra-detailed macro rendering with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting. The mechanical parts show real engineering logic—bearings, actuators, structural ribs—while the organic elements retain their natural beauty.

Background: deep black with subtle iridescent fog. Color palette: warm gold and rose gold for organic parts, cool gunmetal and chrome for mechanical. Add micro-details like oil droplets on metal, bioluminescent veins, and hairline weld seams. Photorealistic quality, cinematic depth of field. Square 1:1.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[主题]】为核心的生物机械融合艺术作品。有机形态与机械组件无缝融合——血管化为光纤电路，骨骼变成抛光钛合金框架，花瓣展开如精密工程齿轮。

融合感觉是必然的而非强迫的：生物纹理（皮肤、薄膜、木纹）自然过渡为冷峻金属表面、电路痕迹和液压关节。超精细微观渲染，戏剧性的明暗对比。机械零件展示真实的工程逻辑——轴承、执行器、结构肋——而有机元素保留其自然之美。

背景：深黑色配微妙的彩虹迷雾。色彩：有机部分用暖金和玫瑰金，机械部分用冷钢铁色和铬合金色。加入微观细节如金属上的油滴、生物发光纹脉和焊接痕迹。照片级真实感，电影级景深。正方形 1:1。

entries.title: 中国水墨动画海报
entries.description: 东方水墨动画气质的视觉海报，宣纸纹理与大量留白，毛笔书法标题自然生长于画面之中。
entries.prompt:
Design a visual poster with an Oriental ink animation temperament for a lone crane in flight. The overall principle: heavy ink for structure, light color for atmosphere, negative space for narrative, and edges for breathing. Background: warm rice paper texture with natural off-white and light blue-grey smudging, showing paper grain, water marks, and ink diffusion.

Core text layout is not fixed but responds intelligently to the subject's movement, gaze, and negative space—titles can appear left, right, top, bottom, or diagonally, growing naturally as part of the image rather than added in post-production.

The main title is a heavy ink visual anchor in handwritten calligraphy with thick, moist, irregular strokes including dry-brush effects and smudged edges—like children's picture books and Chinese ink animation titles. Keep moderate negative space in the center. Add theme-appropriate edge elements such as bamboo leaves. Colors appear mainly at edges and corners; center remains restrained and clean.

Overall temperament: poetic, childlike, Oriental warmth, hand-drawn. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh:
设计一张具有东方水墨动画气质的视觉海报，主题为【[主题]】。整体逻辑是"浓墨构形、淡彩营造氛围、留白叙事、边缘呼吸"。背景采用温暖的宣纸纹理，带有自然晕染的米白色、浅蓝灰色和淡水彩的效果，呈现出细微的纸张纹理、水痕和墨迹扩散。

核心文字不固定位置，而是根据主体动势、视线和负空间进行智能排布。标题可以出现在任何位置——左、右、上、下或对角线——如同画面的一部分自然生长，而非后期排版。

主标题作为浓墨视觉锚点，引导视线。字体采用手写毛笔书法，笔触厚重、湿润、原始而不规则，包含枯笔效果和晕染边缘，具有儿童绘本和中国水墨动画标题的手工感。在中心保持适度的负空间，让角色或物体轻盈地置于画面空气之上。根据主题添加边缘元素，如【[边缘元素：竹枝、水花、梅花]】。色彩主要出现在边缘和角落，保持中心克制与整洁。整体气韵诗意、童趣、东方温情、手绘质感。比例 9:16。

entries.prompt: Nostalgic travel poster celebrating Kunming, a wide-angle photograph of a quiet tree-lined street canopied by blooming purple jacaranda trees, soft petals drifting through the air and scattered on the pavement below, warm afternoon sunlight filtering through the purple blossoms. Around the edges of the composition, several smaller inset travel photographs arranged collage-style: a close-up of purple jacaranda blossom clusters against a blue sky, a traditional Chinese stone archway monument framed by flowering branches, a distant lake with hills at sunset, a small vintage postmark stamp graphic. Top of the poster: large elegant Chinese calligraphy brush characters "昆明" with English "Kunming" in elegant script beneath, small vertical Chinese and English text about flowers blooming everywhere in the spring city. Left side: a vintage kraft-paper travel tag design showing "目的地 DESTINATION" "昆明 KUNMING" a date, and "春城记忆 SPRING CITY MEMORY" text, with a circular rubber stamp design reading "KUNMING SPRING CITY" with a flower icon. Bottom: small Chinese and English text about time becoming gentle in Kunming, with a small camera icon doodle. Warm nostalgic purple, cream, and dusty pink color grading throughout, layered scrapbook travel journal aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

entries.prompt: Cheerful cartoon sticker pack illustration, a 3×4 grid of twelve individual stickers all featuring the same recurring character: a middle-aged Japanese woman with a permed curly brown updo hairstyle, round glasses (in some panels), wearing a leopard-print cardigan and colorful floral outfits, exaggerated comedic facial expressions and body language in each panel matching a different everyday emotion or situation. Each sticker shows the character in a distinct pose: giving an enthusiastic thumbs up, panicking dramatically over a boiling pot on the stove, cheering with a fist pump, doing a confident thumbs up while holding a notebook, waving cheerfully while shopping, jogging energetically in a tracksuit, sitting exhausted looking sad, fanning herself dramatically looking overheated, gesturing gracefully with a flowing motion, sipping tea contentedly from a teapot, pointing firmly at a moving box, clasping hands together with a delighted sparkly expression. Each sticker has a large bold colorful Japanese text word or phrase in a speech-bubble-adjacent comic font positioned above or beside the character matching her expression (like "well done", "oh no", "here we go", "nice", "next", "one more round", "it's over", "too hot", "good flow", "reset", "put it there", "wonderful"), each text outlined with a thick white border for sticker readability. Clean white background behind each character, vibrant flat cartoon coloring, thick black outline character design, LINE messaging app sticker pack aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

entries.prompt: Adorable pastel pink horoscope daily forecast infographic card, decorative watercolor pink roses and vine border running along all four edges of the composition with small sparkle accents. Top: bold black Chinese title text reading "Scorpio Daily Horoscope" with a scorpio zodiac symbol icon, small sparkle icons on either side. Below: two small text boxes side by side showing "Lucky Number: 0" and "Lucky Color: Rose Pink" (rose pink swatch highlighted). Center: a 2×2 grid of four circular illustrated icon scenes, each with a Chinese label above it and a short descriptive Chinese phrase below: top-left circle shows a cute illustrated girl sitting on a crescent moon over water labeled "Overall Fortune" with text about emotional fluctuation and staying calm; top-right circle shows a broken heart illustration between a cartoon man and woman arguing labeled "Love Fortune" with text about avoiding conflict and more tolerance; bottom-left circle shows a person sitting at a desk working by a window with books and a plant labeled "Career Fortune" with text about focusing on oneself and steady progress; bottom-right circle shows a glass jar filled with coins and cash with small money bags and a growing plant labeled "Wealth Fortune" with text about rational spending and gradual saving. Bottom: two small icon rows showing a compass labeled with a lucky direction and a clock labeled with a lucky time, plus a lucky compatible zodiac sign label. Very bottom: a centered gentle closing Chinese blessing phrase. Soft pastel pink and cream color palette, cute hand-drawn illustration style, warm healing social media graphic aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

entries.prompt: Casual hand-drawn fashion sketch illustration on a lined notebook paper background with visible faint horizontal ruled lines and a red margin line down the left side. A confident young man with short styled dark hair and a neat beard walks forward in three-quarter view, rendered in loose expressive pencil and pen sketch linework with cross-hatch shading, wearing a burnt orange shearling-collar bomber jacket over a beige ribbed turtleneck knit sweater, black skinny jeans, tan suede Chelsea boots, a gold wristwatch, one hand in pocket. Bold handwritten-style black marker title "OOTD" underlined at the top with small motion scribble marks. Scattered handwritten annotation labels with arrows pointing to each garment: "Burnt Orange Shearling Jacket" pointing to the jacket with a small scribble icon, "Beige Turtleneck Knit" pointing to the sweater with a small clothing icon sketch, "Black Skinny Jeans" pointing to the pants, "Tan Suede Chelsea Boots" pointing to the boots with a small boot icon sketch, "Gold Watch" pointing to the wrist with a small watch icon sketch, plus mood/style keyword annotations "DESERT VIBES" and "LAYERS" with small scribble underlines scattered around the figure. entries.prompt: Creative OOTD fashion photograph with a photo-within-photo concept. A round wooden outdoor cafe table with scattered golden autumn maple leaves and a ceramic cup of coffee on a saucer, set on a Parisian sidewalk with a blurred cafe storefront and street visible in the background. Resting on the table is a large polaroid-style instant photograph with a white border, and within that polaroid photograph, a three-dimensional effect makes it appear as if a young woman is physically emerging out of the photograph into the real world: her head, torso, and upper body extend above the polaroid's surface in full photorealistic 3D form, wearing a beige ribbed turtleneck sweater and matching beige mini skirt, while her legs in tall brown leather knee-high boots remain flat within the 2D polaroid image below, creating a playful dimensional break effect. She leans forward with a playful pouty expression, one hand reaching toward the camera. White handwritten-style annotation text with thin arrows point to her boots labeled "leather boots", her skirt labeled "mini skirt", and her sweater labeled "clean turtleneck". Small text at the bottom of the polaroid reads "OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS". Warm autumn afternoon lighting, realistic street photography aesthetic merged with creative dimensional photo-manipulation, 4:5 vertical

entries.prompt: Nostalgic documentary-style photograph of a rural Chinese elementary school courtyard from the 1980s-1990s era. A long red-brick single-story school building with a grey tiled roof and multiple wood-framed windows, faded red painted Chinese slogan characters on the brick wall reading an encouraging educational phrase, a small blackboard mounted outside one classroom door showing simple handwritten arithmetic. A weathered basketball hoop with a worn wooden backboard and a metal rim with an old net stands in the dirt courtyard, a loudspeaker mounted on a wooden pole nearby. Several children in matching worn blue denim-style school uniforms with canvas satchel bags play and walk around the dusty courtyard in various small groups, some sitting on a low wall, some walking with backpacks, captured in candid unposed documentary moments. Bare young trees with sparse leaves planted in a row, tall trees with green foliage in the background. Warm hazy golden-hour sunlight, soft warm color grading with slight film grain texture reminiscent of vintage Kodak film photography, nostalgic collective memory mood, authentic 1990s Chinese rural school aesthetic, 9:16 vertical

entries.prompt: Cinematic historical educational infographic poster, a photorealistic oil-painting-style scene of three ancient Greek philosophers seated together in discussion on stone steps within an ancient Athenian agora, warm golden hour sunlight, the Acropolis and Parthenon visible on a hill in the blurred background along with a bustling ancient marketplace crowd. The philosophers: an elderly bearded man in simple white robes gesturing while speaking (Socrates), a middle-aged man in a red-trimmed robe listening thoughtfully (Plato), and a younger bearded man in a brown robe with hands clasped (Aristotle), ancient scrolls resting nearby. Left side of the composition: three stacked text blocks in bold Chinese characters naming each philosopher followed by their core philosophical concepts (questioning method and self-knowledge for Socrates, ideas and the academy and philosopher-king for Plato, logic and classification and empirical observation for Aristotle). Upper right: a winding dotted timeline path curving through the image connecting small circular waypoint markers, each labeled with a historical era in Chinese and date range, progressing from ancient Greek thought through Alexandria, Rome, medieval universities, the Renaissance, the Enlightenment, up to modern science, with an arrow at the top pointing to text about the origin of world civilization history. Small decorative compass and geometric diagram motifs in the corners. Ancient Greek text fragments visible faintly in the upper background like aged manuscript writing. Bottom left corner: a small stack of rolled scrolls with a short poetic Chinese caption about the spark of ideas being lit in Athens illuminating the path of human civilization. Warm sepia and gold cinematic color grading, museum documentary quality, 2:3 vertical
entries.promptZh: 电影感的历史教育信息图海报，写实油画质感场景，三位古希腊哲学家坐在雅典古代集市的石阶上交谈，温暖的黄金时刻阳光，背景虚化处可见卫城和帕特农神庙矗立山丘，以及熙攘的古代集市人群。哲学家们：一位年长的蓄须男子身穿简朴白袍边说边打手势（苏格拉底），一位中年男子身穿红边长袍若有所思地倾听（柏拉图），一位较年轻的蓄须男子身穿棕色长袍双手交叠（亚里士多德），附近放着古代卷轴。构图左侧：三段堆叠的粗体中文文字块，分别命名每位哲学家并列出其核心哲学理念（苏格拉底的提问、诘问法、认识你自己；柏拉图的理念、学园、哲人王；亚里士多德的逻辑、分类、经验观察）。右上角：一条蜿蜒的虚线时间轴路径穿过图像连接小圆形路标标记，每个标注中文历史时代和年代范围，从古希腊思想经亚历山大城、罗马、中世纪大学、文艺复兴、启蒙时代，直至现代科学，顶部有箭头指向关于世界文明史源头的文字。角落有小号装饰性罗盘和几何图案元素。背景上方隐约可见古希腊文字片段，仿佛古老手稿书写。左下角：一小摞卷起的卷轴，配一句诗意的中文小字讲述思想的火种在雅典点燃，照亮了人类文明前行的道路。温暖的棕褐色与金色电影级调色，博物馆纪录片品质，2:3竖版

entries.title: 苹果品牌人格漫画信息图

entries.prompt: Bold branding strategy comic infographic poster, orange-and-black color scheme throughout. Top: large orange Apple logo icon and bold orange "Apple" wordmark, with bold black Chinese headline text asking what this brand feels like, an orange highlighted subtitle about quiet confidence and sharp boundaries. Center: a large realistic illustrated portrait of an older man resembling a tech visionary with round glasses, grey stubble beard, black turtleneck sweater, holding an orange smartphone in one hand and a black smartphone in the other, confident direct gaze, bold black banner text beneath him reading "I am Apple" with Chinese subtitle about the product not being the point but the experience being the point. Surrounding the central portrait: eight numbered comic-style panels arranged around the edges, each showing a small illustrated scene of the man in a different scenario (talking with a customer, facing a competitor, selling a product, social media presence, facing criticism, daily brand life, a product launch moment, interacting with the world), each panel labeled with a bold numbered Chinese title and containing small speech bubbles with brand-voice Chinese dialogue, small like and comment count icons on the social media panel. Bottom section: a "DO" and "DON'T" two-column checklist with small icon badges and Chinese labels for brand behaviors to embrace and avoid, plus a small personality trait radar chart graphic with Chinese labels, a row of small color swatch circles showing the brand's orange-black-cream color palette, and a closing quote attributed to Steve Jobs. Clean modern infographic poster design with comic panel illustration style, 2:3 vertical

Panel 1: an excited young man with spiky black hair pumps his fist while pulling a rolling suitcase, airplane and bullet train illustrated behind him, speech bubble showing excitement about capturing the best vacation. Panel 2: a cheerful girl with twin ponytails points excitedly at a tourist map, Kyoto train station sign and cherry blossoms and a pagoda visible behind her, speech bubble about having too many places to visit. Panel 3: a rugged man with a bandana eating takoyaki skewers with intense manga-style sparkling eyes at a festival with lanterns, ferris wheel and fireworks in the background, speech bubble about delicious fun. Panel 4: an adventurer in a hat looks out at Mount Fuji and a lake with a tent and lantern nearby, speech bubble about being refreshed by nature. Panel 5: the whole group of four friends cheering together with fists raised, bold red banner text about making the best memories and enjoying Golden Week to the fullest with all their energy. A rocket ship blasts off from a small launch pad at the bottom of the bulb, bright orange-white flame and exhaust thrust visible beneath it, with a massive billowing white and tan smoke cloud filling most of the upper interior of the bulb shaped naturally like a mushroom cloud, a small launch tower structure visible to the side within the glass. The glass bulb surface has a subtle realistic reflective sheen. Clean soft beige-grey seamless studio background, soft even studio lighting with subtle shadow beneath the bulb, extremely high production value 3D render or photo-composite, symbolic concept photography about ideas and innovation breakthrough, minimalist advertising aesthetic, 9:16 vertical

Top of the cover: brand banner text "BLACKAIR GLOBAL PROJECT" and a small logo badge, large bold chrome metallic 3D text "POP STAR" as the main magazine title with "vol.1" label, small text "fashion street culture" beneath it. Scattered around the composition: several rounded speech bubble UI elements containing Korean and Japanese pop phrases in white and pink text, small star icon badges in the corners, a large bold pink Korean word and large bold blue Japanese characters positioned dynamically on the right side, a small heart-shaped badge with a Korean word, a barcode graphic in the bottom left corner with small product number text. entries.title: 北京王府井街景线描插画

entries.prompt: Highly detailed black-and-white pen line-art illustration of a bustling Beijing Wangfujing shopping street, drawn in a vintage architectural sketch style on cream-white background. Large bold sans-serif title "BEIJING" at the top with a thin decorative divider line beneath it. The street scene shows tall buildings with traditional Chinese eave details mixed with modern glass storefronts on both sides, densely packed with pedestrians walking in various directions, a delivery rider on an electric scooter, bicycles, street lamp posts. Numerous small shop signs with both Chinese and English text are illustrated throughout: a tea shop, a bookstore, a jewelry store "CHOW TAI FOOK", a photo studio, a large mall sign, a subway station entrance with line number and "SUBWAY" text, directional street signs pointing to nearby landmarks and streets, a "LOCAL SNACKS" food stall, a 24-hour newsstand kiosk. A traditional Chinese bell tower silhouette visible in the far background between buildings. Crosswalk markings and traffic signal visible in the foreground. Bottom of the poster: centered text "WANGFUJING" with smaller text "BEIJING · 王府井" beneath a thin divider line. Extremely fine detailed linework, architectural illustration meets travel poster design, monochrome ink pen aesthetic, 1:2 tall vertical
entries.promptZh: 极其精细的黑白钢笔线描插画，描绘熙熙攘攘的北京王府井商业街，米白色背景上以复古建筑速写风格绘制。顶部是大号无衬线粗体标题"BEIJING"，下方配一条细装饰分隔线。街景展示两侧高楼，传统中式檐口细节与现代玻璃橱窗混搭，密集的行人朝各个方向行走，一位骑电动车的外卖骑手，自行车，路灯柱。画面各处绘有众多中英双语小招牌：茶馆、书店、周大福珠宝店、照相馆、大型商场招牌、带线路编号和"SUBWAY"字样的地铁站入口、指向附近地标和街道的方向路牌、"北京小吃"食品摊位、24小时报刊亭。远景楼宇之间隐约可见传统中式钟楼剪影。前景可见人行横道标线和交通信号灯。海报底部：居中文字"WANGFUJING"，下方细分隔线后配小字"BEIJING · 王府井"。极其精细的线条细节，建筑插画与旅行海报设计的融合，单色钢笔画美学，1:2瘦长竖版

entries.title: 温度计纪念日科普信息图

entries.prompt: Clean educational infographic poster, a young woman with short black bob hairstyle stands holding a digital thermometer near her mouth with a slightly puzzled expression, wearing a blue-to-red gradient t-shirt with bold Japanese text printed on it about a thermometer commemorative day and a date, a small thermometer icon graphic and degree symbol in the upper area. Top of poster: large bold Japanese headline text about "May 14th is Thermometer Day" with a smaller subtitle below about temperature being the measure supporting daily life, plus a body paragraph explaining the historical origin of the mercury thermometer invention. Left side: a red thermometer icon illustration and a blue globe icon and a flask icon. Below the main image: three side-by-side rounded rectangle panels each with a small line icon (heart for health management, cooking pot for cooking life, flask for research industry) and Japanese caption text and a small photograph (a person's hand holding a thermometer near a towel, a cooking thermometer in a pot, laboratory glassware with a thermometer). Bottom: a Japanese paragraph about understanding temperature protecting the future, with a small green sprout icon, and a final highlighted call-to-action line of Japanese text. Clean white background, soft blue and coral accent colors, modern Japanese web infographic design style, 9:16 vertical
entries.promptZh: 简洁的科普信息图海报，一位留黑色短鲍勃头的年轻女性手持数字体温计靠近嘴边，表情略带疑惑，穿着蓝到红渐变色T恤，印有关于温度计纪念日和日期的日文大字，上方区域有小号温度计图标和度数符号。海报顶部：大号日文标题讲述"5月14日是温度计之日"，下方小号副标题讲述温度是支撑生活的标尺，配一段解释水银温度计发明历史起源的正文段落。左侧：红色温度计图标插画、蓝色地球图标和烧瓶图标。主图下方：三个并排的圆角矩形面板，每个配一个小号线条图标（爱心代表健康管理、锅具代表料理生活、烧瓶代表研究产业）和日文说明文字及一张小照片（手持体温计靠近毛巾、锅中的料理温度计、实验室玻璃器皿配温度计）。底部：一段关于了解温度守护未来的日文段落，配一个绿色嫩芽图标，最后一行高亮的日文行动号召文字。干净的白色背景，柔和的蓝色与珊瑚色点缀，现代日系网页信息图设计风格，9:16竖版

A young schoolgirl with long dark hair crouches down on worn stone steps, wearing a classic navy-and-white sailor school uniform with pleated navy skirt, white knee socks, black loafers, gently reaching out to pet an orange-and-white tabby cat sitting on the steps looking up at her affectionately, both figures rendered with soft warm rim lighting. Background: weathered stone steps leading upward, a stone wall covered in climbing pink rose bushes on the left, a small wooden planter box with more roses, a small stone signpost on the right reading Japanese characters for a neighborhood name. Warm golden hour sunlight streaming in from the side creating long soft shadows and a dreamy glow, shallow depth of field with soft bokeh in the background, dust particles visible in the light. Ultra-detailed miniature figure photography aesthetic blending anime character design with photorealistic diorama craftsmanship, nostalgic Japanese slice-of-life mood, 3:4 vertical
entries.promptZh: 迷人的移轴微缩场景摄影，呈现动漫写实人偶质感。一位长发少女蹲在斑驳的石阶上，穿着经典藏青白色水手服校服，打褶藏青短裙，白色及膝袜，黑色乐福鞋，温柔地伸手抚摸坐在台阶上仰头深情望着她的橘白相间狸花猫，两者都笼罩着柔和的暖色轮廓光。背景：向上延伸的风化石阶，左侧石墙爬满粉色蔷薇花丛，一个木质花箱种着更多玫瑰，右侧一个小石制路牌用日文写着地名。温暖的黄金时刻阳光从侧面洒入，形成柔长的阴影和梦幻光晕，浅景深背景柔和散景，光线中可见浮尘颗粒。超精细微缩人偶摄影美学，融合动漫角色设计与照片级微缩模型工艺，怀旧的日系日常治愈氛围，3:4竖版

entries.title: 月季植物结构解剖图谱
entries.description: 古典科学插画风格，中央绘制完整月季植株，周围分区展示根、茎、叶、花、果实的显微解剖细节…
entries.prompt: Vintage scientific botanical illustration poster on aged cream parchment paper background with subtle compass rose decoration in the corner. Center: a complete, beautifully detailed rose plant illustration (Rosa chinensis) rendered in delicate watercolor and ink, showing the full stem with thorns, compound leaves, one fully bloomed pink rose flower, one rosebud, and root system extending below the soil line. Top-left section labeled "root structure": detailed cross-section illustrations of root anatomy including root cap, root hair zone, cross-section rings. Below it labeled "stem structure": stem cross-section showing epidermis, cortex, phloem, xylem layers in ring pattern, plus a vascular bundle magnified inset. Top-right section labeled "leaf structure breakdown": individual leaf illustration with venation pattern, plus a magnified cross-section block diagram showing leaf tissue layers (cuticle, epidermis, palisade mesophyll, spongy mesophyll, veins, stomata), and a circular magnified leaf surface and stomata closeup. Bottom-center labeled "flower internal structure": a cutaway cross-section of the rose flower showing petals, sepals, stamens, pistil, receptacle in anatomical detail. Bottom-right labeled "fruit and seed structure": a rose hip fruit shown whole and cut open revealing seeds, plus a magnified seed cross-section. Small Chinese text labels with fine leader lines point to every anatomical part throughout the diagram, a decorative quote in small italic text and small hand-sketched notes in the corners. Aged paper texture, elegant vintage scientific illustration aesthetic combining botanical art with educational diagram design, 1:1 square
entries.promptZh: 复古科学植物插画海报，米黄色做旧羊皮纸背景，角落有精致罗盘装饰。中央：一株完整精美的月季植株插画（蔷薇科植物），细腻的水彩加钢笔画法，展示带刺的完整茎干、复叶、一朵盛开的粉色月季花、一个花苞，以及延伸至土层下方的根系。左上版块标注"根系结构"：详细的根部解剖截面图，包括根冠、根毛区、横截面年轮。其下方标注"茎的结构"：茎横截面展示表皮、皮层、韧皮部、木质部的环状层次，配放大的维管束插图。右上版块标注"叶片结构分解"：单片叶子插画配叶脉纹理，加放大的横截面区块图展示叶片组织层次（角质层、表皮、栅栏组织、海绵组织、叶脉、气孔），配圆形放大的叶表皮和气孔特写。底部中央标注"花的内部结构"：月季花的剖面解剖图，详细展示花瓣、花萼、雄蕊、雌蕊、花托。右下标注"果实与种子结构"：完整的蔷薇果实和剖开露出种子的果实，配放大的种子横截面。图谱各处都有细线指示的小号中文标签指向每个解剖部位，角落有优雅斜体小字引言和手绘笔记。做旧纸张质感，融合植物艺术与教育图解设计的典雅复古科学插画美学，1:1正方形

entries.title: 纸雕树下读书女孩

entries.prompt: Minimalist layered papercut art photograph, extreme close-up macro shot. A large stylized tree canopy made of soft sage-green paper-cut clouds fills the upper portion, with a warm blush-pink circular paper sun/moon shape nestled beneath it. Inside the pink circle, a small white silhouette figure of a woman sits cross-legged, absorbed in reading an open book, with a few small paper cutout shapes floating away from the book like scattered pages or butterflies. Below and around, layered rows of soft pink and sage-green cloud-like paper shapes cascade downward creating a gentle wave pattern, each paper layer showing visible soft paper fiber texture and subtle drop shadows between layers indicating physical depth. Cream white paper background. Extremely tactile, soft, three-dimensional papercraft photography, soothing pastel color palette, minimalist wall art aesthetic, 3:2 horizontal
entries.promptZh: 极简分层纸雕艺术摄影，超近距离微距镜头。上方大片区域是柔和鼠尾草绿纸雕云朵造型的风格化树冠，下方嵌着一个温暖粉色的圆形纸雕太阳/月亮造型。粉色圆圈内，一个白色剪影小人物盘腿而坐，专注地读着摊开的书，书本旁几个小纸片形状像飘散的书页或蝴蝶一样飞离。下方和周围，层叠的柔粉色和鼠尾草绿云朵状纸雕层层叠叠向下延展形成柔和波浪图案，每层纸张都可见柔软的纸纤维质感和层间细腻投影表现出真实的立体深度。奶白色纸质背景。极具触感的柔和立体纸艺摄影，舒缓的马卡龙色调，极简墙面艺术装饰美学，3:2横版

entries.prompt: Enchanting fantasy miniature diorama photograph of an old open book resting on a rustic wooden table inside a forest tent at dusk. The left page shows real living moss, tiny white wildflowers, and delicate ferns physically growing up out of the paper, with a small glass jar containing a tiny salamander figure sitting on the page, hand-drawn botanical sketches and handwritten notes visible on the paper beneath the greenery. entries.promptZh: 创作1960年代摩登时尚编辑摄影。模特穿着几何印花迷你裙、Mary Jane鞋、白色膝上靴。大胆图形妆容：淡唇、浓眼线、假睫毛。极简工作室或波普艺术背景。Twiggy和Jean Shrimpton时代美学。胶片摄影品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 文化机构品牌设计
entries.description: 博物馆或文化机构品牌视觉系统，兼顾传统权威与当代设计语言，文化机构的形象再造。
entries.prompt: Create a cultural institution brand identity for the Museum of Contemporary Digital Art. Distinctive but authoritative logotype. Applied to: museum guide, signage, tote bag, exhibition poster. Balancing heritage with contemporary design language. Generous white space. Louvre, Tate, or Smithsonian rebranding quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[博物馆/机构]】创作文化机构品牌形象。独特而权威的字标设计。应用于：博物馆指南、标识系统、手提袋、展览海报。平衡传统权威与当代设计语言。充足留白。卢浮宫、泰特或史密森尼博物馆重塑品牌品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 手工食品品牌形象
entries.description: 手工食品品牌视觉形象，复古插画风格与温暖色调，传递小批量精品食品的手工情怀。
entries.prompt: Create an artisan food brand identity for OLIVA — premium cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil. Vintage-inspired label design with hand-drawn botanical or food illustration. Applied to jar, tin, or paper bag packaging. Warm earthy colors. Custom script lettering for brand name. Mast Brothers chocolate or Graza olive oil brand aesthetic. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[产品/品牌]】创作手工食品品牌形象。带有手绘植物或食品插画的复古标签设计。应用于罐头、锡罐或纸袋包装。温暖大地色。品牌名称定制手写字体。Mast Brothers巧克力或Graza橄榄油品牌美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 科技产品发布视觉
entries.description: 科技产品发布会视觉设计，极简背景上的产品英雄图与功能点阵，苹果发布会级别的视觉表达。
entries.prompt: Create a tech product launch visual for a next-generation foldable smartphone. Hero product floating on pure black or gradient background. Clean sans-serif feature callouts. Subtle light reflection on product surface. One key tagline in large type. Apple WWDC or Samsung Unpacked event visual quality. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[产品]】创作科技产品发布视觉。主打产品漂浮于纯黑或渐变背景上。干净无衬线字体功能标注。产品表面微妙光线反射。大字号单行核心标语。苹果WWDC或三星Unpacked发布会视觉品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 公益社会活动视觉
entries.description: 非营利公益活动视觉设计，真实而有力量的影像与简洁的行动呼吁，让善意传播更远。
entries.prompt: Create a powerful NGO social impact campaign visual for ocean plastic cleanup and marine ecosystem restoration. Authentic documentary-style photography showing real human impact. Bold typographic call-to-action. Simple color palette emphasizing urgency and hope. The image should inspire action. WWF, UNICEF, or Amnesty International visual approach. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[公益事业]】创作有力量的公益组织社会影响活动视觉。展示真实人类影响的真实纪录式摄影。大胆字体行动号召。强调紧迫感与希望的简洁色板。图像应激励行动。WWF、联合国儿童基金会或国际特赦组织的视觉方式。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 企业年报设计
entries.description: 企业年度报告视觉设计，数据可视化与精准排版融合，传递企业形象的高级出版物美学。
entries.prompt: Create a premium corporate annual report design for a global AI and sustainability technology company. Cover with bold typographic statement and brand color. Interior spread showing data visualization as art — charts and graphs beautifully designed. Photography integrated into layout. Clean grid system. McKinsey, Apple, or Patagonia report aesthetic. 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[公司]】创作高端企业年度报告设计。封面以大胆字体声明和品牌色彩呈现。内页展示数据可视化作为艺术——精美设计的图表与图形。摄影融入版式。干净网格系统。麦肯锡、苹果或巴塔哥尼亚报告美学。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 美妆品牌视觉活动
entries.description: 高端美妆品牌视觉活动，产品与美人交织的完美演绎，传递品牌美学主张与情感价值。
entries.prompt: Create a high-end cosmetics brand campaign visual for Charlotte Tilbury Pillow Talk lip collection. Hero product integrated with beautiful model portrait. Soft studio lighting with skin-flattering quality. Brand color palette woven throughout. Product floating or held elegantly. Chanel Beauty, NARS, or Charlotte Tilbury campaign quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端美妆品牌视觉活动。主打产品与美丽模特人像融合。柔和工作室灯光，令肌肤更美。品牌色板贯穿始终。产品优雅漂浮或握持。香奈儿美妆、NARS或夏洛特·蒂尔伯里广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 街头服饰品牌视觉
entries.description: 街头服饰品牌视觉活动，真实街拍感与大胆字体叠加，传递青年文化的力量与态度。
entries.prompt: Create a streetwear brand campaign visual for PALACE SKATEBOARDS. Urban photography with model wearing key pieces. Bold brand typography overlay. Gritty city backdrop — concrete, graffiti wall, basketball court. Raw authentic energy. Supreme, Off-White, or Stüssy campaign DNA. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作街头服饰品牌视觉活动。模特穿着主打单品的城市摄影。大胆品牌字体叠加。粗粝城市背景——混凝土、涂鸦墙、篮球场。原始真实能量。Supreme、Off-White或Stüssy广告基因。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 播客品牌视觉形象
entries.description: 播客品牌视觉体系，从封面到社交媒体模板的完整设计，让声音节目在视觉上同样抢眼。
entries.prompt: Create a podcast brand visual identity for DEEP FOCUS — a podcast about flow states and creativity. Album artwork for the podcast cover — bold typography, distinctive illustration or photography. Applied to: Spotify player mockup, social media story template, website header. Audio waveform design element. Modern digital media aesthetic. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[播客名称/主题]】创作播客品牌视觉形象。播客封面图——大胆字体、独特插画或摄影。应用于：Spotify播放器样机、社交媒体故事模板、网站标题。音频波形设计元素。现代数字媒体美学。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 精品葡萄酒标签设计
entries.description: 精品葡萄酒标签设计，极简或插画风格的酒标定义产品个性，在货架上一眼被记住。
entries.prompt: Create a fine wine label design for Domaine Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet 2022. Elegant label design — either refined minimal or beautifully illustrated. Applied to real wine bottle photography. Premium paper texture visible. The label tells a story of terroir and craft. Applied to dark green glass bottle. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[酒庄/酒名]】创作精品葡萄酒标签设计。优雅的标签设计——极致简约或精美插画风格。应用于真实酒瓶摄影。高端纸质感可见。标签讲述风土与工艺的故事。应用于深绿色玻璃瓶上。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 时尚品牌造型手册
entries.description: 时尚品牌季度造型手册，视觉一致的系列摄影与排版，定义品牌美学语言的核心出版物。
entries.prompt: Create a fashion brand lookbook spread for COS — Autumn/Winter 2025 Collection. Editorial photography integrated with clean typographic layout. Model in key look from collection. Brand name subtly placed. Consistent color grade throughout. Campaign quality photography with editorial design. COS, Acne Studios or Toteme aesthetic. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌/季节]】创作时尚品牌造型手册跨页。编辑摄影融入干净排版设计。模特穿着系列主打造型。品牌名称低调放置。整体一致色调。广告级摄影搭配编辑设计。COS、Acne Studios或Toteme美学。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 奢华酒店品牌形象
entries.description: 奢华酒店品牌视觉形象，从门牌到信头纸的完整品牌应用，传递顶级酒店的尊贵气质。
entries.prompt: Create a luxury hotel brand identity showcase for THE OBSIDIAN — a luxury mountain retreat. Refined logotype with custom letterform. Applied to: key card, welcome letter, pillow chocolate wrapper, room number plate, tote bag. Elegant minimal aesthetic. Cream, navy, and gold palette. Four Seasons or Aman resort quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[酒店名称]】创作奢华酒店品牌形象展示。精致的字标，定制字形设计。应用于：房卡、欢迎信、枕头巧克力包装、房间号牌、手提袋。优雅极简美学。奶油、海军蓝与金色色板。四季酒店或安缦度假村品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 产品包装三维样机
entries.description: 产品包装精品三维样机，真实质感的盒型与标签展示，设计师展示包装作品的终极工具。
entries.prompt: Create a premium product packaging 3D mockup for a luxury perfume bottle with faceted crystal stopper. Clean floating box or bottle with high-quality label and material simulation. Multiple angles shown. Studio lighting with subtle ground shadow. Matte, gloss, and metallic material options visible. Design presentation quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[产品类型]】创作高端产品包装三维样机。干净漂浮的盒子或瓶子，高品质标签与材质模拟。展示多个角度。工作室灯光搭配微妙地面阴影。哑光、光泽与金属材质选项可见。设计展示品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 抽象色域三维
entries.description: 抽象色域三维视觉，大面积纯色曲面在空间中漂浮交叠，色彩即内容的极致三维表达。
entries.prompt: Create an abstract color field 3D composition. Large curved planes of pure saturated color floating and intersecting in space. No texture — pure smooth matte surface. Colors: vibrant but harmonious palette of 3-4 hues. Soft ambient lighting. Rothko-inspired color field meets 3D sculpture. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作抽象色域三维构图。大型纯饱和色彩曲面在空间中漂浮交叉。无质感——纯光滑哑光表面。色彩：3-4色相的鲜艳而和谐色板。柔和环境光。罗斯科风格色域遇见三维雕塑。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 珊瑚礁水下三维
entries.description: 珊瑚礁水下三维渲染，五彩珊瑚与热带鱼的微型世界，超写实海洋生态的数字奇境。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic underwater coral reef 3D render. Diverse coral formations — brain coral, staghorn, sea fans — in vibrant colors. Schools of tropical fish. Caustic light patterns from surface. Perfect water transparency. Marine biology illustration quality meets cinema VFX. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作超写实水下珊瑚礁三维渲染。多样的珊瑚群落——脑珊瑚、鹿角珊瑚、海扇——以鲜艳色彩呈现。成群热带鱼。来自水面的焦散光纹。完美水体透明度。海洋生物学插画品质遇见电影VFX。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 动态雕塑三维艺术
