entries.description: 受亚历山大·考尔德启发的动态雕塑三维艺术，平衡在运动中的抽象形态，工业与艺术的精妙平衡。
entries.prompt: Create a 3D render of a kinetic sculpture inspired by Alexander Calder. Delicate suspended geometric shapes — circles, arcs, triangles — balanced in perfect equilibrium. Fine wire connections. Primary colors: red, blue, yellow, black. Clean white gallery environment. Motion blur suggesting gentle movement. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作受亚历山大·考尔德启发的动态雕塑三维渲染。精细悬挂的几何形状——圆形、弧线、三角形——以完美平衡悬挂。细铁丝连接。原色：红、蓝、黄、黑。干净白色画廊环境。运动模糊暗示轻柔运动。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 奇幻生物三维设计
entries.description: 奇幻生物三维概念设计，鳞片、羽翼与发光眼睛的每个细节都令人信服，数字神话的造物主。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic fantasy creature 3D design concept for a crystal-armored deep-sea dragon with bioluminescent fins. Detailed scales, feathers, or fur with subsurface scattering skin. Glowing magical eyes. Dramatic environment lighting. Every anatomical detail convincing and believable. Film VFX quality — Avatar or Lord of the Rings creature work. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[生物类型]】创作超写实奇幻生物三维设计概念。详细的鳞片、羽毛或皮毛，带有次表面散射皮肤。发光魔法眼睛。戏剧性环境光线。每个解剖细节令人信服。电影VFX品质——阿凡达或指环王的生物创作水准。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 三维字体Logo渲染
entries.description: 三维字体Logo渲染，金属或玻璃材质的文字在光线中呈现品牌质感，数字时代的标识美学。
entries.prompt: Create a premium 3D typography logo render for NOVA. Letters in metallic gold, chrome, or glass material with perfect reflections. Floating in clean space with subtle ground shadow. Beveled and extruded letterforms. Professional product launch visual quality. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌/词语]】创作高端三维字体Logo渲染。金属金色、镀铬或玻璃材质字母，完美反光。悬浮于干净空间，带有微妙地面阴影。斜面与挤出字形。专业产品发布视觉品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 科幻飞船三维设计
entries.description: 科幻飞船外观三维设计概念，精密的机械细节与星际航行的宏大想象，工业设计与科幻美学融合。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic sci-fi spaceship exterior 3D concept design. Detailed hull plating, engine nacelles, weapons systems, and running lights. Deep space background with nebula. Dramatic light from a nearby star. Industrial and functional yet visually awe-inspiring design. Interstellar or Halo aesthetic. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作超写实科幻飞船外观三维概念设计。详细的船体装甲板、引擎舱、武器系统与导航灯。深空背景搭配星云。附近恒星的戏剧性光线。工业功能性却视觉上令人敬畏的设计。星际穿越或光晕美学。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 复古汽车三维渲染
entries.description: 复古经典汽车超写实三维渲染，完美的金属漆面与车灯反光，汽车之美的数字致敬。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic vintage car 3D render for 1967 Ferrari 275 GTB in classic Rosso Corsa red. Perfect chrome and paint reflections. Dramatic studio lighting with multiple light sources highlighting body curves. Minimal background — dark gradient or studio. Rain-wet surface reflections. Automotive advertising quality. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[汽车型号/年份]】创作超写实复古汽车三维渲染。完美的镀铬与油漆反光。多光源戏剧性工作室灯光突显车身曲线。极简背景——深色渐变或工作室。雨湿表面倒影。汽车广告品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 抽象参数化三维造型
entries.description: 抽象参数化三维造型，算法生成的复杂曲面与无尽的细节，计算美学的视觉震撼。
entries.prompt: Create an abstract parametric 3D form. Algorithm-generated complex surface with thousands of subdivisions creating organic yet mathematical patterns. Smooth matte or reflective material. Dramatic single spotlight. Pure white or gradient background. Computational design beauty. Zaha Hadid meets digital sculpture. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作抽象参数化三维造型。算法生成的复杂曲面，数千个细分创造有机但数学性的纹样。光滑哑光或反射材质。戏剧性单束聚光灯。纯白或渐变背景。计算设计之美。扎哈·哈迪德遇见数字雕塑。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 建筑可视化三维
entries.description: 现代建筑效果图，精确的日光模拟与人文活动，让未建成的建筑在图像中已获生命。
entries.prompt: Create a photorealistic architectural visualization for a luxury glass-and-concrete villa cantilevered over an ocean cliff. Modern minimalist structure with floor-to-ceiling glass, clean concrete and wood. Golden hour sunlight casting long shadows. Human figures for scale. Lush landscaping. The quality of Bjarke Ingels Group or Kengo Kuma architectural rendering. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[建筑类型]】创作超写实建筑可视化。现代极简主义建筑，落地玻璃幕墙，干净混凝土与木材。黄金时段阳光投下长影。人物比例参照物。茂密景观绿化。比雅克·英格尔斯事务所或隈研吾建筑渲染品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 超写实三维食品渲染
entries.description: 超写实三维食品渲染，每一滴水珠与面包纹理都以假乱真，颠覆你对3D渲染边界的认知。
entries.prompt: Create a hyperrealistic 3D CGI food render of a glistening honey-glazed almond croissant with flaky laminated layers. Photorealistic to the point of being indistinguishable from real photography. Every pore, water droplet, crumb, and light reflection perfectly simulated. Studio product photography lighting. Unreal Engine or Blender Cycles quality. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[食品]】创作超写实3D CGI食品渲染。逼真到与真实摄影无法区分的程度。每个细孔、水滴、面包屑与光线反射都完美模拟。工作室产品摄影灯光。虚幻引擎或Blender Cycles品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 猎魔人动漫人像
entries.description: 猎魔人动漫人像，身背特殊武器的战士在满月夜独立，黑暗奇幻动漫的英雄美学。
entries.prompt: Create a demon hunter anime portrait. A lone hunter — specialized weapon on back — standing on a rooftop against a full moon night sky. Cape flowing in wind. Battle-worn armor with magical inscriptions. City or village below. Kimetsu no Yaiba or Claymore dark fantasy hero aesthetic. 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作猎魔人动漫人像。孤独的猎人——背负特殊武器——站在屋顶对抗满月夜空。斗篷在风中飘扬。带有魔法铭文的战损盔甲。下方是城市或村庄。鬼灭之刃或古语的黑暗奇幻英雄美学。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 80年代复古动漫
entries.description: 80年代日本动漫复古风格，大眼睛与细长四肢的经典美学，VHS画质感与昭和时代的青春记忆。
entries.prompt: Create a retro 1980s Japanese anime style illustration. Classic large expressive eyes, oval face, and characteristic 80s proportions. Soft cel-shading with limited color palette. VHS scan-line texture overlay. City Pop aesthetic — neon lights, sunset, sports car or city backdrop. Macross or City Hunter visual nostalgia. 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作复古1980年代日本动漫风格插画。经典大而有神的眼睛、椭圆面孔与标志性80年代比例。有限色板的柔和赛璐珞阴影。VHS扫描线纹理叠加。City Pop美学——霓虹灯、落日、跑车或城市背景。超时空要塞或城市猎人的视觉怀旧感。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 魔法学院动漫
entries.description: 魔法学院动漫场景，哈利波特氛围与日本动漫美学结合，魔法少女与古老图书馆的奇遇。
entries.prompt: Create a magical witch academy anime scene. Young witch student in pointed hat exploring a vast magical library with floating books and glowing spell tomes. Gothic stone architecture with warm candlelight. Magical potions and familiars. Harry Potter mood with anime character design. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作魔法学院动漫场景。年轻女巫学生戴着尖帽探索一座巨大的魔法图书馆，漂浮的书本与发光法术典籍。哥特式石砌建筑搭配温暖烛光。魔法药水与灵兽。哈利波特氛围与动漫角色设计的融合。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 妖狐精灵动漫
entries.description: 九尾妖狐动漫插画，多尾白狐在林间跳跃，水墨笔触与动漫彩绘的融合，东方灵异之美。
entries.prompt: Create a spirit fox (kitsune) anime illustration with ink wash elements. Nine-tailed fox spirit — elegant white fox with multiple magical tails — in a bamboo forest or shrine setting. Ink brush strokes for environmental details. Glowing blue-white fox fire (kitsune-bi). Ethereal and mysterious Eastern spirit. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作带有水墨元素的妖狐（狐狸精）动漫插画。九尾狐灵——优雅白狐有多条魔法尾巴——在竹林或神社场景中。环境细节以水墨笔触表现。发光蓝白狐火（狐狸火）。空灵神秘的东方灵异之美。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 末日后动漫城市
entries.description: 末日后动漫城市场景，植物爬满废弃摩天大楼，孤独的少年在旧世界的废墟中寻找希望。
entries.prompt: Create a post-apocalyptic anime city scene. Abandoned skyscrapers reclaimed by nature — vines, trees growing through buildings. Lone anime protagonist walking through overgrown urban ruins. Soft afternoon light filtering through leaves and broken glass. Beautiful melancholy. Attack on Titan or Nausicaä aesthetic. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作末日后动漫城市场景。自然重新占领废弃摩天大楼——藤蔓、树木穿越建筑生长。孤独的动漫主角在过度生长的城市废墟中行走。柔和午后阳光透过树叶与破碎玻璃筛落。美丽的忧郁。进击的巨人或风之谷美学。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 水下人鱼动漫
entries.description: 水下人鱼动漫插画，鱼尾在海底珊瑚间翩翩起舞，梦幻水色与发光生物共同编织深海童话。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful underwater mermaid anime illustration. Graceful mermaid with iridescent tail swimming among colorful coral and tropical fish. Rays of sunlight filtering down from surface. Bioluminescent sea creatures. Deep teal and aquamarine water tones. Magical and serene ocean world. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的水下人鱼动漫插画。优雅的人鱼，彩虹色鱼尾在五彩珊瑚与热带鱼间游泳。阳光从水面向下筛落。生物发光海洋生物。深青绿色水调。神奇而宁静的海洋世界。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 动漫动作序列定格
entries.description: 动漫动作序列定格，战斗爆发瞬间的速度线与冲击波，热血战斗动漫的永恒瞬间。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic anime action sequence freeze frame. Two fighters locked in mid-battle — sword clash or power attack — at the instant of impact. Speed lines radiating from impact point. Energy shockwave visual effect. Detailed torn clothing and flying debris. Dragon Ball Z or Naruto level power and intensity. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作戏剧性的动漫动作序列定格画面。两个战士在战斗中锁定——刀剑相碰或力量攻击——在冲击瞬间。冲击点放射状速度线。能量冲击波视觉效果。详细的撕裂衣物与飞散碎片。七龙珠或火影忍者级别的力量与强度。比例 16:9。

entries.title: Q版角色设计图
entries.description: Q版角色设计图，超萌的2头身比例，各种表情包与动作变体，可爱到令人心融化。
entries.prompt: Create a chibi character design sheet for a chibi space explorer girl with a star-patterned helmet and rocket backpack. Ultra-cute 2-head proportion chibi style. Multiple expressions: happy, angry, crying, surprised, sleeping. Various action poses: running, jumping, sitting. Pastel color palette. Clean line art with simple shading. Kawaii Japanese chibi aesthetic. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[角色]】创作Q版角色设计图。超萌的2头身比例Q版风格。多种表情：开心、生气、哭泣、惊讶、睡觉。各种动作姿态：奔跑、跳跃、坐姿。马卡龙色板。干净线稿搭配简单阴影。可爱的日本Q版美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 异世界传送门动漫
entries.description: 异世界传送动漫经典场景，蓝白光芒的传送门将现代少年送入奇幻王国，命运的转折点。
entries.prompt: Create an isekai fantasy portal anime illustration. A modern Japanese teenager standing before a glowing magical portal — blue-white swirling energy gate. On one side: modern Japan; on the other side: glimpse of fantasy kingdom with dragons and castles. Epic lighting from the portal. Dramatic moment of crossing fates. 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作异世界奇幻传送门动漫插画。现代日本少年站在发光魔法传送门前——蓝白旋转能量之门。一侧是现代日本；另一侧是奇幻王国的一瞥，有龙与城堡。传送门发出史诗性光芒。跨越命运的戏剧性时刻。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 太空歌剧动漫
entries.description: 太空歌剧动漫，巨型战舰在星云中对峙，星际战争的宏大叙事与动漫美学的史诗融合。
entries.prompt: Create an epic space opera anime scene. Massive battleships facing off in deep space, surrounded by colorful nebula. Beam weapons creating light trails. Detailed mechanical ship designs. Heroic figure on ship bridge looking out at the battle. Gundam or Legend of Galactic Heroes visual scale. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作史诗太空歌剧动漫场景。巨型战舰在深空对峙，被彩色星云包围。光束武器制造光轨。详细的机械战舰设计。英雄人物站在舰桥上凝视战斗。高达或银河英雄传说的视觉规模。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 日常校园动漫
entries.description: 温馨日常校园动漫场景，阳光教室与青春笑颜，治愈系动漫最熟悉的生命片段。
entries.prompt: Create a warm slice-of-life school anime illustration. High school classroom scene with afternoon light streaming through windows, dust motes floating. Anime students chatting or studying, cherry blossoms visible outside. Warm golden light and soft colors. K-On, Clannad, Toradora visual warmth. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作温馨的日常校园动漫插画。下午阳光从窗户斜射进教室，光尘微粒漂浮。动漫学生聊天或学习，窗外可见樱花。温暖金色光与柔和色彩。轻音部、CLANNAD、龙虎斗视觉温暖感。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 能剧面具艺术
entries.description: 日本能剧面具艺术，古典面具的细腻雕刻与神秘表情，日本传统表演艺术的精神象征。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic Noh theater mask art photograph or illustration. Ancient painted wooden Noh mask — ko-omote (young woman), hannya (demon), or ko-jo (old man) — as sole subject on dark background. Raking light revealing carved texture and painted detail. Deep shadows emphasizing the ambiguous emotional expression. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作戏剧性的能剧面具艺术摄影或插画。古老彩绘木质能面——小面（年轻女性）、般若（鬼神）或翁（老人）——作为深色背景上的唯一主体。斜射光揭示雕刻质感与彩绘细节。深沉阴影强调模糊的情感表情。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 京都古寺秋意
entries.description: 京都古寺秋日，红叶覆盖的寺院庭园与古朴建筑，禅意与自然之美的千年对话。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful Kyoto temple in peak autumn photograph. Ancient Buddhist temple pagoda or gate surrounded by brilliant red maple trees. Stone lanterns and moss-covered pathway leading to the entrance. Soft autumn light. Fallen leaves carpet the ground. Timeless spiritual Japanese atmosphere. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作美丽的京都古寺红叶盛期摄影。古老佛教寺庙塔楼或山门被鲜艳红枫树环绕。石灯笼与苔藓覆盖的小径通向入口。柔和秋日光线。落叶铺满地面。永恒的日本神圣氛围。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 原宿街头时尚
entries.description: 原宿青年街头时尚，夸张多彩的个性造型与竹下通为背景，日本次文化的视觉狂欢。
entries.prompt: Create a vibrant Harajuku street fashion portrait. Young Japanese person in elaborate Harajuku fashion — Lolita, Decora, or street kei style — standing in Takeshita Street. Bold colors, layered accessories, dramatic makeup. Surrounding colorful shops. Authentic Tokyo youth culture energy. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作充满活力的原宿街头时尚人像。年轻日本人穿着精心设计的原宿时尚——洛丽塔、Decora或街道系风格——站在竹下通。大胆色彩、叠层配饰、戏剧性妆容。周围彩色店铺。真实的东京青年文化能量。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 竹林小径
entries.description: 京都岚山竹林小径，高耸竹竿形成翠绿隧道，晨光从竹隙间筛落，世界上最治愈的森林浴。
entries.prompt: Create a photograph of Arashiyama bamboo grove path in Kyoto. Towering green bamboo stalks creating a living cathedral tunnel. Morning sunlight filtering through the canopy. Single narrow stone path. The sound of bamboo rustling implied by swaying. Vertically compressed perspective. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作京都岚山竹林小径摄影。高耸翠绿竹竿构成活体大教堂隧道。晨光透过竹冠筛落。单条狭窄石板路。摇曳竹子暗示竹叶沙沙声。竖向压缩透视。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 东京涩谷十字路口
entries.description: 东京涩谷十字路口，数百人同时穿越，长曝光的人流轨迹与霓虹广告牌，城市脉搏的视觉史诗。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic photograph of Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo at night. Hundreds of pedestrians crossing from all directions simultaneously. Long exposure light trails from people and vehicles. Giant LED billboards lighting the scene in blue and white. Overhead aerial or street-level perspective. Iconic urban energy. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作东京涩谷十字路口夜间的电影感摄影。数百人同时从各方向穿越。人流与车流的长曝光光轨。巨型LED广告牌以蓝白光照亮场景。俯视或街道视角。标志性城市能量。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 和服纹样细节
entries.description: 和服纺织品近景摄影，精美染织纹样与丝绸光泽，日本传统工艺美学的极致特写。
entries.prompt: Create a macro textile detail photograph of a Japanese kimono. Extreme close-up of silk weave showing intricate yuzen dyeing or Nishijin weaving patterns — cranes, chrysanthemums, waves, or geometric motifs. The shimmer and weight of silk visible. Rich jewel tones. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作日本和服微距纺织细节摄影。丝织物的极致近景，展示精美的友禅染色或西阵织纹样——鹤、菊花、海浪或几何图案。丝绸的光泽与质感可见。丰富宝石色调。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 新干线速度摄影
entries.description: 新干线高速列车摄影，子弹头造型在山岳与富士山背景前飞驰，日本工业美学的极致象征。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic Shinkansen bullet train speed photograph. The iconic white bullet nose of the train at speed, cherry blossoms or Mount Fuji in background. Motion blur on train body while background remains sharp (panning technique). Blue sky and white train. Japanese precision engineering beauty. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作戏剧性新干线子弹头列车速度摄影。标志性白色子弹头在高速行驶，背景是樱花或富士山。列车车身运动模糊而背景保持清晰（追随拍摄技法）。蓝天与白色列车。日本精密工程之美。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 日本陶艺侘寂
entries.description: 日本陶艺侘寂之美，裂痕与不完美是金继美学的诗意，粗糙质感中蕴藏生命的哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a wabi-sabi Japanese pottery still life photograph. Handmade ceramic vessels with intentional imperfections — crazing, texture, asymmetry. Kintsugi gold-repaired cracks glowing. Natural neutral surface. Raking light emphasizing texture. A single flower or moss. The beauty of imperfection. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作侘寂日本陶艺静物摄影。手工陶瓷器皿带有刻意的不完美——龟裂、肌理、不对称。金继修复的黄金裂缝发光。自然中性台面。斜射光强调质感。一朵花或苔藓。不完美的美。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 雪中温泉
entries.description: 冬日雪中温泉，温泉热气在严寒中袅袅升腾，雪景与热泉的视觉反差令人向往日本冬日。
entries.prompt: Create a serene winter onsen hot spring photograph. Steam rising from thermal water into cold winter air. Snow-covered rocks and pine branches surrounding the pool. Soft grey overcast winter sky. Possibly Japanese macaque monkeys in the water. Peaceful and deeply Japanese atmosphere. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作宁静的冬日温泉摄影。热泉水面蒸汽升腾入冷冬空气。积雪的岩石与松枝环绕水池。柔和灰色阴云冬日天空。水中可能有日本猕猴（雪猴）。安宁而深刻的日本氛围。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 食材爆炸漂浮摄影
entries.description: 食材漂浮爆炸摄影，新鲜食材在空中定格，色彩鲜艳的视觉盛宴传递食品的新鲜活力。
entries.prompt: Create a vibrant floating ingredients explosion photograph for Japanese ceremonial matcha — bamboo whisk and ceramic bowl. Fresh ingredients — vegetables, fruits, spices, herbs — exploding outward from central product, each perfectly sharp and frozen mid-air. Clean white background. Studio strobe freezing motion. Vivid saturated natural food colors. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[食品/品牌]】创作充满活力的食材漂浮爆炸摄影。新鲜食材——蔬菜、水果、香料、香草——从中心产品向外爆炸性飞散，每一个都完美清晰地凝固在空中。纯白背景。工作室闪光灯冻结运动。鲜艳饱和的天然食物色彩。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 复古相机静物摄影
entries.description: 复古胶片相机静物摄影，岁月沉淀的金属光泽与皮质包裹，摄影爱好者的器材恋物癖。
entries.prompt: Create a vintage camera still life photograph. Aged film cameras — Leica, Rolleiflex, or Contax — arranged on wooden surface with developed film strips, contact sheets, and camera strap. Warm dramatic raking light revealing leather texture and metal wear. Nostalgic analog photography culture. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作复古相机静物摄影。老旧胶片相机——徕卡、禄来弗莱克斯或康泰时——与冲洗好的胶卷、接触印相纸和相机背带一起排列于木质台面。温暖戏剧性斜射光线揭示皮革质感与金属磨损痕迹。怀旧模拟摄影文化。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 建筑模型摄影
entries.description: 建筑模型精品摄影，白色石膏模型在纯白背景上的光影关系，建筑师手工艺的极简记录。
entries.prompt: Create minimalist architectural model photography for a flowing parametric pavilion by Zaha Hadid Architects. White plaster or chipboard architectural study model on pure white surface. Single directional light creating soft shadows that reveal three-dimensional form. Zero distraction — just form and light. Fine art meets architecture. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[建筑/事务所]】创作极简建筑模型摄影。白色石膏或硬纸板建筑研究模型放置于纯白台面。单方向光线制造柔和阴影，揭示三维形态。零干扰——只有形态与光线。精细艺术遇见建筑。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 高端耳机编辑摄影
entries.description: 高端耳机编辑广告摄影，精准光影勾勒出工业设计的美感，音乐与科技的感官想象。
entries.prompt: Create premium headphones editorial product photography for Bang & Olufsen Beoplay H95 in gold tone. Headphones floating or on a model, dramatic studio lighting revealing acoustic mesh detail and material quality. Sound visualization: floating musical notes or audio waveform. Dark premium background. Apple/Sony campaign quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端耳机编辑产品摄影。耳机漂浮或佩戴于模特头上，戏剧性工作室灯光揭示声学网格细节与材质品质。声音可视化：漂浮音符或音频波形。深色高端背景。苹果/索尼广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 跑鞋运动摄影
entries.description: 跑鞋运动瞬间摄影，冻结在空中的鞋子展现科技感中底与材质，速度与力量的广告语言。
entries.prompt: Create a dynamic running shoe product photography for Nike Vaporfly 3 in neon volt green. Shoe frozen mid-air in running motion, slight motion blur on sole and heel. Hard concrete or track surface below. Dramatic low side lighting. Splatter of water or dust particles around shoe. Technical sole detail visible. Speed and power. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作动感跑鞋产品摄影。跑步运动中凝固在空中的鞋子，鞋底与鞋跟有轻微运动模糊。下方坚硬混凝土或跑道表面。戏剧性低侧光。鞋子周围的水花或尘埃颗粒飞溅。科技鞋底细节可见。速度与力量。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 奢华巧克力微距摄影
entries.description: 顶级巧克力微距摄影，截面的层次质感与可可颗粒的细节，让人无法抗拒的感官诱惑。
entries.prompt: Create ultra-luxury chocolate macro photography for VALRHONA Manjari 64% dark chocolate. Extreme close-up of chocolate bar breaking, revealing interior layers and air bubbles. Perfect snap caught mid-action. Dark deep chocolate brown with golden reflections. Cocoa powder dust in air. Premium confectionery advertising quality. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作超级奢华巧克力微距摄影。巧克力棒断裂的极致近景，揭示内部层次与气泡。完美的断裂瞬间捕捉。深沉浓郁巧克力棕色搭配金色反光。空气中的可可粉尘。高端糖果广告品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 植物产品静物摄影
entries.description: 植物与产品共生的静物摄影，绿植的生命力为产品注入自然气息，北欧极简家居美学。
entries.prompt: Create a botanical product still life photograph for AESOP Parsley Seed skincare range. Product as hero among living plants and dried botanicals. Terracotta pots, hanging greenery, monstera leaves. Bright airy window light. White or warm neutral background. Danish-inspired home aesthetic. Life and nature intertwined with product. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作植物产品静物摄影。产品作为主角，置于活体植物与干燥植物之间。赤陶花盆、悬挂绿植、龟背竹叶。明亮通透的窗光。白色或暖中性背景。丹麦风格家居美学。生命与自然和产品交织。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 精品咖啡近景摄影
entries.description: 精品咖啡近景摄影，完美拉花在晨光中冒着热气，咖啡师与咖啡文化的视觉颂歌。
entries.prompt: Create a close-up artisan coffee photography. Latte art in perfect rosette or tulip pattern, steam rising from the cup surface. Early morning window light creating warm glow. Ceramic cup on wooden café table. Extreme shallow depth of field. Coffee texture and cream swirls in ultra-detail. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作精品咖啡近景摄影。拿铁拉花呈现完美玫瑰花或郁金香图案，蒸汽从杯面升起。清晨窗光制造温暖光晕。陶瓷杯放置于木质咖啡桌。极浅景深。咖啡质感与奶油旋涡超细节呈现。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 护肤品平铺摄影
entries.description: 高端护肤品平铺摄影，精心搭配的瓶瓶罐罐与自然植物，传递纯净护肤的品牌哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a premium skincare flatlay product photograph for La Mer The Moisturizing Cream. Multiple product lineup — serums, moisturizer, toner — arranged in a precise overhead flat lay. Clean white or soft pink surface. Fresh botanical elements: aloe, rose petals, green leaves. Soft even overhead studio light. Clean clinical beauty aesthetic. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作高端护肤品平铺产品摄影。多个产品系列——精华、保湿霜、化妆水——在精准的俯视平铺中排列。干净白色或柔粉色台面。新鲜植物元素：芦荟、玫瑰花瓣、绿叶。柔和均匀的顶部工作室光线。干净临床美妆美学。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 书籍封面样机展示
entries.description: 书籍封面编辑摄影，自然光下的书本与阅读场景，传递知识与审美并重的文化气息。
entries.prompt: Create an editorial book cover mockup photograph for A Sea of Quiet — a literary fiction novel with linen cover. The book is open or closed on a beautiful natural surface — linen, marble, wooden desk. Golden hour or natural window light. Reading glasses, coffee cup, or flower as supporting props. Intellectual and aesthetic lifestyle mood. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[书名/类型]】创作编辑书籍封面样机摄影。书本打开或合上放置于美丽的自然台面——亚麻、大理石、木质书桌。黄金时段或自然窗光。阅读眼镜、咖啡杯或花卉作为辅助道具。知性而有美感的生活方式情绪。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 奢华蜡烛情绪摄影
entries.description: 奢华香薰蜡烛情绪摄影，烛光在黑暗中的温柔晕染，让产品传递仪式感与生活品质。
entries.prompt: Create luxury candle mood product photography for AESOP Petrichor candle. Single or pair of candles lit in dramatic darkness. The warm flame glow is the sole light source, creating intimate amber atmosphere. Marble, dark wood, or concrete surface. Dried botanicals nearby. Minimal props, maximum atmosphere. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作奢华蜡烛情绪产品摄影。一支或两支点燃蜡烛在戏剧性黑暗中。温暖烛光是唯一光源，营造亲密琥珀氛围。大理石、深色木材或混凝土台面。附近摆放干燥植物。最少道具，最大氛围感。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 逆光舞蹈剪影
entries.description: 舞者逆光剪影摄影，运动中凝固的优美姿态在强光前化为诗意剪影，动与静的完美平衡。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic backlit dance silhouette portrait. Dancer frozen mid-movement — leap, arabesque, or contemporary pose — perfectly silhouetted against intense backlight. Studio strobe behind creates rim light halo. Tutu fabric or flowing costume catching light. Pure artistic movement photography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作戏剧性逆光舞蹈剪影人像。舞者在运动中凝固——跳跃、阿拉贝斯克或当代舞姿——对抗强逆光完美剪影化。背后工作室闪光灯制造轮廓光光晕。芭蕾裙或飘逸服装捕捉光线。纯粹艺术动态摄影。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 眼部微距特写
entries.description: 人眼微距摄影，虹膜的纹理如同宇宙星云，极致近景揭示人体最神秘器官的宏大细节。
entries.prompt: Create an extreme macro eye portrait photograph. Single human eye filling entire frame. Iris texture revealed in extraordinary detail — resembling a galaxy or abstract landscape. Catchlight reflection in pupil. Individual eyelashes sharp. Color: blue, green, or amber iris with exceptional detail. Commercial beauty photography quality. 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作极致微距眼部人像摄影。单只人眼充满整个画面。虹膜质感以非凡细节呈现——如同星系或抽象风景。瞳孔中的反光点。每根睫毛清晰。颜色：蓝色、绿色或琥珀色虹膜，细节卓越。商业美妆摄影品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 雨窗反射人像
entries.description: 雨天玻璃窗前的反射人像，水珠与城市灯光折射出朦胧诗意，孤独与沉思的情绪摄影。
entries.prompt: Create a moody rain window reflection portrait. Face looking out through rain-streaked glass, the outside city lights refracted into bokeh trails through each raindrop. Inside darkness, outside neon glow. Solitude and contemplation mood. Cool blue tones with warm light pops. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作忧郁的雨窗反射人像。面孔透过雨迹玻璃向外凝视，窗外城市灯光通过每滴雨珠折射成虚化光轨。室内昏暗，室外霓虹发光。孤独与沉思的情绪。冷蓝色调搭配温暖光斑点缀。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 双联人像摄影
entries.description: 双联组合人像，两个人物面对或背对，形成叙事张力与情感对话的电影级构图。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic double portrait diptych. Two figures in the same frame, facing each other or back to back. Empty space between them creates tension. Complementary or contrasting: light/shadow, young/old, masculine/feminine. Film still quality — from a story bigger than what we see. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作电影感双联人像。两个人物在同一画面，面对面或背靠背。中间的空间制造张力。互补或对比：光与影、年轻与年老、阳刚与阴柔。电影静帧品质——来自一个比我们看到的更大的故事。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 男性编辑时尚人像
entries.description: 男性时尚编辑人像，简洁背景与强烈光影，传递男性气质与当代时尚杂志的高级感。
entries.prompt: Create a strong editorial male headshot/portrait. Clean studio or architectural background. Strong architectural lighting — Rembrandt or split light. Sharp jaw, direct gaze into camera. Minimal styling: plain t-shirt or white shirt. Confidence and masculinity. High-end fashion magazine quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作强有力的男性编辑头像/人像。干净工作室或建筑背景。强烈建筑感光线——伦勃朗光或分色光。锐利下颚，直视镜头。极简造型：素色T恤或白衬衫。自信与男性气质。高端时尚杂志品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 沙漠风光人像
entries.description: 沙漠荒野人像，人物融于广袤大地，风沙与阳光塑造出粗粝而诗意的西部美学。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic desert landscape portrait. Figure standing in vast desert environment — red rock canyon, sand dunes, or salt flats. Extreme wide angle giving sense of scale. Warm golden light or dramatic storm light. Dust particles in air. Color grade: warm highlights, teal shadows. National Geographic quality. 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作电影感沙漠风光人像。人物站立于广阔沙漠环境——红岩峡谷、沙丘或盐滩。极宽广角给予比例感。温暖金色光或戏剧性风暴光。空气中的尘埃颗粒。色调：温暖高光、青色阴影。国家地理品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 神祇概念人像
entries.description: 神祇概念人像，火焰、水流或星辰融入人物，超凡脱俗的力量感与神话气质。
entries.prompt: Create a conceptual goddess portrait of goddess of the moon — lunar silver robes, crescent crown. The subject embodies an elemental force — fire goddess with flames woven into hair, water deity with liquid fabric, star goddess with cosmic dust skin. Dramatic ethereal lighting. Otherworldly beauty. High-end composite photography art. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[神祇/元素]】概念神祇人像。人物体现元素力量——火焰女神头发中编织火焰，水神穿着液态织物，星辰女神有宇宙尘埃肌肤。戏剧性空灵光线。超凡美貌。高端合成摄影艺术。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 黑色电影人像
entries.description: 1940年代好莱坞黑色电影风格人像，威尼斯百叶窗投影与烟雾，永恒的黑白电影美学。
entries.prompt: Create a film noir style black and white portrait. Venetian blind shadow stripes across the face from a side window. Cigarette smoke curl. Deep shadows under cheekbones and eyes. Detective office or dimly lit bar setting behind subject. 1940s Hollywood aesthetic. High contrast silver gelatin print quality. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作黑色电影风格黑白人像。侧窗百叶窗条纹阴影投在脸上。烟雾旋绕。颧骨与眼睛下方的深沉阴影。人物身后的侦探办公室或昏暗酒吧场景。1940年代好莱坞美学。高对比银盐印相品质。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 手绘幻想地图
entries.description: 幻想世界手绘地图插画，山脉、海怪与罗盘玫瑰，中世纪制图师的想象力与精细笔触。
entries.prompt: Create a hand-illustrated fantasy world map for the ancient Silk Road trade routes connecting East and West. Aged parchment background. Mountains, forests, and seas rendered in medieval cartographic style. Sea monsters and ships in ocean areas. Ornate compass rose. Decorative calligraphy for place names. Aged border frame. Tolkien-inspired map aesthetics. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[世界/故事]】创作手绘幻想世界地图。陈年羊皮纸背景。山脉、森林与海洋以中世纪制图风格渲染。海域中的海怪与船只。华丽罗盘玫瑰。地名装饰性书法。做旧边框。托尔金风格地图美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 建筑蓝图艺术
entries.description: 建筑蓝图风格艺术插画，白色精细线条在深蓝底上描绘建筑或机械，理性美学的极致。
entries.prompt: Create an architectural blueprint style art illustration of the Sagrada Família cathedral by Gaudí. White or cyan technical line drawing on deep navy blue background. Multiple views: elevation, section, plan. Fine hatching and dimension lines. Grid overlay. Precise and beautiful technical drafting. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[建筑/物体]】的建筑蓝图风格艺术插画。深海军蓝背景上的白色或青色技术线图。多视图：立面、剖面、平面。精细剖面线与尺寸标注线。网格叠加。精确而美丽的技术制图。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 彩色玻璃窗艺术
entries.description: 哥特式大教堂彩色玻璃窗风格艺术，铅条分割的玻璃镶嵌与光线透射，神圣而绚烂。
entries.prompt: Create a stained glass window style illustration of a phoenix rising from golden flames. Gothic cathedral aesthetic with lead caming (black outlines) dividing colored glass panels. Jewel-toned translucent colors: ruby red, cobalt blue, emerald green, golden amber. Backlighting effect making colors glow. Biblical or symbolic figurative scene. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[主题]】的彩色玻璃窗风格插画。哥特式大教堂美学，铅条（黑色轮廓）分割彩色玻璃板块。宝石般半透明色彩：红宝石红、钴蓝、祖母绿、金色琥珀。背光效果令色彩发光。圣经或象征性人物场景。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 神话场景插画
entries.description: 史诗神话场景插画，神祇与凡人的相遇，古典油画技法重现东西方神话的磅礴气势。
entries.prompt: Create an epic mythological scene illustration depicting Athena, goddess of wisdom, emerging fully armored from Zeus's forehead. Gods and mortals in dramatic interaction. Classical oil painting technique: chiaroscuro lighting, dynamic figural composition. Clouds, lightning, divine light. Greek, Chinese, or Norse mythology aesthetic. Renaissance-inspired composition with baroque drama. 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作描绘【[神话/神祇]】的史诗神话场景插画。神与凡人的戏剧性互动。古典油画技法：明暗对比光线、动态人物构图。云彩、闪电、神圣光芒。希腊、中国或北欧神话美学。文艺复兴构图搭配巴洛克戏剧感。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 麻胶版画艺术
entries.description: 麻胶版画印刷艺术，刀刻痕迹与高对比黑白构图，原始而有力的手工印刷美学。
entries.prompt: Create a linocut print style artwork of a lone wolf howling at the full moon on a rocky ridge. Bold black and white high-contrast composition with characteristic gouge marks and cut textures. Organic irregular edges to shapes. No gradients — pure positive/negative space. Handmade print aesthetic. Simple powerful imagery: animal, landscape, or portrait. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作【[主题]】的麻胶版画风格艺术作品。大胆的黑白高对比构图，带有特征性的凿刻痕迹与刀切纹理。形状边缘有机不规则。无渐变——纯粹正负空间。手工印刷美学。简洁有力的图像：动物、风景或人像。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 艺术信息图表
entries.description: 将数据可视化变为艺术品，流动的图表线条与精美排版共同讲述数据背后的故事。
entries.prompt: Create an artistic infographic for how specialty coffee travels from Ethiopian highlands to your cup. Data visualization transformed into beautiful illustration — flowing chart lines that form landscapes or figures. Icons hand-illustrated in consistent style. Clear typographic hierarchy. Cohesive color system. Information design meets fine art poster. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[数据/主题]】创作艺术信息图表。数据可视化转化为美丽插画——流动的图表线条构成风景或人物。图标以统一风格手绘。清晰的字体层级。统一色彩系统。信息设计与精细艺术海报的融合。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 角色概念设计
entries.description: 游戏或影视角色概念设计，三视图展示与装备细节，工业级概念艺术家的创作语言。
entries.prompt: Create a character concept art sheet for Rei — an ancient forest spirit guardian with flowing moss-covered robes. Front, side, and 3/4 view poses. Detailed costume/armor/equipment design. Color palette swatches. Callout lines indicating material and design notes. Epic fantasy, sci-fi, or steampunk genre aesthetic. Professional game art or film pre-production quality. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[角色名/类型]】创作角色概念设计图。正面、侧面与3/4视角姿态。详细服装/盔甲/装备设计。配色方案色块。引线标注材质与设计说明。史诗奇幻、科幻或蒸汽朋克风格美学。专业游戏美术或电影前期制作品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 复古旅行海报插画
entries.description: 1930年代风格旅行海报插画，平面色块与简洁风景，令人向往的异国目的地浪漫想象。
entries.prompt: Create a 1930s-style travel poster illustration for Kyoto, Japan — temples, geisha, and autumn foliage. Simplified flat-color landscape with iconic landmarks — mountains, temples, coastlines. Art Deco typographic frame. Limited palette of 4-5 colors: sky blue, warm tan, forest green, cream. Streamlined shapes with long shadows. WPA poster aesthetic. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[目的地]】创作1930年代风格旅行海报插画。简化平面色块风景与标志性地标——山脉、寺庙、海岸线。装饰艺术排版框架。4-5色有限色板：天蓝、温暖棕褐、森林绿、奶油色。流线型形状与长条阴影。WPA海报美学。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 时装设计手稿
entries.description: 时装设计师风格手稿插画，纤细流畅的人体线稿与服装细节，高定时装的艺术笔记。
entries.prompt: Create a fashion design sketch illustration for a sculptural floor-length evening gown with dramatic train. Elongated fashion figure (croquis) in dynamic pose. Loose gestural ink or pencil lines for body structure. Detailed watercolor or marker rendering of the garment. Fabric texture and drape suggested with minimal strokes. Sketchbook aesthetic with handwritten notes. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[服装/系列]】创作时装设计手稿插画。修长时装人体（croquis）以动态姿态呈现。松散手势墨线或铅笔线条描绘人体结构。服装以水彩或马克笔详细渲染。最少笔触暗示面料质感与垂坠感。速写本美学搭配手写注释。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 编辑漫画插画
entries.description: 时事评论漫画风格插画，夸张的人物特征与犀利的讽刺视角，纽约客杂志级别的插画艺术。
entries.prompt: Create an editorial caricature illustration of a visionary tech billionaire holding a tiny rocket. Exaggerated but recognizable features — oversized head, characteristic gestures. Clean line art with flat ink wash coloring. New Yorker magazine cover aesthetic. Black ink outline with limited color wash. Satirical yet sophisticated humor. 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[对象]】创作编辑漫画插画。夸张但可识别的特征——超大头部、标志性姿态。干净线稿搭配平面水墨着色。《纽约客》杂志封面美学。黑色墨线与有限彩色晕染。犀利而精致的幽默。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 字体艺术海报
entries.description: 字体即艺术的视觉海报，文字本身构成画面，排印即图形，现代字体设计的极致表达。
entries.prompt: Create a typography-as-art poster where BREATHE is the sole visual element. The text is arranged, scaled, rotated, and layered to form a face, landscape, or abstract composition. Monochrome or duo-tone palette. Multiple typefaces at extreme contrast in size. Graphic design mastery where type IS the image. 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 创作文字即艺术的海报，【[词语/引言]】是唯一视觉元素。文字经过排列、缩放、旋转和叠加，形成人脸、风景或抽象构图。单色或双色调色板。极端对比字号与多种字体。文字即图像的平面设计极致。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 天文星空海报
entries.description: 天文学教育海报，深邃星云与星座图案，科学与浪漫并存的宇宙视觉探索。
entries.prompt: Create an astronomy night sky educational poster. Deep space photography style showing nebula, star clusters, or constellation map. Rich deep space colors: midnight blue, violet, gold star points. Scientific constellation line overlay with Latin names. Vintage observatory chart meets modern astrophotography. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作天文学夜空教育海报。深空摄影风格展示星云、星团或星座图。丰富的深空色彩：午夜蓝、紫罗兰、金色星点。星座连线叠加拉丁名称。复古天文台图表与现代天体摄影的融合。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 博物馆展览海报
entries.description: 现代博物馆展览海报，极简的展品图像与精准的排版，传递高级艺术机构气质。
entries.prompt: Create a museum exhibition poster for Forms of Silence — A Retrospective on Minimalist Sculpture. One dominant image — artwork detail, sculpture fragment, or abstract form — floating on clean white. Precise typographic layout: exhibition title in refined serif, date and institution in minimal sans-serif. Generous negative space. MoMA, Tate, Pompidou aesthetic. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[展览名称]】创作博物馆展览海报。一个主图——艺术品细节、雕塑局部或抽象形式——飘浮于干净白底。精确排版：精致衬线字体展览名，极简无衬线字体日期与机构名。充足负空间。MoMA、Tate、蓬皮杜美学。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 构成主义宣传海报
entries.description: 苏联构成主义风格海报，对角线构图与工人人物剪影，强烈的政治美学与历史张力。
entries.prompt: Create a Soviet Constructivist style propaganda poster for Protect the Oceans — Our Planet Needs You. Dramatic diagonal composition with bold geometric shapes. Silhouetted heroic figures of workers or athletes. Limited palette: red, black, cream, yellow. Cyrillic-inspired bold sans-serif typography at dynamic angles. Authentic 1920s-30s Russian avant-garde aesthetic. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[主题]】创作苏联构成主义风格宣传海报。戏剧性对角线构图，大胆几何形状。工人或运动员英雄剪影。有限色板：红、黑、奶油、黄。西里尔字体灵感的粗黑无衬线字体以动态角度排列。真实1920-30年代俄罗斯先锋美学。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 科技峰会海报
entries.description: 科技峰会简约海报，几何线条与数字粒子构成科技感视觉，清晰传达会议信息。
entries.prompt: Create a minimalist tech conference poster for NEURAL SUMMIT 2025 — The Future of Artificial Intelligence. Abstract geometric network or circuit topology as background illustration in subtle blueprint blue or dark mode. Clean sans-serif hierarchy: event name, date, location. Accent color glow effects on key nodes. Sophisticated and intelligent visual language. 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[活动]】创作极简科技峰会海报。抽象几何网络或电路拓扑作为背景插画，细腻蓝图蓝或暗黑风格。干净无衬线字体层级：活动名、日期、地点。关键节点发光效果。精致智慧的视觉语言。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 音乐节阵容海报
entries.description: 夏日音乐节海报，多层艺术家信息排版与插画背景，活力满满的户外音乐节氛围。
entries.prompt: Design a summer music festival lineup poster for AURORA FESTIVAL 2025. Bold headline artist name at top in large decorative font. Supporting acts in descending size typography. Festival dates and venue. Background: illustrated landscape (mountains, desert, forest) with gradient sky. Psychedelic color palette. Hand-drawn frame details. 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[音乐节名称]】设计夏日音乐节阵容海报。顶部大号装饰字体显示头条艺人名。支持艺人依次递减字号排列。节日日期与场地。背景：插画风景（山脉、沙漠、森林）搭配渐变天空。迷幻色调。手绘边框细节。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 包豪斯几何海报
entries.description: 包豪斯风格几何构成海报，原色圆形与线条的精确排布，工业设计与艺术的完美统一。
entries.prompt: Create a Bauhaus-style geometric composition poster. Pure primary color shapes — circles, triangles, rectangles — arranged with mathematical precision. Black, red, blue, yellow on white. Herbert Bayer or Moholy-Nagy inspired. Strong typographic integration with sans-serif in various weights. Modernist functional beauty. 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 创作包豪斯风格几何构成海报。纯原色几何——圆形、三角形、矩形——以数学精度排列。白底上的黑、红、蓝、黄。赫伯特·拜耶或莫霍利-纳吉灵感。无衬线字体多重量级排印强力融入。现代主义功能之美。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 黑胶唱片封面
entries.description: 黑胶唱片封面设计，70年代摇滚或爵士专辑美学，模拟印刷质感与手工插画。
entries.prompt: Design a vinyl album art cover for Midnight Bloom — Lyra Sol's debut dream-pop album. Inspired by 1970s rock or jazz album aesthetics. Bold illustrated artwork — psychedelic landscape, abstract portrait, or geometric art. Warm analog print colors with slight overexposure. Album title in retro hand-lettering. Cardboard texture and print grain. Square 1:1 ratio.
entries.promptZh: 为【[艺术家/专辑]】设计黑胶唱片封面。受1970年代摇滚或爵士专辑美学启发。大胆插画——迷幻风景、抽象人像或几何艺术。温暖模拟印刷色彩，轻微过曝。复古手写字体专辑名。纸板纹理与印刷颗粒感。正方形 1:1 比例。

entries.title: 电影院线海报
entries.description: 好莱坞院线级电影海报设计，电影感光影与人物构图，大片的视觉冲击感。
entries.prompt: Design a Hollywood-style cinematic movie poster for Blade Runner 2049. Dramatic character composition with strong key light, wide-angle lens distortion. Title treatment with layered glow effects and supporting cast credits in fine print. Epic sky or environment background. Moody desaturated color grade with teal-orange LUT. 2:3 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 为【[电影名称]】设计好莱坞风格电影海报。戏剧性人物构图，强主光、广角畸变。标题搭配多层发光效果，下方演职员表细字。史诗性天空或环境背景。青橙色调低饱和电影级色调。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 塔罗牌艺术海报
entries.description: 神秘塔罗牌艺术风格海报，金边装饰纹样与神秘符号，古老占卜美学的视觉重构。
entries.prompt: Create a tarot card style art poster for The Moon — a luminous silver goddess rising from still midnight water. Ornate gold border frame with mystical symbols and celestial motifs. Central allegorical figure or symbolic composition. Deep jewel-tone background (midnight navy, forest green, deep crimson). Antique serif typography with Roman numerals. Fine Art Nouveau illustration style. 2:3 ratio.
entries.promptZh: 为【[主题]】创作塔罗牌风格艺术海报。华丽金色边框，神秘符号与天体图案。中心寓言人物或象征性构图。深宝石色背景（午夜海军蓝、森林绿、深红）。古典衬线字体与罗马数字。新艺术运动插画风格。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 高定服装细节特写
entries.description: 高级定制服装细节特写，手工刺绣与精密剪裁在光线下令人屏息，制衣工艺之美。
entries.prompt: Create a breathtaking haute couture garment detail close-up photograph for Chanel Atelier — hand-embroidered camellia bodice. Extreme macro focus on hand-embroidered detail — seed pearls, crystal beading, silk embroidery, pleating or draping. Garment worn or on mannequin with dramatic raking studio light revealing three-dimensional texture of every embellishment. Blurred background context. Chanel Atelier, Christian Dior Haute Couture quality documentation. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[高定品牌]】创作一张令人窒息的高级定制服装细节特写照片。极致微距对焦手工刺绣细节——珍珠子、水晶珠饰、丝绸刺绣、褶皱或垂坠。服装由模特穿着或置于人台，戏剧性斜射工作室光线揭示每一处装饰的立体质感。模糊背景提供语境。香奈儿高定工坊、克里斯汀·迪奥高级定制品质记录。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 时尚配饰平铺摄影
entries.description: 时尚配饰平铺摄影，包袋、珠宝与香水的精心组合，构建一套有品位的时尚叙事。
entries.prompt: Create an editorial fashion accessories flat lay photograph for Loewe — Summer 2025 Collection. Premium accessories arranged in a perfectly styled overhead shot: designer bag, sunglasses, jewelry, perfume bottle, silk scarf. Shot on linen, marble, or colored paper surface. Precise arrangement with intentional asymmetry. Soft diffused light with minimal shadows. Cohesive color story. Net-a-Porter, Vogue editorial still life quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌/季节]】创作一张编辑风时尚配饰平铺摄影。俯视角度精心造型的顶级配饰排列：设计师包袋、太阳镜、珠宝、香水瓶、丝质围巾。置于亚麻布、大理石或彩色纸面拍摄。精准排布，刻意的不对称感。柔和漫射光，阴影极简。统一的色彩故事。Net-a-Porter、Vogue 编辑静物品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 男士定制西装造型
entries.description: 男士定制西装编辑造型，剪裁的力量与优雅，商务与品位在一套量身定制中得到诠释。
entries.prompt: Create a refined menswear tailored suit editorial photograph for Kiton bespoke Neapolitan tailoring. Male model in precisely cut bespoke suit — sharp lapels, perfect shoulder line, immaculate trouser break. Minimal styling: white shirt, silk tie or bare collar. Location: minimalist architecture, marble lobby, or simple studio. Clean editorial lighting revealing fabric texture. Tom Ford, Brioni, Savile Row elegance. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌/设计师]】创作一张精致男装定制西装编辑大片。男模身着精确裁剪的定制西装——锋利翻领、完美肩线、整洁的裤脚落位。简洁造型：白衬衫、丝绸领带或敞领。场景：极简建筑、大理石大堂或简洁工作室。干净编辑灯光凸显面料质感。汤姆·福特、布里奥尼、萨维尔街的优雅。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 泳装海滩大片
entries.description: 高端泳装海滩编辑大片，阳光、沙滩与完美曝光，活力四射的夏日时尚语言。
entries.prompt: Create a luxury swimwear editorial beach campaign photograph. Model in elegant designer swimwear on pristine white sand or rocky coastal setting. Perfect outdoor natural light — late afternoon golden hour or bright midday. Ocean backdrop in deep turquoise. Dynamic confident pose — walking, leaping, or reclining. Vibrant saturated colors: tropical bright and warm. Sports Illustrated, Vogue swimsuit editorial quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张奢华泳装编辑海滩广告摄影。模特穿着优雅设计师泳装，置于洁白沙滩或岩石海岸场景。完美户外自然光——下午黄金时段或明亮正午阳光。背景是深绿松石色海洋。充满动感自信的姿态——行走、跃动或卧姿。鲜艳饱和色彩：热带明艳与温暖。《体育画报》、《Vogue》泳装大片编辑品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 先锋时尚大片
entries.description: 先锋派时尚编辑大片，突破常规的造型与结构性服装，挑战视觉极限的高级时尚表达。
entries.prompt: Create an avant-garde high fashion editorial photograph for Iris van Herpen's biomimicry couture collection. Model in architectural or deconstructed garment — exaggerated proportions, sculptural silhouette, unconventional materials. Location: industrial space, rooftop, or stripped studio. Bold dramatic lighting creating strong shadows that complement garment structure. Challenging editorial composition — rule-breaking angles. Comme des Garçons, Rick Owens editorial DNA. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[设计师/概念]】创作一张先锋派高级时尚编辑大片。模特身着建筑感或解构主义服装——夸张比例、雕塑廓形、非常规材质。场景：工业空间、楼顶或简洁工作室。大胆戏剧性灯光制造强烈阴影与服装结构相呼应。挑战性编辑构图——打破规则的角度。川久保玲、Rick Owens 的编辑基因。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 餐厅菜单品牌设计
entries.description: 餐厅菜单品牌视觉，从Logo到菜单封面的完整品牌表达，每一个细节都是用餐体验的一部分。
entries.prompt: Create a complete restaurant brand and menu design for BOTANICA — contemporary plant-based fine dining. Brand identity applied to menu cover: restaurant name in custom lettering, complementary illustration of key ingredients or cultural motifs. Printed menu mockup with textured paper cover. Warm bistro color palette. Typography hierarchy on interior pages showing sections clearly. Bouchon, Nobu, Noma brand quality. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[餐厅名称/菜系]】创作一套完整的餐厅品牌与菜单设计。品牌形象应用于菜单封面：餐厅名称采用定制字体，搭配核心食材或文化图腾的插画。带有肌理纸质封面的印刷菜单样机。温馨小酒馆色调。内页排版层级清晰展示各个菜单分区。Bouchon、Nobu、Noma 品牌品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 环保品牌包装设计
entries.description: 可持续环保品牌包装，原色纸板与植物油墨，传递品牌的环境责任感与自然美学。
entries.prompt: Create an eco-friendly sustainable brand packaging design for organic loose-leaf herbal tea. Unbleached kraft paper and cardboard boxes with soy-ink botanical illustrations. Earthy natural color palette: forest green, terracotta, sand, natural kraft. Minimal printing — only what's necessary. Seed paper hang tags, cotton twine. Product feels naturally responsible. Aesop, Seed, Pela brand aesthetic. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[产品]】创作一款环保可持续品牌包装设计。未漂白牛皮纸和硬纸板盒，配有大豆油墨植物插画。大地自然色调：森林绿、赤陶、沙色、天然牛皮色。最小化印刷——只印必要内容。种子纸吊牌、棉绳。产品散发天然负责任的气质。Aesop、Seed、Pela 品牌美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 应用图标设计系列
entries.description: 精心设计的应用图标系列，统一的设计语言贯穿多个图标，极简美学与功能识别完美平衡。
entries.prompt: Create a cohesive app icon design set for a productivity and wellness app suite called FLOW. 6-9 app icons arranged in a clean grid, all sharing the same design language: consistent corner radius, color palette, icon weight, and illustration style. Clean minimalist filled icons on white or colored rounded-rectangle backgrounds. Each icon clearly communicates its function. Apple App Store quality standards. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[应用类型/品牌]】创作一套统一的应用图标设计系列。6-9个图标以干净网格排布，共享相同设计语言：统一的圆角半径、色调、图标粗细和插画风格。干净极简的实心图标，置于白色或彩色圆角矩形背景上。每个图标清晰传递其功能。苹果 App Store 质量标准。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 时尚杂志编辑版式
entries.description: 高端时尚杂志编辑版式，大胆的字体层级与精致的图文排版，纸媒的黄金时代重现。
entries.prompt: Create a high-end fashion magazine editorial spread layout for VOGUE — The Future of Fashion Issue. Double-page spread design with bold typographic hierarchy — large display headline, pull quotes, body text columns. Fashion photography integrated into asymmetric grid. White space used confidently. Modern serif meets grotesque type system. Clean minimal design with bold editorial personality. Vogue, Porter, Kinfolk magazine quality. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[杂志/主题]】创作一个高端时尚杂志编辑版式展开页设计。跨页版式，带有大胆字体层级——大标题展示字、引用语、正文分栏。时尚摄影融入非对称网格。留白运用大胆。现代衬线字体与无衬线字体系统结合。简洁极简设计与大胆编辑个性兼备。Vogue、Porter、Kinfolk 杂志品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 运动品牌视觉大片
entries.description: 运动品牌视觉大片，运动员突破极限的决定性瞬间，燃爆视觉与品牌精神高度融合。
entries.prompt: Create a powerful sports brand campaign visual for elite marathon running. Athlete at peak performance moment — explosive movement frozen in time. Dynamic motion blur on surroundings while face remains sharp. Cinematic dramatic side lighting. Background: stadium lights, urban environment, or natural landscape. Bold brand typography integration. Nike/Adidas epic campaign energy. Push the limit, never surrender spirit. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[运动/品牌]】创作一张强大的运动品牌视觉大片。运动员处于巅峰表现的决定性瞬间——爆发性动作在时间中凝固。周围环境运动模糊而面部保持清晰锐利。电影感戏剧性侧光。背景：体育场灯光、城市环境或自然地景。大胆品牌字体融合。耐克/阿迪达斯史诗广告能量。突破极限，永不放弃的精神。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 精品咖啡品牌视觉
entries.description: 精品咖啡品牌视觉活动，复古插画风格与咖啡产区故事，让每一杯咖啡都有温度。
entries.prompt: Create a specialty coffee brand campaign visual for RITUAL COFFEE ROASTERS. Vintage illustration aesthetic — hand-drawn coffee plant, beans, brewing equipment in a warm editorial illustration. Origin story elements: farmers, mountains, sunrise over plantation. Warm golden-brown and cream color palette. Artisanal letterpress typography. Both product and story communicated. Blue Bottle and Stumptown campaign quality. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[咖啡品牌]】创作一套精品咖啡品牌视觉活动。复古插画美学——手绘咖啡树、咖啡豆、冲煮器具，温暖编辑风插画。产区故事元素：农夫、山峦、庄园日出。温暖金棕色与奶油色调。工匠风格凸版印刷排版。同时传递产品与故事。Blue Bottle 和 Stumptown 活动品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 奢侈品礼品包装设计
entries.description: 奢华礼品包装设计，厚实磨砂纸盒与金箔烫印，未开封时已令人心生期待。
entries.prompt: Create a luxurious gift packaging design for BOTTEGA VENETA. Premium matte black or deep jewel-tone box with embossed gold foil logo and hot-stamped typography. Silk ribbon, tissue paper peek, dried flower detail. Shot on neutral stone or marble surface. Soft diffused studio lighting revealing surface texture. Unboxing experience focus. La Mer, Valmont, Hermès packaging aesthetic. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[品牌]】创作一款奢华礼品包装设计。高端哑光黑色或深宝石色礼盒，配有浮雕金箔 Logo 和烫金字体。丝缎蝴蝶结、露出一角的薄纸、干花细节点缀。置于中性石材或大理石台面拍摄。柔和漫射工作室灯光凸显表面质感。专注开箱体验感。海蓝之谜、维瓦尔特、爱马仕包装美学。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 初创企业品牌视觉形象
entries.description: 现代初创企业品牌视觉形象，干净的Logo标识与品牌应用展示，传递专业与创新力。
entries.prompt: Create a modern startup brand identity showcase for LUMIO — an AI-powered mindfulness journaling app. Clean logo mark centered with strong visual hierarchy. Brand applied to mockups: business card, letterhead, phone screen, tote bag. Cohesive color system — 1 primary, 2 secondary colors. Contemporary sans-serif or geometric typography. White and light grey presentation background. Premium branding agency portfolio quality. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[公司名称/类型]】创作一套现代初创企业品牌视觉形象展示。以清晰视觉层次呈现核心 Logo 标识。品牌应用于实物样机：名片、信头纸、手机屏幕、手提袋。一致的色彩系统——1个主色、2个辅色。现代无衬线或几何字体。白色和浅灰色展示背景。高端品牌顾问公司作品集品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 霓虹水母深海三维
entries.description: 深海霓虹水母三维艺术，生物发光水母群在深蓝海底漂浮，梦幻而神秘的深海奇境。
entries.prompt: Create a magical deep ocean neon jellyfish 3D render. Multiple translucent bioluminescent jellyfish of various sizes floating in dark deep ocean water. Their bodies emit soft glowing neon light: electric blue, magenta, sea-green. Long trailing tentacles with particle effects. Deep dark navy ocean background with subtle light caustics. Ultra-realistic 3D render with painterly atmosphere. Dreamy and otherworldly. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张神奇的深海霓虹水母三维渲染。各种大小的半透明生物发光水母漂浮于深邃幽暗的深海水域。水母身体散发柔和发光的霓虹光芒：电光蓝、品红、海绿。长触须拖曳着粒子效果。深海军蓝海底背景带有微妙焦散光纹。超写实三维渲染搭配绘画般的氛围感。梦幻而超凡脱俗。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 液态金属三维
entries.description: 液态金属三维渲染，水银般的镜面液体凝固成抽象造型，高反光金属的极致视觉表达。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic chrome liquid metal 3D render. Mercury-like liquid metal frozen in a dynamic splash or abstract sculptural form. Perfect mirror chrome material reflecting the environment and studio light. Dramatic key light creating reflective highlights. Dark studio background. The form could be a face, letter, or pure abstract shape. T-1000 Terminator liquid metal aesthetic meets high-end CGI. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张戏剧性的镀铬液态金属三维渲染。类似水银的液态金属凝固于动态飞溅或抽象雕塑形态。完美镜面铬材质反射环境与工作室灯光。戏剧性主光制造反射高光。深色工作室背景。形态可以是人脸、字母或纯抽象造型。终结者T-1000液态金属美学遇上高端CGI。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 充气感三维角色
entries.description: 充气感三维角色，柔软的橡胶气球质感与夸张圆润的比例，呆萌可爱到令人融化。
entries.prompt: Create a trendy inflatable balloon-style 3D character design of a fluffy cloud-shaped teddy bear with sleepy eyes. The character has exaggerated rounded proportions — chubby limbs, oversized head — rendered with soft matte rubber-like balloon material. Subtle highlight streaks. Pastel or bold saturated single color body. Clean white or gradient background. Highly tactile, squeezable aesthetic. Fashion toy meets art toy aesthetic, inspired by KAWS and Bearbrick. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[角色概念]】创作一款时尚充气气球风格三维角色设计。角色拥有夸张圆润的比例——胖乎乎的四肢、超大头部——以柔软哑光橡胶气球材质渲染。微妙的高光条纹。马卡龙或饱和单色身体。干净白色或渐变背景。极具触感的可捏感美学。时尚玩具与艺术玩具美学，受 KAWS 和 Bearbrick 启发。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 微缩地球三维场景
entries.description: 微缩星球三维场景，手掌大小的微型地球漂浮在宇宙中，山川湖海尽在掌中，梦幻可爱。
entries.prompt: Create a charming miniature planet 3D diorama render. A small spherical planet floating in space, hand-sized scale — featuring tiny detailed landscapes: mountains, forests, waterfalls, small houses, clouds. Soft warm studio lighting from above. Deep space gradient background with subtle stars. Tilt-shift focus effect making it look like a tiny toy. Dreamy pastel color palette. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张迷人的微缩星球三维场景渲染。一个悬浮在太空中的小球形星球，手掌大小——包含精细的微型地貌：山脉、森林、瀑布、小房屋、云朵。来自上方的柔和温暖工作室灯光。带有微妙星星的深空渐变背景。移轴模糊效果令其看起来像小玩具。梦幻马卡龙色调。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 霓虹几何三维渲染
entries.description: 霓虹几何三维视觉，发光线框与实体几何体在黑暗中构建虚拟空间，充满数字未来感。
entries.prompt: Create a neon geometric 3D render composition. Multiple platonic solids and parametric shapes — icosahedra, torus, crystals — rendered with glowing neon wireframe edges and subtle volumetric light. Pure black void background. Neon color palette: electric blue, magenta, acid green, white. Bloom and glow effects. Mathematical precision meets futuristic aesthetics. Motion blur on rotating elements. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张霓虹几何三维渲染合成画面。多个柏拉图几何体与参数化造型——二十面体、环形体、水晶——以发光霓虹线框边缘和微妙的体积光渲染。纯黑虚空背景。霓虹色板：电光蓝、品红、荧光绿、白色。光晕与发光效果。数学精度与未来主义美学的碰撞。旋转元素的动态模糊。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 流体玻璃雕塑三维
entries.description: 流体玻璃三维雕塑，液态玻璃凝固于最美的流动瞬间，透明与反射的视觉奇迹。
entries.prompt: Create a stunning glass fluid sculpture 3D render. A single abstract fluid form frozen mid-flow — perhaps twisting ribbons, a breaking wave, or cascading liquid. Perfect photorealistic glass material: caustics, total internal reflection, refraction. Minimalist gradient background (soft dove grey to white). Studio three-point lighting system. Ultra-high quality CGI render. Perfect for product design or art portfolio. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张令人惊叹的流体玻璃雕塑三维渲染。单一抽象流体形态在运动中凝固——扭转的缎带、破碎的浪花或瀑布般的液体。完美的超写实玻璃材质：焦散光、全内反射、折射。极简渐变背景（柔和鸽灰到白色）。三点工作室灯光系统。超高质量 CGI 渲染。完美适用于产品设计或艺术作品集。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 粘土风格室内三维
entries.description: 粘土风格三维室内渲染，圆润柔软的家具与暖色调灯光，梦幻可爱的建筑可视化。
entries.prompt: Create a charming clay render style 3D interior scene for a minimalist Scandinavian living room with a reading nook. All objects have smooth matte clay material with soft round edges — no sharp corners. Minimalist furniture arrangement. Single warm point light source creating gentle soft shadows. Tiny decorative details: small plants, books, geometric objects. Soft pastel color palette. Architectural visualization meets toy world aesthetic. Ultra-clean modern interior. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[房间类型]】创作一张迷人的粘土渲染风格三维室内场景。所有物体都有光滑哑光粘土材质，边角圆润柔软，没有锐角。极简家具布局。单个温暖点光源制造柔和阴影。细小装饰细节：小植物、书籍、几何摆件。柔和马卡龙色调。建筑可视化与玩具世界美学的融合。超级干净的现代室内。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 黑暗哥特吸血鬼
entries.description: 黑暗哥特吸血鬼动漫，古堡夜色中银发贵族优雅而危险，黑暗美学的顶级表达。
entries.prompt: Create a dark gothic vampire anime illustration. Elegant silver-haired vampire nobleman in elaborate Victorian black coat, standing in ancient castle ruins under a full moon. Red eyes glowing with supernatural power. Bats swirling in the moonlit sky. Deep navy and crimson color palette with silver accents. Inspired by Castlevania and Vampire Hunter D visual style. Beautifully detailed dark fantasy anime art. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张黑暗哥特吸血鬼动漫插画。银发优雅吸血鬼贵族，身着精美维多利亚风黑色礼服，站立于满月下的古老城堡废墟中。红色眼睛散发超自然力量的光芒。蝙蝠群在月夜天空中旋绕。深海军蓝与深红色调，银色点缀。受恶魔城与吸血鬼猎人D视觉风格启发。精美细节的黑暗奇幻动漫艺术。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 赛博朋克机器女孩
entries.description: 赛博朋克机器女孩，半透明机械肌肤下流动的数据光流，东方面孔与未来机械完美融合。
entries.prompt: Create a cyberpunk android girl anime illustration. Beautiful female android with partially visible mechanical components beneath translucent synthetic skin. Glowing circuit patterns under skin and in eyes. Rain-soaked neon megacity background. Half-mechanical, half-human aesthetic. Cold blue-purple-magenta color palette. Ghost in the Shell and Blame! visual DNA. Ultra-detailed dark sci-fi anime art. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张赛博朋克机器女孩动漫插画。美丽的女性机器人，半透明合成皮肤下可见部分机械结构。皮肤下和眼中发光的电路纹样。雨水浸透的霓虹大都市背景。半机械半人类美学。冷调蓝紫品红色板。攻壳机动队和BLAME!视觉基因。超细节黑暗科幻动漫艺术。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 温馨咖啡馆动漫场景
entries.description: 治愈系动漫咖啡馆场景，午后阳光透窗、咖啡香气与微笑的女孩，最美好的瞬间凝固在画中。
entries.prompt: Create a cozy cafe anime scene with warm healing aesthetic. Anime girl sitting by a large window seat, afternoon sunlight streaming in creating soft lens flare, floating dust motes. Coffee cup on table, open book, potted plant. Warm wooden cafe interior with fairy lights. Soft color palette: golden amber, warm cream, sage green. Lofi anime aesthetic inspired by Your Name and A Silent Voice. Widescreen ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 以温暖治愈美学创作一张温馨咖啡馆动漫场景。动漫女孩坐在临窗座位，午后阳光斜射进来制造柔和光晕，光尘微粒漂浮。桌上是咖啡杯、翻开的书本、盆栽植物。暖木质咖啡馆内景搭配童话灯串。温暖色调：金琥珀、暖奶油、鼠尾草绿。受你的名字与聲之形动漫美学启发。宽银幕比例 16:9。

entries.title: 月下武士决斗
entries.description: 月下武士对决，水墨与动漫融合，月光与刀光交织，东方武侠气概跃然纸上。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic samurai moonlit duel anime illustration with ink wash aesthetic. Two samurai in silhouette facing off, katana drawn, on a misty mountain cliff under a massive full moon. Ink brush stroke style for trees, grass, and atmosphere. Motion blur on drawn blades. Deep indigo night sky. Inspired by Rurouni Kenshin and Demon Slayer visual style. Epic vertical composition. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 以水墨美学创作一张戏剧性的月下武士决斗动漫插画。两位武士剪影在薄雾弥漫的山崖上对峙，拔刀出鞘，背后是巨大满月。树木、草地和大气感以水墨笔触风格表现。出鞘刀刃的动态模糊。深靛青夜空。受浪客剑心和鬼灭之刃视觉风格启发。史诗竖版构图。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 魔法少女变身
entries.description: 魔法少女变身场景，璀璨魔法光芒、飘扬发丝与闪耀战斗服，经典日本魔法少女动漫美学。
entries.prompt: Create a stunning magical girl (mahou shoujo) transformation scene anime illustration. Young magical heroine mid-transformation: flowing star and heart magical particles swirling around her, battle outfit appearing with ribbons and light, hair swirling outward dramatically. Soft but intense magical sparkle light from all directions. Pastel pink, gold, and sky blue color palette. Sailor Moon and Pretty Cure inspired aesthetic. Vertical poster composition. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张精美的魔法少女变身场景动漫插画。年轻魔法少女处于变身进行时：星形与心形魔法粒子环绕旋转，战斗服与缎带在光芒中显现，秀发戏剧性向外旋舞。来自四面八方的柔和而强烈的魔法闪耀光芒。粉色、金色、天蓝色调。美少女战士与光之美少女美学启发。竖版海报构图。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 日式庭园秋色
entries.description: 日式庭园深秋，枫叶如火燃红，锦鲤划过倒映天空的水面，岁月静好的极致日本美。
entries.prompt: Create a stunning Japanese garden in peak autumn foliage (koyo) photograph. Brilliant red and orange maple (momiji) trees reflected perfectly in a still koi pond. Traditional stone lantern (toro) and curved wooden bridge. Fallen leaves floating on water surface. Overcast soft sky creating even light that makes colors pop. Koi fish visible beneath the reflections. Timeless Japanese garden photography. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张日式庭园红叶（紅葉）盛期的壮美照片。鲜艳的红色与橙色枫树（紅葉）完美倒映在平静的锦鲤池中。传统石灯笼（燈籠）与弧形木桥。飘落的叶片漂浮在水面。阴云柔和天空制造均匀光线令色彩更加饱满。倒影之下可见锦鲤游动。永恒的日本庭园摄影。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 大阪街道黄昏
entries.description: 大阪道顿堀黄昏，霓虹招牌在暮色中渐次亮起，人潮涌动，烟火气与华灯初上共存。
entries.prompt: Create a cinematic Osaka Dotonbori street dusk photograph. The famous neon signs and giant crab/blowfish decorations illuminating the dusk sky. Crowded pedestrian bridge with motion blur crowds. Canal reflections of neon signs in deep blue water. Blue hour sky transitioning to warm neon artificial light. Street food smells implied by steaming yatai stalls. Classic Osaka nightlife energy. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张电影感的大阪道顿堀黄昏街道照片。著名霓虹招牌和巨型螃蟹/河豚装饰在暮色天空中亮起。行人天桥上人潮涌动带有动态模糊。深蓝色运河水面映照霓虹倒影。蓝调时分天空过渡到温暖的霓虹人工光。冒着热气的屋台摊位暗示街头美食气息。经典大阪夜生活能量。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 榻榻米室内晨光
entries.description: 日式和室榻榻米晨光，薄薄的纸门障子透过柔光，草席纹理与寂静空间，侘寂之心。
entries.prompt: Create a minimalist Japanese tatami room (washitsu) morning light photograph. Soft diffused light filtering through shoji paper screens casting gentle grid shadows on tatami grass mats. Perhaps a low chabudai table with a single ceramic tea cup. Scroll or ikebana in tokonoma alcove. Extreme silence, emptiness, and wabi-sabi imperfection. Muted green, grey, warm cream tones. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张极简日式和室榻榻米晨光照片。柔和的漫射光透过障子纸门，在榻榻米草席上投下轻柔的格子阴影。可见一张低矮茶台（ちゃぶ台）上摆着一只陶瓷茶杯。壁龛（床の間）中的挂轴或生花。极度宁静、空灵，带有侘寂的不完美。哑光绿、灰色、温暖奶油色调。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 拉面店蒸汽内景
entries.description: 昭和时代拉面店内景，蒸汽弥漫的吧台旁一碗热拉面，暖黄灯光与陈年木质散发时光气息。
entries.prompt: Create an atmospheric Showa-era Japanese ramen shop interior photograph. Narrow counter with wooden stools, chef behind pass with steaming pots, warm amber incandescent lighting. A perfect bowl of ramen in foreground with rising steam, nori, chashu, soft egg. Aged wood surfaces, vintage Japanese signage, worn patina everywhere. Film grain, warm kodachrome tones. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张充满氛围的昭和时代日本拉面店内景。木制凳子排列的狭长吧台，厨师在蒸腾锅炉后忙碌，温暖的琥珀白炽灯光。近景是一碗冒着热气的完美拉面，点缀海苔、叉烧、溏心蛋。老化木质表面、复古日文招牌、磨损的包浆无处不在。胶片颗粒，温暖柯达彩色调。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 京都舞伎写真
entries.description: 京都舞伎写真，白粉底妆与精致和服，祇园古街青石路，传统美学的极致呈现。
entries.prompt: Create a beautiful Kyoto maiko (apprentice geisha) portrait photograph. Maiko in elaborate kimono with obi sash, traditional white face makeup (oshiroi), decorative kanzashi hair ornaments, and red lipstick. Setting: narrow Gion district stone alley or traditional machiya townhouse entrance. Soft overcast light. Shallow depth of field. Documentary-quality portraiture with fine art aesthetic. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张美丽的京都舞伎（见习艺伎）写真照片。舞伎身着精美和服与大带，传统白粉底妆（白粉），精致发簪（簪），红唇妆。场景：祇园地区狭窄石板小巷或传统町家门口。柔和阴天光线。浅景深。纪录片风格与精细艺术美学兼备。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 枯山水清晨
entries.description: 京都禅院枯山水清晨，耙痕细沙与孤石，第一缕晨光投下长长的影子，无为之境。
entries.prompt: Create a serene Zen karesansui (dry landscape garden) photograph at dawn. Perfectly raked gravel showing precise circular and linear patterns around placed rocks. First light of dawn casting long soft shadows across the raked surface, emphasizing texture. Minimal traditional architecture framing one edge. Cool blue-grey pre-dawn tones warming to soft gold. Extreme stillness and meditative quality. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 拍摄一张宁静的日本枯山水庭园清晨照片。耙梳完美的砾石展现精准的同心圆与直线纹样，环绕摆放的石组。清晨第一缕光线在耙梳表面投下长长的柔和阴影，强调质感。传统建筑檐角裁切一侧边缘。从冷蓝灰的破晓色调渐变为柔和金色。极度宁静、冥想气质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 超写实美食摄影
entries.description: 超写实美食摄影，食材的每个细节都诱人至极，光影与色泽让人垂涎，纯粹的感官享受。
entries.prompt: Create hyperrealistic commercial food photography of a perfect wagyu A5 beef burger with melting aged cheddar. The food is styled to perfection — hero portion at ideal temperature with visible steam, fresh ingredients glistening, sauces glossy, textures exaggerated. Precise overhead or 45-degree angle. Complementary props and surface. Perfect studio strobe lighting with fill. Extreme detail: every grain of salt, sesame seed, herb leaf visible. Michelin-starred restaurant menu quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[菜品/食材]】创作一张超写实商业美食摄影。食物造型完美——主体份量处于理想温度，可见蒸汽，新鲜食材晶莹剔透，酱汁光泽饱满，质感夸张化。精准俯视或45度角构图。搭配互补道具与台面材质。完美工作室闪光灯搭配补光。极致细节：每颗盐粒、芝麻、香草叶清晰可见。米其林星级餐厅菜单品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 香水水晶瓶摄影
entries.description: 香水瓶精品摄影，水晶玻璃折射的彩虹光谱与液体流动的感官之美，触动嗅觉想象。
entries.prompt: Create luxury perfume crystal bottle photography for CHANEL No. 5. Cut crystal perfume bottle as main subject, positioned to create prismatic rainbow light diffraction. Frozen liquid splash around bottle. Background: deep jewel tones (amethyst, sapphire, emerald) with bokeh. Multiple light sources creating internal reflections and refractions. Ultra-luxury cosmetics campaign aesthetics. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[香水品牌]】创作一张奢华香水水晶瓶摄影。切割水晶香水瓶为主体，通过角度设计制造棱镜彩虹光谱散射。瓶身周围凝固的液体飞溅。背景：深宝石色调（紫水晶、蓝宝石、翡翠）搭配虚化光斑。多光源制造内部折射和反射。超级奢华化妆品广告美学。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 球鞋品牌广告大片
entries.description: 球鞋品牌广告大片，动感爆炸式视觉与街头文化能量，将球鞋推上文化符号的神坛。
entries.prompt: Create an epic sneaker brand campaign advertisement for Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG Chicago. Sneaker as hero object floating or in extreme motion, surrounded by explosive visual elements: paint splashes, light trails, particle explosions. Urban concrete environment or pure studio. Cinematic side lighting making shoe materials shine. Bold brand energy — street culture meets high art. Dynamic widescreen composition. Nike/Adidas campaign quality. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 为【[球鞋型号]】创作一张史诗级球鞋品牌广告大片。球鞋作为主角悬浮或处于极限运动中，周围爆发式视觉元素：颜料飞溅、光轨、粒子爆炸。城市混凝土环境或纯净工作室。电影感侧光令鞋身材质熠熠生辉。大胆品牌能量——街头文化与高艺术的碰撞。动感宽银幕构图。耐克/阿迪达斯广告级品质。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 科技产品爆炸分解图
entries.description: 科技产品爆炸图，各零部件在空间中精准悬浮展开，极客美学与工程精密完美融合。
entries.prompt: Create a precision technical exploded view product visualization of premium wireless noise-canceling over-ear headphones. All components floating in perfect geometric separation — showing internal architecture clearly. Clinical white or pure black background. Each component casts clean drop shadow. Fine grid or guide lines connecting parts. Blueprint or CAD rendering aesthetic with premium product photography quality. Color accent highlighting key innovation. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张【[科技产品]】的精准技术爆炸分解图产品可视化。所有部件以完美几何间距悬浮展开，清晰展示内部结构。纯白或纯黑背景。每个部件投射干净的投影。细线或引导线连接部件。蓝图/CAD 渲染美学与优质产品摄影品质结合。关键创新部件的色彩高光。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 红酒瓶编辑摄影
entries.description: 高端红酒编辑摄影，橡木、葡萄藤与自然光共同讲述产区故事，品味与情调兼得。
entries.prompt: Create editorial wine bottle photography for Château Margaux 2018 Grand Cru. Wine bottle as hero, shot in vineyard or rustic wine cellar setting. Supporting elements: oak barrel staves, terracotta, weathered wood, wine glass with deep ruby color. Dramatic raking natural light through vineyard leaves. Moody warm color grade — burnt amber, terracotta, deep burgundy. Storytelling product photography with sense of place. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[红酒品牌/庄园]】创作一张编辑风红酒瓶摄影。红酒瓶为主角，在葡萄园或质朴酒窖场景中拍摄。辅助元素：橡木桶板条、赤陶、风化木材、盛有深红宝石色的酒杯。葡萄叶间戏剧性斜射自然光。温暖低沉色调——焦琥珀、赤陶、深酒红。带有地域感的故事性产品摄影。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 建筑感腕表广告大片
entries.description: 腕表广告大片，建筑线条与精密机芯相呼应，冷调金属光影彰显顶级制表工艺。
entries.prompt: Create a high-end architectural watch advertisement for PATEK PHILIPPE Nautilus 5711. The timepiece floats in a dramatic architectural space — marble columns, steel grid ceiling, or brutalist concrete. Single dramatic spotlight creates razor-sharp shadow geometry. Watch reflection in polished surface. Cold steel-blue color grade with warm gold dial glow. Monochrome palette with metallic accents. Swiss luxury watch campaign quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 为【[腕表品牌]】创作一张高端建筑感腕表广告。腕表漂浮于戏剧性建筑空间中——大理石廊柱、钢制网格天花板或野兽主义混凝土。单束戏剧性聚光灯制造锋利阴影几何。腕表在抛光表面的倒影。冷钢蓝色调搭配温暖金色表盘光芒。单色系搭配金属点缀。瑞士奢侈腕表广告品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 珠宝微距摄影
entries.description: 极致精细的珠宝微距摄影，宝石切割面与金属纹理在光线下熠熠生辉，奢华无言。
entries.prompt: Create ultra-fine jewelry macro photography of a 3-carat oval diamond engagement ring with platinum pavé band. Extreme close-up revealing every facet of precious gemstones and intricate metalwork detail. Multiple directional light sources creating fire and brilliance in stones. Perfect focus throughout — micro-precision rendering of prong settings, engraving, surface texture. Dark velvet or mirrored background. Commercial jewelry advertisement quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张【[珠宝名称]】的极致精细珠宝微距摄影。超级近景揭示宝石每一个切割面和精细金属工艺细节。多方向光源在宝石中制造光火与闪耀。完美对焦，微米级精确渲染爪镶、雕刻、表面肌理。深色天鹅绒或镜面背景。商业珠宝广告品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 茶道产品摄影
entries.description: 东方茶道美学产品摄影，自然质感道具衬托茶器之美，空灵禅意与东方留白哲学。
entries.prompt: Create a minimalist Japanese tea ceremony product photography for Japanese ceremonial-grade Matcha powder. Handmade ceramic tea vessel as hero product on raw linen or slate surface. Supporting props: bamboo whisk, small stone, fresh tea leaves, morning steam. Soft diffused natural window light from one side. Extreme minimalism — maximum 4 elements. Wabi-sabi imperfection in ceramics. Neutral warm palette: cream, slate, forest green. Editorial still-life quality. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 为【[茶品]】创作一张极简日本茶道产品摄影。手工陶瓷茶器作为主产品，置于原色亚麻或石板表面。辅助道具：竹制茶筅、小石头、新鲜茶叶、晨雾蒸汽。单侧柔和自然窗光。极致简约，最多4个元素。陶器的侘寂不完美感。中性暖色调：奶油色、石板灰、森林绿。精品静物摄影品质。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 烟雾艺术人像
entries.description: 彩色烟雾萦绕的创意人像，人物从烟雾中若隐若现，神秘而有力的视觉语言。
entries.prompt: Create a dramatic smoke art portrait with a confident young woman surrounded by vibrant colored smoke. Multiple bold smoke colors — deep red, electric blue, golden yellow — swirling and interacting around a confident figure. Strong side studio lighting creates sharp face definition against smoke chaos. Black studio background. The smoke appears as natural fabric flowing from the subject. Fine art portrait photography with painterly quality. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张戏剧性的彩色烟雾艺术人像，【[主题]】人物被鲜艳彩色烟雾环绕。多种大胆烟雾色彩——深红、电光蓝、金黄——在自信的人物周围旋绕交织。强侧面工作室灯光在烟雾混沌中勾勒出清晰面部轮廓。黑色工作室背景。烟雾如同从人物身上流淌出的天然织物。兼具绘画质感的精细艺术肖像摄影。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 黄金时段剪影人像
entries.description: 黄金时段剪影摄影，人物轮廓在橙金落日中化为诗意剪影，温度、情绪与光同在。
entries.prompt: Create a stunning golden hour silhouette portrait of a woman with long flowing hair standing on a coastal cliff against a breathtaking sunset sky. Figure completely silhouetted against blazing orange-gold horizon. Dramatic sky with streaks of magenta, purple and gold. Possible location: hilltop, beach, rooftop, field. Long shadows and warm dust particles in air. Slightly underexposed silhouette preserving sky drama. Fine art landscape-portrait hybrid. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张令人惊叹的黄金时段剪影人像，【[主题]】的人物剪影映衬在壮观的落日天空中。人物轮廓完全剪影化，对抗燃烧般橙金色地平线。戏剧性天空带有品红、紫色和金色的条纹。可选场景：山顶、海滩、屋顶、田野。空气中的长条阴影与温暖尘埃颗粒。略微欠曝的剪影保留天空的戏剧张力。精细艺术风景-人像混合摄影。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 霓虹艺术面孔
entries.description: 霓虹彩绘艺术人像，荧光颜料在暗室中发光，前卫的艺术妆容将人脸变为发光画布。
entries.prompt: Create an artistic neon UV body/face paint portrait. Model's face and neck covered in intricate fluorescent neon body art — geometric patterns, tribal-inspired designs, or floral motifs glowing under UV black light. Pure black background making neon colors explode: electric blue, magenta, lime green, orange. Studio beauty photography meets fine art body painting. Close-up or half-body composition. Ratio 1:1.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张紫外线荧光体彩/面部彩绘艺术人像。模特面部和颈部覆盖着精美的霓虹荧光彩绘——几何图案、部落风设计或花卉图腾在紫外光下发光。纯黑背景让霓虹色彩爆炸般呈现：电光蓝、品红、荧光绿、橙色。工作室美妆摄影与精细艺术彩绘的结合。近景或半身构图。比例 1:1。

entries.title: 迷雾森林人像
entries.description: 神秘迷雾森林人像，晨曦穿透林间薄雾，人物融于自然，宛如古老传说中的林中精灵。
entries.prompt: Create a mystical fog forest portrait of a figure standing in an ancient woodland. Dense morning mist weaving through old-growth trees, shafts of golden light piercing through fog. Figure appears to merge with the forest — wearing earthy tones, possibly with floral or botanical details. Moody cinematic color grade: desaturated greens, cool shadows, warm rim light. Fine art portrait photography quality. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh: 创作一张人物站立于古老林地中的神秘迷雾森林人像。浓厚晨雾穿越苍老大树，金色光柱穿透薄雾射下。人物与森林融为一体，身着大地色系服装，带有花卉或植物细节。电影质感色调：去饱和绿色、冷调阴影、温暖轮廓光。精细艺术摄影人像品质。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 儿童绘本封面
entries.description: 温暖治愈的儿童绘本封面，圆润可爱的角色与魔法世界，笔触柔软，充满纯真童趣。
entries.prompt: Create a charming children's picture book cover illustration featuring a tiny fox who collects fallen stars in a glass jar. Warm, inviting painterly style with soft rounded shapes and friendly character design. Gentle watercolor-gouache textures. Magical enchanted setting: cozy forest, candy-colored village, or storybook cottage. Warm golden light and soft shadow. Pastel and warm earth tone palette. Title space at top or bottom. Award-winning picture book quality (Caldecott style). Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 创作一幅温馨可爱的儿童绘本封面插画，主题为【[角色/故事]】。温暖、迷人的绘画风格，圆润造型与友善角色设计。柔和的水粉-水彩笔触。魔法童话场景：温馨森林、糖果小镇或故事书小屋。温暖金色光线与柔和阴影。马卡龙色系搭配暖大地色调。预留标题位置。凯迪克奖级儿童绘本品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 太空探索插画
entries.description: 史诗级太空探索视觉，宇航员站立于外星地表，宇宙飞船与星云共同构成壮美宇宙史诗。
entries.prompt: Create an epic space exploration illustration featuring first human landing on Europa, Jupiter's icy moon. Astronaut or spacecraft on alien planetary surface with dramatic alien landscape — crystal formations, twin moons, rings, unusual terrain. Deep space nebula backdrop in rich purples and golds. Cinematic widescreen composition. Rendered in retro-futuristic NASA concept art style, combining photorealism with illustrated atmosphere. Awe-inspiring sense of cosmic scale. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 创作一幅史诗级太空探索插画，主题为【[场景/任务]】。宇航员或飞船降落于外星地表，奇异地貌——水晶地形、双月、星环、异色地面。背景为紫金色浓郁的深空星云。宽银幕电影构图。复古未来主义 NASA 概念艺术风格，融合超写实与插画大气感。令人窒息的宇宙宏大尺度。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 民俗节庆插画
entries.description: 中国传统民俗节庆插画，剪纸与年画风格，喜庆色彩与吉祥图腾，传承民间艺术精髓。
entries.prompt: Create a Chinese folk art festival illustration celebrating Spring Festival — Year of the Dragon. Inspired by paper cutting (jianzhi), New Year woodblock prints (nianhua), and traditional embroidery patterns. Symmetrical composition with auspicious symbols: fish, peony, phoenix, red lanterns. Bold flat colors in vermilion, gold, jade green, and bright yellow. Hand-crafted decorative border. Joyful festive energy. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 创作一幅中国民俗节庆插画，主题为【[节日/活动]】。汲取剪纸、年画木版印刷和传统刺绣纹样的灵感。对称构图，融入吉祥图腾：鱼、牡丹、凤凰、红灯笼。朱砂红、金色、翠绿、明黄的大胆平面色彩。手工感装饰边框。洋溢喜庆节日气氛。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 超现实梦境插画
entries.description: 达利风格超现实主义插画，物理规则被颠覆，漂浮岛屿与熔融时钟共存于梦境空间。
entries.prompt: Create a surrealist dreamscape illustration inspired by Dalí and Magritte for the sensation of falling upward through infinite golden skies. Physics defying impossible space: floating islands and staircases, melting objects, scale inversions, open sky within closed rooms. Photorealistic rendering of impossible combinations. Dramatic lighting with long shadows. Dreamlike color palette: warm golden light, deep cerulean shadows, impossible vistas. Fine art oil painting quality. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh: 以达利和马格利特为灵感，创作一幅超现实梦境插画，主题为【[主题]】。违背物理法则的不可能空间：漂浮岛屿与楼梯、熔化物体、比例颠倒、密室中打开的天空。对不可能的组合进行超写实渲染。戏剧性光影与长条阴影。梦境色调：温暖金色光线、深群青阴影、奇异远景。精细油画品质。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 像素艺术城市夜景
entries.description: 复古像素艺术城市夜景，32位游戏美学，霓虹窗格与像素月亮，带来满满怀旧感。
entries.prompt: Create a detailed pixel art cityscape at night in classic 32-bit retro game aesthetic. Isometric or side-scrolling perspective of a dense futuristic city with glowing neon windows, pixel moon and stars, flying vehicles. Rich atmospheric depth with foreground buildings silhouette. Limited but carefully chosen color palette of deep navy, neon cyan, hot pink, warm amber. Nostalgic 1990s JRPG visual novel style. Ratio 16:9.
entries.promptZh: 以32位复古游戏美学绘制一幅详细的像素艺术城市夜景。等距或横版视角的密集未来城市，带有发光霓虹窗格、像素月亮与星星、飞行载具。前景建筑剪影营造大气纵深感。有限但精心选择的色板：深海军蓝、霓虹青、亮粉、暖琥珀。1990年代 JRPG 视觉小说风格。比例 16:9。

entries.title: 植物科学插画
entries.description: 18世纪博物馆级植物手绘插画，精细解剖细节与科学标注，兼具艺术美感与学术价值。
entries.prompt: Create a museum-quality botanical scientific illustration of Passiflora caerulea (Blue Passionflower). 18th century naturalist style with meticulous hand-drawn details showing leaves, stems, roots, flowers, seeds and cross-sections. Clean off-white parchment background. Precise watercolor and ink rendering with Latin scientific annotations and detailed labels. Scale ruler and specimen numbering. Royal Botanical Gardens archive quality. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 绘制一幅博物馆级植物科学插画，描绘【[植物名称]】。18世纪博物学家风格，精细手绘展示叶片、茎、根、花、种子及横截面。干净的羊皮纸底色。精准的水彩与钢笔渲染，附拉丁文学名标注和详细标签。附比例尺和标本编号。皇家植物园档案级品质。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 街头涂鸦艺术海报
entries.description: 城市街头涂鸦文化视觉，喷漆质感、野生风格字母与墙面纹理，真实城市气息。
entries.prompt: Create a street graffiti art poster for DREAM HIGHER. Wild style graffiti lettering as dominant visual element, multiple overlapping spray-paint colors with realistic drips and overspray. Concrete or brick wall texture background. Sticker and wheat-paste collage layers. Urban tags and doodles. Bold street culture energy. Colors: vibrant spray paint in electric blue, hot pink, yellow, black outlines. Documentary-style authenticity. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[艺术家/信息]】创作一张街头涂鸦艺术海报。以野性风格涂鸦字母为主视觉，多色喷漆叠加，带有逼真的喷漆流滴与过喷效果。混凝土或砖墙纹理背景。贴纸与浮贴海报叠层。城市标记与涂鸦细节。强烈的街头文化能量。配色：荧光蓝、玫红、黄色、黑色描边。真实街头风格。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 极简奥运运动海报
entries.description: 简约运动竞技海报，几何化运动人体剪影与动感线条，传递力量与速度。
entries.prompt: Design a minimal Olympic sports poster for 100m Sprint. Geometric abstraction of athletic human figure in peak motion — simplified to essential lines and planes. Bold single accent color (deep red or cobalt blue) against white background. Strong diagonal composition expressing speed and power. Clean sans-serif event title. Simple year and location text. Swiss-inspired sports graphic design. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh: 为【[运动项目]】设计一张极简奥运运动海报。将运动员巅峰状态的人体几何化抽象，简化为线条与平面的本质。白色背景上使用单一强调色（深红或钴蓝）。强烈的斜向构图传递速度与力量。简洁无衬线字体呈现活动标题、年份和城市。瑞士风格运动平面设计。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 新艺术运动装饰海报
entries.description: 穆夏风格装饰海报，流动曲线、女神人物与植物纹样框架，金色细腻，永恒之美。
entries.prompt: Create an Art Nouveau decorative poster in Alphonse Mucha style for a goddess of spring surrounded by wisteria and cherry blossoms. Central goddess or female figure surrounded by elaborate botanical and floral ornamental border frame. Flowing organic lines and whiplash curves. Soft muted palette with gold accents, sage green, dusky rose, cream. Intricate circular halo or arch above figure. Elegant serif lettering integrated into floral frame. Fine lithographic print quality. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh: 以阿尔丰斯·穆夏风格设计一张新艺术运动装饰海报，主题为【[主题]】。中心为女神或女性人物，周围环绕精美植物与花卉装饰边框。流动的有机线条与鞭形曲线。柔和哑光色调搭配金色点缀，鼠尾草绿、暮玫瑰、奶油色。人物头顶精美圆形光环或拱形。优雅的衬线字体融入花卉边框。石版印刷般精细质感。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 霓虹电音派对海报
entries.description: 地下电子音乐派对视觉，霓虹激光束、失真人脸与赛博朋克字体营造疯狂夜晚氛围。
entries.prompt: Design a neon rave party poster for HYPERWAVE — Underground Rave Berlin. Pitch black background with explosive neon laser light beams in magenta, cyan and acid green. Glitched distorted face or figure as focal point. Grunge cyber typography with chromatic aberration effects. Halftone dots and scan-line overlays. Underground nightclub energy, illegal rave aesthetic. Bold EVENT NAME with glow and blur. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 为【[活动名称]】设计一张霓虹电音派对海报。纯黑背景，品红、青色、荧光绿霓虹激光爆射。故障失真人脸或人形作为核心视觉。带色差效果的垃圾字体赛博风排版，叠加半调网点和扫描线。营造地下夜店的狂热氛围。活动名称以发光模糊效果呈现。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 瑞士风格平面设计海报
entries.description: 国际主义风格海报，严格网格系统、无衬线字体与几何色块，彰显功能主义设计美学。
entries.prompt: Create a Swiss International Typographic Style poster for Bauhaus Architecture — 100 Years Exhibition. Strict mathematical grid system with clean geometric composition. Bold primary colors: red, black, white with minimal accents. Helvetica or Akzidenz-Grotesk style sans-serif typography at multiple scales, flush-left alignment. Strong diagonal or horizontal axis. Photography or geometric shapes cropped to grid. No decoration — pure function. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 以瑞士国际主义字体风格设计一张海报，主题为【[主题]】。运用严格的数学网格系统构图。大胆使用原色：红、黑、白，极少点缀。以 Helvetica 或 Akzidenz-Grotesk 无衬线字体排版，多级字号、左对齐。强烈的斜向或水平轴线。摄影或几何图形按网格裁剪。去除一切装饰，追求纯粹功能主义。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 复古演唱会海报
entries.description: 70-80年代摇滚演唱会海报风格，手工印刷质感、失真字体与复古插画完美融合。
entries.prompt: Create a vintage concert poster for MIDNIGHT ECHOES — World Tour 1978 in classic 1970s-80s rock poster style. Hand-printed letterpress texture with visible ink registration misalignment. Psychedelic or Art Deco hand-drawn illustration as centerpiece. Distressed, layered typography using condensed and decorative fonts. Color palette: warm offset printing with muted yellows, deep reds, burnt orange and cream. Paper grain and aging texture throughout. Event details integrated into the illustration. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh: 设计一张复古演唱会海报，主题为【[艺人/活动]】，呈现1970-80年代摇滚海报经典风格。运用手工印刷凸版纹理，带有可见的油墨套印偏差。以迷幻或装饰艺术风格的手绘插画为核心视觉。使用紧缩字体和装饰字体，模拟层叠排印效果。配色方案：胶印风格的哑光黄、深红、焦橙和奶油色。整体带有纸张颗粒感和岁月做旧肌理，活动信息融入插画之中。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 日落双重曝光人像
entries.description: 人像轮廓与日落海滩双重曝光，橙金色波浪融入发丝，沙滩椰林叠加面部，诗意而浪漫。
entries.prompt: Beautiful double exposure portrait blending a {argument name="subject" default="young woman's silhouette"} with a {argument name="landscape" default="tropical beach at golden sunset"}. The beach scene — warm orange waves, palm trees, sun on horizon — is seamlessly integrated within the portrait silhouette. Waves appear to flow through the hair. Palm fronds overlap the facial features. The outer edge of the silhouette remains sharp while the landscape fills within. Color palette: warm golds, deep oranges, soft coral, creamy skin tones. Romantic and poetic atmosphere. High contrast where silhouette meets white background. Fine art photography style.
entries.promptZh: 将【{argument name="subject" default="年轻女性剪影"}】与【{argument name="landscape" default="金色日落热带海滩"}】无缝融合的双重曝光人像。海滩场景——温暖橙色海浪、椰子树、地平线上的太阳——无缝融合于人像轮廓之内。海浪仿佛在发丝中流动。棕榈叶与面部特征叠加。轮廓外缘保持清晰，景观填充其内。调色板：温暖金色、深橙色、柔珊瑚色、奶油肤色。浪漫而诗意的氛围。轮廓与白色背景交界处高对比度。美术摄影风格。

entries.title: 夜市街头写真
entries.description: 亚洲夜市霓虹氛围，红发女孩置身街头小摊之间，暖黄灯光与霓虹混搭，纪实街头摄影风格。
entries.prompt: Street photography portrait at a vibrant Asian night market. Subject: a young woman with {argument name="hair" default="striking dyed red hair"}, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="vintage band tee and high-waisted jeans"}. She is surrounded by night market food stalls with warm glowing lanterns and neon signage in Chinese characters. Mixed lighting: warm incandescent from stalls, cool neon accents. Crowd blurred in background through slow shutter. Authentic documentary street photography — slightly gritty, real, alive. 35mm f/2, high ISO grain visible. The energy of the night market frames her perfectly. 2:3 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 充满活力的亚洲夜市街头摄影人像。拍摄对象：一位拥有【{argument name="hair" default="醒目染色红发"}】的年轻女性，身穿【{argument name="outfit" default="复古乐队 T 恤和高腰牛仔裤"}】。她置身于夜市小摊之间，暖光灯笼和中文霓虹招牌环绕。混合光线：摊位的暖白炽灯与冷色霓虹点缀。慢快门将背景人群虚化。真实纪录片式街头摄影——略有粗粝感、真实、充满活力。35mm f/2，高感光度颗粒清晰可见。夜市的生命力将她完美衬托。2:3 竖幅。

entries.title: 废土幸存者电影静帧
entries.description: 末世废土世界电影级画面，幸存者站在荒芜景观中，电影胶片颗粒感，戏剧性背光，IMAX 宽…
entries.prompt: Cinematic film still from a post-apocalyptic wasteland movie. {argument name="character" default="A lone female survivor"} wearing tactical gear and a {argument name="item" default="weathered long coat"}, standing in a vast desolate landscape. Ruined city silhouette in background. Dramatic backlight from setting sun creating silhouette effect. Dust particles floating in air. Color grade: desaturated, pushed yellows and oranges in shadows. Heavy film grain. IMAX 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen. Cinematic atmosphere. The character feels small against the epic ruined world. High production value movie still quality.
entries.promptZh: 末世废土题材电影的电影级静帧。【{argument name="character" default="孤独的女性幸存者"}】身穿战术装备和【{argument name="item" default="风化长款外套"}】，站在辽阔荒芜的景观中。背景有废墟城市剪影。落日的戏剧性背光制造剪影效果。空气中漂浮的尘埃颗粒。色彩调色：去饱和，阴影中推黄橙色调。浓重胶片颗粒。IMAX 2.39:1 变形宽幅。电影氛围感。在史诗废墟世界中，角色显得渺小。高制作价值电影级画面质量。

entries.title: 健康生活拼图
entries.description: 网格拼贴展现健康生活方式，瑜伽、蔬果、冥想场景，莫兰迪色系，clean girl 美学…
entries.prompt: Aesthetic wellness and healthy lifestyle mood board collage in a clean grid layout. {argument name="grid" default="9 squares, 3x3"}. Content includes: morning yoga pose in golden light, vibrant green smoothie bowl with toppings, hands holding crystal or journal, fresh produce arrangement, minimalist bathroom ritual, aerial view of workout clothes laid flat. Color palette: muted earthy tones — sage green, warm cream, terracotta, dusty pink. Clean girl aesthetic. Each panel has consistent soft lighting. Instagram-worthy flat lay and lifestyle photography style. Delicate typography labels optional.
entries.promptZh: 干净网格排版的健康生活方式情绪板拼贴画。【{argument name="grid" default="九宫格，3x3 排列"}】。内容包含：黄金时刻清晨瑜伽姿势、点缀配料的鲜绿色冰沙碗、手持水晶或日记本、新鲜农产品造型排列、极简浴室护肤仪式、俯拍运动服装平铺。调色板：柔和大地色调——鼠尾草绿、温暖米白、赭土色、藕粉色。Clean girl 美学。每格均有统一柔和光线。Instagram 美观的平铺和生活方式摄影风格。可选精致排版标签。

entries.title: 遮挡水疗美颜人像
entries.description: 创意遮挡美妆人像，面部被花朵或薄纱半遮，水疗护肤氛围，极简留白，神秘高级感。
entries.prompt: Creative beauty portrait with {argument name="obstruction" default="fresh white magnolia branches"} partially covering the face. Woman with perfect luminous skin and no-makeup makeup look. Only eyes and forehead or lower face visible. Spa and skincare aesthetic — clean, pure, serene. Pure white or soft cream background. Soft studio lighting, no harsh shadows. The obstruction element interacts beautifully with the subject. Botanical, ethereal, high-end beauty campaign feel. Shot on 100mm macro lens for skin detail. Minimalist composition with strong negative space.
entries.promptZh: 创意美妆人像，【{argument name="obstruction" default="新鲜白色玉兰花枝"}】部分遮挡面部。女性拥有完美发光肌肤，裸妆感。仅可见眼睛和额头或下半脸。水疗与护肤美学——清洁、纯净、宁静。纯白或柔和奶油色背景。柔和摄影棚灯光，无强硬阴影。遮挡元素与主体产生美丽互动。植物性、空灵、高端美妆大片感。100mm 微距镜头拍摄皮肤细节。极简构图配大量负空间。

entries.title: 粉发清晨人像
entries.description: 清晨柔光粉发美女写真，床边窗光，睡眼朦胧，薄纱睡衣，亲密感胶片氛围，韩系杂志美感。
entries.prompt: Intimate morning portrait of a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="soft pastel pink hair"} waking up in soft morning light. She is wearing a delicate white cotton or silk slip. Sitting beside a window with diffused morning light casting soft shadows. Dreamy, slightly unfocused gaze — half-awake expression. Delicate skin texture visible. Background: soft linen bedding, dried flowers on nightstand. Shot on film — warm, slightly desaturated, Kodak Portra aesthetic. Gentle backlighting creating halo effect around hair. Intimate, editorial, quiet morning mood. 4:5 vertical portrait.
