entries.promptZh: 年轻女性【{argument name="hair color" default="柔和淡粉色头发"}】的亲密清晨人像，在柔和晨光中醒来。她身穿精致白色棉质或丝绸吊带裙。坐在窗边，散漫晨光投下柔和阴影。梦幻、略微失焦的凝视——半梦半醒的表情。可见精致肌肤质感。背景：柔软麻布床单，床头柜上的干花。胶片拍摄——温暖，略微去饱和，柯达 Portra 美学。柔和背光在发丝周围形成光晕。亲密感、编辑风、静谧清晨氛围。4:5 竖幅人像。

entries.title: 博物馆风格解构信息图
entries.description: 中国博物馆展品风格，将日常物品拆解为解构信息图，繁体标注、印章、仿古纸质感，知识性与美…
entries.prompt: Chinese museum collection style deconstruction infographic of {argument name="subject" default="a traditional tea set"}. Rendered as if it were a museum display with detailed anatomical breakdown. White or aged parchment background. Traditional Chinese ink illustration style with fine line work. Numbered callouts in classical Chinese typography. Official museum seal stamp in red. Annotation in both classical Chinese and modern characters. Top classification header in museum catalog style. The object is shown from multiple angles — front, side, cross-section. Scholarly and artistic simultaneously. Gold foil accent details.
entries.promptZh: 中国博物馆藏品风格解构信息图，主题为【{argument name="subject" default="传统茶具"}】。以博物馆展示方式呈现，含详细解剖分解。白色或仿古羊皮纸背景。传统中国水墨插画风格，细腻线条。古典中文排版的编号标注。红色官方博物馆印章。古典汉字与现代字体双语标注。顶部博物馆图录风格分类标题。从多角度展示物件——正面、侧面、剖面。学术性与艺术性并存。金箔装饰细节。

entries.title: 日式早餐俯拍
entries.description: 完美日式早餐俯拍，白瓷器与木质托盘，清晨侧光，食物造型精致，简约留白美学。
entries.prompt: Perfect overhead flat lay of traditional Japanese breakfast. On a {argument name="surface" default="weathered wooden tray"}:  steaming bowl of white rice, miso soup with tofu and wakame, grilled salmon fillet with crispy skin, tamagoyaki rolled omelette, small dishes of pickled vegetables, a cup of green tea. White ceramic tableware with subtle texture. Soft morning side light from window creating gentle shadows. Minimal negative space. Tiny drops of condensation on tea cup. Food styling: precise, authentic, restaurant-quality. Shot from directly above with 50mm equivalent. Muted, warm tones. Japanese culinary aesthetics.
entries.promptZh: 完美的日式早餐俯拍平铺。在【{argument name="surface" default="风化木质托盘"}】上：冒热气的白米饭碗、豆腐裙带菜味噌汤、香脆烤三文鱼柳、玉子烧卷、小碟腌渍蔬菜、一杯绿茶。带有细微质感的白色陶瓷餐具。窗户透入柔和晨光制造轻盈阴影。留有精致负空间。茶杯上的细小水珠。食物造型：精确、正宗、餐厅级品质。50mm 等效镜头从正上方拍摄。柔和暖调。日本饮食美学。

entries.title: 融化冰淇淋夏日写真
entries.description: 夏日阳光下，金发少女手持融化的冰淇淋甜筒，Kodak 胶片粒感，复古滤镜，年轻活力的夏…
entries.prompt: Playful summer portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a blonde girl"} holding a dripping melting {argument name="ice cream" default="rainbow sherbet ice cream cone"} in bright summer sunlight. Melted ice cream dripping down her fingers and wrist. She's wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a pastel yellow sundress"}. Squinting joyfully in the sun. Bright, overexposed summer light. Shooting on Kodak Portra 400 film, vintage color grading, slight grain. Warm golden tones. Candid carefree teenage energy. Blurred summer background — beach or garden. 4:5 vertical.
entries.promptZh: 【{argument name="subject" default="金发女孩"}】手持融化的【{argument name="ice cream" default="彩虹雪葩冰淇淋甜筒"}】的趣味夏日写真，在明媚夏日阳光下拍摄。融化的冰淇淋沿手指和手腕滴落。她穿着【{argument name="outfit" default="淡黄色阳光裙"}】。在阳光下眯眼欢笑。明亮、过曝的夏日光线。使用柯达 Portra 400 胶片拍摄，复古色彩调色，轻微颗粒感。温暖的金色调。随性自由的青春气息。模糊的夏日背景——海滩或花园。4:5 竖幅。

entries.title: 电影级奢华产品广告
entries.description: 电影感奢华产品广告，黑色天鹅绒背景，戏剧性侧光打亮产品，金属质感，品牌大片氛围。
entries.prompt: Cinematic luxury product advertisement for {argument name="product" default="premium potato chips in golden bag"}. Ultra-dramatic studio lighting from single directional source creating deep shadows. Dark rich background — {argument name="background" default="black velvet texture"}. Product shown at dynamic angle with falling {argument name="elements" default="crispy chips"} frozen in motion. Premium metallic reflections and textures. Extreme close-up details. Color palette: deep black with {argument name="accent" default="gold and warm amber"} accents. Luxury brand aesthetic. Shot as if for a cinema commercial. High dynamic range, photorealistic.
entries.promptZh: 为【{argument name="product" default="金色包装高端薯片"}】制作的电影级奢华产品广告。来自单一方向光源的超戏剧性摄影棚灯光，制造深邃阴影。深邃富有质感的背景——【{argument name="background" default="黑色天鹅绒质感"}】。产品以动态角度呈现，【{argument name="elements" default="香脆薯片"}】定格飞溅瞬间。高端金属反射与质感。极致特写细节。调色板：深黑底色搭配【{argument name="accent" default="金色和暖琥珀色"}】点缀。奢华品牌美学。如同电影广告风格拍摄。高动态范围，照片级真实感。

entries.title: 动漫涂装列车
entries.description: 高速列车全身动漫涂装，樱花与机甲风格交织，山岳背景，日本铁道美学，品牌设计与动漫融合。
entries.prompt: Japanese bullet train (Shinkansen) with full-body anime character vinyl wrap design. The train exterior features {argument name="anime character" default="a magical girl anime character"} illustration in vibrant colors, cherry blossoms and dynamic action lines. Mountain and blue sky background. The train is shot from a three-quarter angle showing the full length. Detailed realistic train photography with anime illustration overlay. Brand logo placement on nose. Dynamic speed lines. Japanese typography on side panels. Ultra-detailed, cinematic photography + illustration hybrid, 16:9 wide format.
entries.promptZh: 日本新干线高速列车全车身动漫角色涂装设计。列车外观印有【{argument name="anime character" default="魔法少女动漫角色"}】插画，色彩鲜艳，搭配樱花和动感线条。山脉与蓝天背景。列车从四分之三角度拍摄，展示全长车身。详细真实列车摄影与动漫插画叠加。车头部位品牌 Logo 布置。动感速度线条。侧面板日文排版。超高细节，电影摄影与插画混合风格，16:9 宽幅格式。

entries.title: 洋甘菊美妆人像
entries.description: 户外黄金时刻美妆写真，洋甘菊花环点缀，透明感水光肌，自然散景背景，韩系清新美妆风格。
entries.prompt: Soft beauty portrait with natural makeup and chamomile floral styling. Young woman with {argument name="complexion" default="dewy glass skin"} and subtle natural makeup — soft pink lips, gentle blush, luminous base. Small chamomile flowers woven into {argument name="hair style" default="loosely braided hair"}. Warm afternoon golden hour light creating soft lens flare. Shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh background of wildflower meadow. Slight overexposed dreamy feel. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, medium format aesthetic. Clean, fresh, natural beauty editorial. Soft pastel tones, no harsh shadows.
entries.promptZh: 柔和美妆人像，自然妆容搭配洋甘菊花卉造型。年轻女性拥有【{argument name="complexion" default="水光玻璃肌"}】，搭配淡雅自然妆容——柔粉嘴唇、轻柔腮红、发光底妆。小洋甘菊花朵编入【{argument name="hair style" default="松散编发"}】中。温暖午后黄金时刻光线制造柔和镜头眩光。浅景深搭配奶油感野花草地虚化背景。轻微过曝的梦幻感。85mm f/1.4 拍摄，中画幅美学。清爽自然美妆编辑风格。柔和粉彩色调，无硬阴影。

entries.title: 极简排版旅行海报
entries.description: 建筑摄影与极简瑞士排版融合，地标剪影与大字体标题，简洁留白传递旅行诗意。
entries.prompt: Elegant minimal travel poster for {argument name="destination" default="Kyoto, Japan"}. Photography-meets-typography design: large serif or geometric sans-serif destination name dominating 40% of the poster. Clean architectural or landscape photograph {argument name="image style" default="golden hour temple reflection"} in muted tones. Swiss-influenced grid layout with precise alignment. Accent color: {argument name="color" default="deep terracotta"}. Small supporting text — elevation, coordinates, tagline. Generous white space. Print-ready aesthetic. Modern heritage feel, art gallery poster quality.
entries.promptZh: 为【{argument name="destination" default="日本京都"}】设计的优雅极简旅行海报。摄影与排版融合设计：巨大衬线字体或几何无衬线字体的目的地名称占据海报40%。使用柔和色调的建筑或风景照片【{argument name="image style" default="黄金时刻寺庙倒影"}】。受瑞士设计影响的精确网格排版。强调色：【{argument name="color" default="深赭红"}】。小号辅助文字——海拔高度、坐标、标语。大量留白空间。印刷质量美学。现代人文感，艺廊海报品质。

entries.title: 黑白时尚杂志封面
entries.description: 高对比黑白时尚大片，女性肖像叠加杂志排版，极简留白构图，纽约时尚编辑美学。
entries.prompt: High-contrast black and white fashion magazine cover shoot. Striking female model with defined cheekbones and bold eye makeup, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="architectural structured blazer"}. Clean stark white studio background. Sharp geometric shadows falling across face and body. Typography overlay elements: magazine name at top, bold serif headline, smaller subtext columns on sides — authentic editorial layout. Dramatic directional studio lighting creating strong shadow play. Shot on Hasselblad medium format, 80mm lens. Crisp, high-fashion editorial. Timeless and sophisticated.
entries.promptZh: 高对比度黑白时尚杂志封面拍摄。面部轮廓鲜明、大胆眼妆的女性模特，身穿【{argument name="outfit" default="建筑感结构式西装外套"}】。干净纯白摄影棚背景。几何阴影横跨面部和身体。排版覆层元素：顶部杂志名称、粗体衬线标题、两侧较小副文字栏——真实编辑版式。戏剧性定向摄影棚灯光制造强烈阴影层次。哈苏中画幅拍摄，80mm 镜头。清晰高端时尚编辑风格。永恒而精致。

entries.title: 雨夜街头写真
entries.description: 雨夜霓虹反光，街头美女身着皮夹克与格子短裙，湿漉漉的路面倒影，电影级夜间街拍质感。
entries.prompt: Cinematic nighttime street photography portrait. A stylish woman wearing {argument name="outfit" default="black leather jacket and plaid mini skirt"} standing in a neon-lit urban alley. Heavy rain falling, creating wet reflections on cobblestone pavement. Neon signs in red and cyan reflecting on her face and the wet street. Dramatic side lighting from street lamp. She holds an umbrella slightly tilted. Rain-soaked atmosphere, steam rising from manhole covers. Medium format film quality, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Moody and atmospheric, editorial fashion meets street photography aesthetic. 2:3 vertical format.
entries.promptZh: 电影级夜间街头摄影人像。一位时尚女性身穿【{argument name="outfit" default="黑色皮夹克和格子迷你裙"}】，站在霓虹灯照耀的城市小巷中。大雨倾泻，在鹅卵石路面上形成湿润倒影。红色和青色霓虹招牌映照在她的脸上和湿漉漉的街道上。路灯产生戏剧性侧光。她略微倾斜地撑着一把伞。雨水浸透的氛围，下水道飘出蒸汽。中画幅胶片质感，85mm 镜头，浅景深。忧郁而有氛围感，时尚编辑与街头摄影美学融合。2:3 竖幅格式。

entries.title: 俯拍灰色西装女神
entries.description: 完美垂直90度俯视角，女性站在鹅卵石街道，oversize 灰色西装套裙，金色长发自然…
entries.prompt: Exact recreation: woman standing on cobblestone street photographed from perfectly vertical overhead top-down 90-degree angle. Camera directly above her head. Oversized grey blazer and matching short skirt, grey ribbed socks mid-calf, pointed black leather shoes. Long blonde hair flows naturally over shoulders. Dark brown sunglasses. Brown leather shoulder bag on ground to her left. Takeaway coffee cup and small items to her right. Yellow painted line on stone pavement runs horizontally beneath legs. Neutral urban street environment. Natural daylight, overhead ambient, soft realistic shadows. 35mm equivalent lens, photorealistic, high resolution.
entries.promptZh: 精确还原：女性站在鹅卵石街道上，从完全垂直的俯视90度角拍摄。相机直接位于她头顶上方。oversized 灰色西装外套和配套短裙，灰色罗纹中筒袜，尖头黑色皮鞋。金色长发自然垂落于肩膀。深棕色太阳镜。棕色皮革单肩包放在她左侧地面。外卖咖啡杯和小物件放在她右侧。石铺路面上有一条黄色油漆线水平穿过腿下方。中性城市街道环境。自然日光，头顶环境光，柔和真实的阴影。35mm 等效镜头，照片级真实感，高分辨率。

entries.title: 梦幻水彩风男孩插画
entries.description: 梦幻水彩绘本风格，卷发男孩站在欧洲街角花店前，仙女灯光斑，秋日暖调，手绘素描线条加水彩…
entries.prompt: A fantastical watercolor-style illustration. A {argument name="character" default="cute boy with curly hair"} is standing on a {argument name="location" default="warm European street corner"}. He is wearing an oversized {argument name="clothing" default="pastel green knit sweater"}, loose beige shorts, and holding a coffee cup and a bouquet of wildflowers. His slightly messy ginger-colored hair is adorned with small flowers. Fairy lights glow gently overhead with soft cinematic bokeh. A dreamlike autumn atmosphere. The background features fine details of a flower shop. Large, adorable eyes and slightly rosy cheeks. Hand-drawn sketch-style lines with watercolor bleeds. Warm, natural lighting. Ultra-high-definition picture-book art style. Soft pastel colors. A charming and magical atmosphere.
entries.promptZh: 一幅梦幻般的水彩风格插画。一个【{argument name="character" default="卷发可爱男孩"}】正站在【{argument name="location" default="温馨欧洲街角"}】。他穿着一件超大号的【{argument name="clothing" default="淡绿色针织毛衣"}】，搭配宽松米色短裤，手里拿着咖啡杯和一束野花。他略显凌乱的姜黄色头发上点缀着小花。头顶仙女灯发出柔和光芒，伴随着细腻的电影级光斑。营造出梦幻秋日氛围。背景呈现出花店精致细节。拥有又大又可爱的眼睛和微微泛红的脸颊。手绘素描线条结合水彩晕染效果。温暖自然光。超高清绘本艺术风格。柔和粉彩色调。充满魅力与魔法的氛围。

entries.title: 电影级奇幻国家地图集
entries.description: 如同古老羊皮纸书页中发现的奇幻世界地图——山脉用等高晕渲绘制，海怪出没于地图边缘，罗盘…
entries.prompt:
Illustrate a cinematic fantasy world map for the kingdom of The Realm of Aethoria. The map is rendered as an aged parchment artifact: warm ivory-ochre paper with burn marks at the edges, water stains, and fold creases. The map shows a fictional continent with diverse biomes—snow-capped mountains rendered in isometric hachure style, dense forests marked with individual tree icons, rivers tracing paths to the sea.

Cartographic details: cities marked with stylized castle icons varying by size and importance, roads as dotted lines, regional names in ornate calligraphy (mix of Latin-inspired fantasy script and Chinese-inspired seal script). A compass rose in one corner is an artwork unto itself—layered petals and fine engraving. Sea monsters lurk in the open ocean quadrants.

Color: aged parchment base, sepia and raw umber ink, small color accents (territory borders in faded rouge, water in diluted indigo). Art style: antique cartography × Lord of the Rings map × illuminated manuscript. Printed texture feel. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh:
为【[王国名称]】绘制一幅电影级奇幻世界地图。地图被渲染为陈年羊皮纸文物：温暖的象牙赭色纸张，边缘有烧焦痕迹、水渍和折叠皱纹。地图展示一个虚构大陆，有多样生物群系——积雪山脉以等高晕渲风格绘制，茂密森林以单个树木图标标注，河流蜿蜒至海洋。

制图细节：城市以程式化城堡图标标注，大小依重要性变化；道路为虚线；地区名称以华丽书法体（拉丁启发的奇幻字体与中文启发的篆书混合）。一角的罗盘玫瑰本身即是一件艺术品——层叠花瓣和精细雕刻。海怪潜伏在开阔海洋象限。

色彩：陈年羊皮纸底色，棕褐色和生赭色墨水，少量彩色点缀（领土边界用褪色胭脂红，水域用稀释靛蓝）。艺术风格：古代制图 × 指环王地图 × 泥金装饰手稿。印刷纹理质感。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 极简奢华品牌概念大片
entries.description: 奢侈品牌广告的极致克制美学——一件商品、一块空白、几个字母，沉默即是奢华的语言。
entries.prompt:
Create a minimalist luxury brand concept image for MAISON NOIR. The philosophy: restraint is the ultimate luxury. Vast white or off-white negative space dominates—the product or brand element occupies no more than 15–20% of the frame, positioned with mathematical precision.

The product is rendered with jeweler's scrutiny: every surface, texture, and edge visible in perfect clarity. Material: brushed gold. One shadow, clean and directional, falls from a single unseen light source.

Typography: brand name set in 8–10px equivalent weight, maximum tracking, uppercase, somewhere unexpected—bottom right, far left, or vertical along the edge. No tagline. No secondary elements.

Color: pure white, one accent tone (champagne, slate grey, or deep forest), and the product's own material color. Inspired by: Bottega Veneta, Loro Piana, Aesop campaign imagery. The silence of the image communicates more than any text could. Ratio 4:5.
entries.promptZh:
为【[品牌/产品]】创作一张极简奢华品牌概念图。理念：克制是终极奢华。大片白色或米白色负空间主导画面——产品或品牌元素占据不超过15-20%的画框，以数学般的精准定位。

产品以珠宝商的审视标准渲染：每个表面、纹理和边缘在完美清晰度中可见。材质：【[材质：拉丝金/哑光白陶瓷/陈年勃艮第皮革]】。一道阴影，干净而有方向性，从单一不可见光源投下。

字体：品牌名以8-10px等效字重排列，最大字间距，大写，出现在意想不到的位置——右下角、远左侧或沿边缘垂直排列。无标语。无次要元素。

色彩：纯白色、一个强调色调（香槟色、石板灰或深森林绿）和产品本身的材质颜色。灵感来自：Bottega Veneta、Loro Piana、Aesop品牌形象。图像的沉默比任何文字都传达更多。比例 4:5。

entries.title: 日式涂鸦街头艺术海报
entries.description: 昭和末期的日本街头——涂鸦、汉字海报、和风图案与西方朋克美学碰撞，墙壁上是一个时代的视…
entries.prompt:
Create a Japanese street art graffiti poster for TOKYO 東京 — City of Neon Dreams. The composition layers multiple visual systems: bold kanji lettering in thick brushwork alternates with Western-style graffiti throw-ups and tags. Traditional Japanese woodblock patterns (koi scales, seigaiha waves, asanoha hemp leaves) are spray-painted in saturated colors onto aged concrete.

The wall surface shows history: peeling wheat-paste posters underneath revealing earlier layers, dripping paint, texture of exposed brick or stucco. Small details: a konbini receipt stuck in paint, a sticker from a band or brand, footprint smears.

Color: primary spray paint colors—cadmium red, cobalt blue, chrome yellow—over aged grey concrete. Black outline work dominant. Areas of weathered white paste. Art direction: Osamu Sato × Takashi Murakami × West Coast graffiti. Dense composition with negative space for main message. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
为【[主题/信息]】创作一张日式街头涂鸦艺术海报。构图叠加多个视觉系统：粗笔触的大胆汉字书法与西方风格涂鸦贴字和标签交替出现。传统日本木版画图案（锦鲤鳞片、青海波浪、麻叶图案）被喷涂成饱和色彩在老旧混凝土上。

墙面表面展示历史：下面剥落的麦糊海报露出早期层次、滴落的油漆、暴露砖块或灰泥的纹理。小细节：卡在油漆中的便利店收据、乐队或品牌的贴纸、脚印涂抹痕迹。

色彩：主要喷漆颜色——镉红、钴蓝、铬黄——在老旧灰色混凝土上。黑色轮廓线条为主。风化白色粘贴区域。艺术指导：佐藤理 × 村上隆 × 西海岸涂鸦。密集构图配主信息留白。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 星云银河双重曝光人像
entries.description: 宇宙深处的星云与人物剪影双重曝光——猎户星云的蓝紫光晕在面庞之间流淌，仿佛人是由星尘构…
entries.prompt:
Create a cosmic double exposure portrait of a woman's face in profile fused with deep space nebula imagery. The human silhouette serves as the canvas: within the figure's form, the Orion Nebula or Pillars of Creation fills every contour—gaseous clouds of cobalt blue, violet, and rose gold nebulae visible through the transparent skin.

The most luminous nebula regions align with the eyes and heart, creating focal points of internal starlight. Faint star trails trace the jaw and collarbone. The background exterior: deep black space with scattered point stars.

Color palette: deep space black, electric violet, nebula pink, stellar gold, oxygen emission green-blue. The transition between skin/hair and nebula should be seamless—the figure is literally made of cosmic material. Long exposure astronomical photography quality merged with portrait intimacy. Vertical format for maximum impact. Ratio 9:16.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅【[主角]】与深空星云图像融合的宇宙双重曝光人像。人物剪影作为画布：在人物形体内，猎户星云或创生之柱填满每一轮廓——气态星云云团的钴蓝、紫罗兰和玫瑰金透过透明皮肤可见。

最明亮的星云区域与眼睛和心脏对齐，创造内在星光的焦点。淡淡的星迹沿着下颌和锁骨蔓延。外部背景：深邃黑色太空配散布的点状星光。

色彩：深空黑、电紫色、星云粉、恒星金、氧气发射蓝绿色。皮肤/头发与星云之间的过渡应无缝——人物字面意义上由宇宙物质构成。长曝光天文摄影质量与人像亲密感融合。竖版格式以获得最大视觉冲击。比例 9:16。

entries.title: 冰蓝液态飞溅产品摄影
entries.description: 高速摄影冻结液体飞溅的戏剧瞬间——产品与液体在视觉张力中相遇，每一滴都是一个完美球体。
entries.prompt:
Create a high-speed liquid splash product photograph featuring a cobalt blue glass perfume bottle. The product sits at the center of a dramatic explosion of ice-cold water with frozen droplets, frozen at the peak of impact—an arch of liquid erupting upward and outward, individual droplets suspended as perfect spheres catching studio light.

Background: pure black or deep navy gradient. Product is clearly identifiable and pristine—untouched by the surrounding liquid chaos. The splash forms a natural crown or arch framing the product.

Lighting: multiple rim lights backlighting the liquid to reveal its translucency and refractive quality—each droplet is a tiny lens. One hard key light from front-right creating the main specular highlight on the product. The liquid appears ice-cold: pale cyan-white with blue shadows.

Technical quality: motion frozen as if at 1/25000 second shutter. Every droplet in sharp focus. Commercial advertising photography, ultra-clean, 4K. Square 1:1.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[产品]】为主角的高速液态飞溅产品摄影。产品坐落在【[液体：冰冷水/蓝色精华/透明矿泉水]】的戏剧性爆发中心——液体在冲击峰值时向上向外爆发，一个个液滴悬停在空中，如完美球体捕捉摄影棚光线。

背景：纯黑色或深海军蓝渐变。产品清晰可辨且完美无瑕——未被周围液体混沌触及。飞溅形成自然的皇冠或拱形将产品框入。

光效：多个轮廓逆光照亮液体，揭示其透明度和折射特质——每个液滴都是一个微型镜头。一道从右前方的硬主光在产品上产生主要高光。液体呈现冰冷感：苍白青白色配蓝色阴影。

技术质量：运动冻结如1/25000秒快门。每个液滴清晰对焦。商业广告摄影，超干净，4K。正方形 1:1。

entries.title: 等轴测微缩 3D 世界
entries.description: 精密等轴测视角的微缩3D场景——一个完整的小世界在等角视角中展开，每个细节都是一个发现。
entries.prompt:
Render an isometric 3D miniature world depicting a tiny antique bookshop with floor-to-ceiling shelves and a spiral staircase. Perfect isometric projection (30° angle), everything scaled to create a believable miniature diorama effect—the whole scene feels like it could fit on a tabletop.

High level of detail: readable book spines, individual plant species identifiable, tiny working lights with warm glow visible in windows, micro-characters going about their activities. Materials are physically accurate: wood grain, metal edges, glass reflection, fabric textures.

Lighting: golden hour from one side, casting long gentle isometric shadows. A few spotlights inside create warm interior contrast. Slight vignette keeping focus on the micro-world. Color palette: warm earth tones with accent colors depending on theme (library: warm amber and oak; garden: terracotta and moss green; space: deep blue and chrome). Clean white or gradient backdrop. Square 1:1.
entries.promptZh:
渲染一个描绘【[场景：微型书店/屋顶花园/舒适小屋/空间站]】的等轴测3D微缩世界。完美等角投影（30°角），一切按比例创造令人信服的微缩立体模型效果——整个场景感觉可以放在桌面上。

高细节水平：可读的书脊、可辨认的个别植物品种、窗户内可见温暖光芒的微型工作灯、微型角色进行日常活动。材质物理准确：木纹、金属边缘、玻璃反射、织物纹理。

光效：一侧的黄金时刻光芒，投下长而柔和的等角阴影。内部几盏聚光灯制造温暖室内对比。轻微暗角保持焦点在微缩世界上。色彩：暖土色调配主题强调色（图书馆：温琥珀色和橡木色；花园：赤陶和苔藓绿；太空：深蓝和铬合金）。干净白色或渐变背景。正方形 1:1。

entries.title: Y2K 动漫街头风模特
entries.description: 2000年前后Y2K千禧美学的重生——亮蓝发色、低腰牛仔裤、蝴蝶发夹和动漫大眼，城市街…
entries.prompt:
Create a Y2K-inspired anime streetwear fashion editorial portrait of a confident girl with butterfly clips and metallic mini skirt. The character channels early 2000s aesthetics reborn: iridescent hair in electric blue or platinum, butterfly hair clips and chunky platform sneakers, low-rise cargo pants with safety pins, a tiny crop top with star and heart motifs, oversized tinted bug-eye sunglasses.

The art style blends anime illustration with fashion photography: bold graphic eyes with holographic reflections, slightly exaggerated proportions, but rendered in a semi-realistic style. Background: Tokyo street corner in 2001—digital kiosk glow, vending machines, scattered Y2K brand signage in chrome and holographic foil.

Color palette: iridescent pastels, chrome silver, electric pink and cyan, holographic rainbow gloss. Slight scanline overlay suggesting CRT monitor aesthetic. Fashion editorial composition, confident pose, direct eye contact. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[主角]】为主的Y2K动漫街头时尚编辑人像。角色展现2000年代初美学重生：闪光的电蓝或铂金发色，蝴蝶发夹和厚底运动鞋，安全别针低腰工装裤，带有星形和爱心图案的小露脐上衣，超大有色甲壳虫造型太阳镜。

艺术风格融合动漫插画与时尚摄影：大胆的图形眼睛带有全息反射，略微夸张的比例，但以半写实风格渲染。背景：2001年东京街角——数字信息亭光芒、自动售货机、散落的Y2K品牌招牌（镀铬和全息箔）。

色彩：虹彩柔和色、镀铬银、电粉色和青色、全息彩虹光泽。轻微扫描线叠加，暗示CRT显示器美学。时尚编辑构图，自信姿态，直视镜头。比例 2:3。

entries.title: 哥特风黑暗茶会海报
entries.description: 黑暗童话美学的爱丽丝茶会——黑玫瑰、古旧瓷器、蜡烛烛台、哥特蕾丝与那个不按时间走的钟。
entries.prompt:
Design a gothic dark tea party poster centered on a Victorian-era dark queen with porcelain skin and black roses. A grand table draped in black velvet is set for an impossible feast—mismatched baroque china cracked and stained, black roses spilling from a broken teapot, candelabras with dripping dark wax, an antique clock stopped at midnight.

The figure at the head of the table wears an elaborate Victorian-gothic outfit: black lace, silver crow feathers, deep oxblood velvet. Their expression is enigmatic, beckoning. Overgrown dark ivy climbs the walls behind. Moths hover near the candlelight.

Color palette: deep charcoal, oxblood red, silver-white, gold from candlelight. Cinematic portrait-orientation. Art direction: dark fairytale editorial × Alphonse Mucha composition × Edward Gorey line detail. Rich texture, slight desaturation, vignette. Poster format 9:16.
entries.promptZh:
以【[主角/角色]】为中心设计一张哥特风黑暗茶会海报。一张铺着黑色天鹅绒的宏大桌子摆设着不可能的宴会——风格不一的巴洛克瓷器，破裂染渍；黑玫瑰从破茶壶中泻出；滴着深色蜡的烛台；停在午夜的古董钟。

坐在桌头的人物穿着精致的维多利亚哥特服装：黑色蕾丝、银色乌鸦羽毛、深牛血色天鹅绒。表情神秘，似在招手。深色常青藤蔓延在身后墙壁。飞蛾徘徊在烛光附近。

色彩：深炭黑、牛血红、银白、烛光金。电影竖版构图。艺术指导：黑暗童话编辑风格 × 慕夏构图 × 爱德华·高雷线条细节。丰富质感，轻微去饱和，暗角。海报格式 9:16。

entries.title: 纸雕分层立体模型
entries.description: 多层剪纸层叠而成的立体微缩世界——柔和的颜色渐变、精细的剪影边缘、从正面射入的自然漫射…
entries.prompt:
Create a layered paper-cut diorama illustration of enchanted forest at twilight with glowing mushrooms. The scene is built from 8–12 distinct paper layers, each receding further into depth, creating a parallax shadowbox effect.

Each layer is precisely cut with delicate silhouette details—foreground layer may show grass blades and flowers, middle layers have trees or rocks, background layers dissolve into soft atmospheric shapes. The paper has a clean card-stock texture with visible cut edges.

Lighting: soft natural diffused light from slightly above-front, casting gentle graduated shadows between each layer, emphasizing the physical depth. Color progression from warm saturated foreground to cool desaturated background (or a single hue progression: coral to pale peach, forest green to sky blue).

Aesthetic: clean Scandinavian craft meets Japanese precision. No photography references—pure paper art illustration. Soft studio background. Ratio 4:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅以【[场景：魔法森林/山顶日出/水下珊瑚园]】为主题的分层纸雕立体模型插画。场景由8-12层独立纸层构建，每层向更深处退去，创造视差灯箱效果。

每层都有精确切割的细腻剪影细节——前景层可能是草叶和花朵，中层有树木或岩石，背景层渐溶为柔和的大气形状。纸张有干净的卡纸纹理，可见切割边缘。

光效：柔和的自然漫射光从略微前上方照射，在每层之间投下轻柔的渐进阴影，强调物理深度感。色彩从温暖饱和的前景到冷淡去饱和的背景渐变（或单色相渐变：珊瑚色到浅桃色，森林绿到天蓝色）。

美学：干净的斯堪的纳维亚工艺与日本精准性相遇。无摄影参考——纯纸艺插画。柔和摄影棚背景。比例 4:3。

entries.title: 赛博朋克霓虹城市夜景
entries.description: 酸雨倾盆的2049年深夜——霓虹倒影在积水街道，巨型广告牌汉字在烟雾中闪烁，孤独的剪影…
entries.prompt:
Paint a cinematic cyberpunk cityscape set in 2049 Neo-Tokyo 2077. Torrential acid rain. The streets below reflect an infinite neon mirror: magenta, electric blue, toxic green kanji advertising signs stacked thirty stories high. Steam vents from grated manholes. Crowds in ponchos and face masks move through the narrow alleys.

A lone a lone detective in a worn trench coat stands silhouetted on a rooftop edge, back to camera, overlooking the city's electric abyss. In the sky: massive blimp advertising holograms, drone swarms, and layer upon layer of elevated highways with gridlocked flying vehicles, their brake lights smearing red in the rain.

Art direction: Blade Runner 2049 × Ghost in the Shell × Akira. Color palette: deep indigo black, saturated magenta and cyan neon, orange fire bursts, chromatic aberration. Extreme atmospheric perspective with volumetric light shafts through fog. Ultra-detailed, cinematic widescreen 16:9.
entries.promptZh:
绘制一幅设定在2049年【[城市]】的电影级赛博朋克城市夜景。倾盆的酸雨。下方街道倒映出无限霓虹镜像：品红、电光蓝、荧光绿的汉字广告牌叠加到三十层楼高。蒸汽从格栅式下水道盖子中喷出。穿着雨衣和戴面罩的人群穿行于狭窄巷弄。

一个孤独的【[人物]】剪影站在屋顶边缘，背对镜头，俯瞰城市的电光深渊。天空中：巨型飞艇全息广告、无人机群，以及一层层高架公路上堵塞的飞行车辆，刹车灯在雨中拖出红色光迹。

艺术指导：银翼杀手2049 × 攻壳机动队 × 阿基拉。色彩：深靛蓝黑、饱和品红和青色霓虹、橙色火光、色差效果。极致大气透视与雾中体积光束。超细节，电影宽屏 16:9。

entries.title: 90年代日本居酒屋快照
entries.description: 35mm一次性相机拍下的深夜居酒屋瞬间——暖黄灯光、烟雾、昭和遗风、和那个年代的疲惫与…
entries.prompt:
Capture a candid 35mm film snapshot of a late-night Japanese izakaya scene in the early 1990s. The setting: a narrow counter with 8 seats, hanging noren curtain slightly swaying, paper lanterns casting warm amber light, the glass fogging from yakitori smoke.

salary men unwinding after work sits hunched over a ceramic sake cup or cold beer, work jacket still on, the day's exhaustion visible in their shoulders. Empty skewers accumulate on a small plate. A handwritten menu board on the wall shows kanji in thick brushwork. Other patrons blur in the background.

Film stock aesthetic: expired Fujifilm 400 or Kodak Gold 200—slight color shift toward warm orange-green, heavy grain, lens flare from bare bulb overhead, slight blur from a slow shutter hand-held. Flash used, creating that characteristic harsh-yet-intimate 90s snapshot look. Ratio 3:4.
entries.promptZh:
用35mm胶片相机捕捉一个1990年代初深夜日本居酒屋的偷拍快照。场景：狭窄的吧台有【[数量]】个座位，悬挂的暖帘轻轻摇曳，纸灯笼投下暖琥珀色光芒，烤串的烟雾使玻璃起雾。

【[主体]】弓背坐在陶瓷清酒杯或冰啤酒前，还穿着工作夹克，肩膀上可见一天的疲惫。小碟子上积累着空烤串签。墙上手写菜单用粗笔触书写汉字。背景中其他顾客模糊化。

胶片美学：过期的富士400或柯达Gold 200——轻微的暖橙绿色偏移、浓重颗粒、头顶裸灯泡的镜头炫光、手持慢快门产生的轻微模糊。使用闪光灯，产生90年代快照特有的粗粝而亲密的感觉。比例 3:4。

entries.title: 月光双重曝光人像
entries.description: 人物剪影与自然景观的双重曝光融合——松林、星河、海浪在面庞与颈肩之间流淌，成为一幅诗意…
entries.prompt:
Create a double exposure portrait of a woman's silhouette merged with ancient pine forest. The human silhouette provides the outer boundary; within it, a secondary landscape scene is visible—trees, water, or cosmos filling the figure as if they are made of nature itself.

Exposure balance: the portrait's facial features should remain subtly readable, while the landscape fills and flows through the form. The background outside the silhouette fades to soft foggy white or deep night blue.

Tone: silver gelatin film aesthetic, high contrast, delicate grain. Key light comes from behind casting the figure as a near-silhouette. The landscape within glows with an internal light—moonlit forest, bioluminescent waves, or star clusters. Color: predominantly monochromatic silver-blue-white with a single warm amber accent. Dreamy, poetic, contemplative. Ratio 2:3.
entries.promptZh:
创作一幅【[人物]】与【[景观：松林/海浪/星云]】融合的双重曝光人像。人物剪影提供外部边界；其中可见次级景观——树木、水流或宇宙填充人物，仿佛他们本身由自然构成。

曝光平衡：人像的面部特征应保持微妙可辨，而景观填充并在形体中流淌。轮廓外的背景渐变为柔雾白或深夜蓝。

调色：银明胶胶片美学，高对比度，细腻颗粒感。背光使人物成为近乎剪影。内部景观散发内在光芒——月光森林、生物发光海浪或星团。色彩：以银蓝白单色调为主，加一个暖琥珀色点缀。梦幻、诗意、沉思。比例 2:3。
